# Wrong Way — AdManager (Google AdMob & Cross-Platform Ad System)
# - Banner: Displayed in all menus (Main Menu, Level Select, Editor), strictly HIDDEN during active gameplay.
# - Interstitial (To'liq ekranli oraliq reklama): Triggers immediately when a player replays an already beaten level.
# - Rewarded Video: Triggers when player watches an ad to unlock a level (alternating "cheriz" rule).

# Google AdMob Identifikatorlari (Official Production IDs)
const ADMOB_APP_ID := "ca-app-pub-9009277559004471~1297962659"
const ADMOB_BANNER_ID := "ca-app-pub-9009277559004471/5320968143"
const ADMOB_INTERSTITIAL_ID := "ca-app-pub-9009277559004471/1106390961"
const ADMOB_REWARDED_ID := "ca-app-pub-9009277559004471/5903035034"

# RELIZ UCHUN MUHIM:
# 1) Haqiqiy AdMob plaginini (GodotAdMob yoki PoingGodotAdMob) loyihaga o'rnatish shart — hozir
#    loyihada native plagin YO'Q, shuning uchun banner/interstitial/rewarded faqat mahalliy mock overlay.
# 2) UMP (User Messaging Platform) consent dialogi ulanishi va set_consent() orqali uzatilishi shart (GDPR/COPPA).
# 3) Reward berish native "rewarded completed" callback'iga bog'lanishi kerak (hozir mock taymer bilan beriladi).

signal banner_visibility_changed(is_visible: bool)
signal rewarded_ad_started
signal rewarded_ad_completed(reward_granted: bool)
signal interstitial_ad_completed

# Banner UI
var banner_panel: Panel = null

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_setup_ad_ui()
	_init_native_admob()

func _setup_ad_ui() -> void:
	canvas_layer = CanvasLayer.new()
	canvas_layer.layer = 120 # Above HUD and modals
	canvas_layer.name = "AdLayer"
	add_child(canvas_layer)
	
	_create_banner_ui()
	_create_rewarded_ui()
	_create_interstitial_ui()

	# Ad Badge

func show_banner() -> void:
	if not banner_enabled:
		hide_banner()
		return
	is_banner_active = true
	# Sun'iy mock banner ko'rsatilmaydi - faqat rasmiy AdMob plagini ishlaganda native ko'rinadi
	if banner_panel:
		banner_panel.visible = false
	banner_visibility_changed.emit(true)
	_native_show_banner()

func hide_banner() -> void:
	is_banner_active = false
	if banner_panel:
		banner_panel.visible = false
	banner_visibility_changed.emit(false)
	_native_hide_banner()

func is_banner_visible() -> bool:
	return is_banner_active

func set_consent(granted: bool) -> void:
	consent_granted = granted
	if not consent_granted:
		hide_banner()

func show_interstitial_ad(on_finish_callback: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
	pending_interstitial_callback = on_finish_callback
	is_interstitial_active = true
	is_interstitial_finished = false
	interstitial_elapsed = 0.0
	
	if interstitial_progress:
		interstitial_progress.value = 0.0
	if interstitial_timer_label:
		interstitial_timer_label.text = "4s"
	if interstitial_skip_btn:
		interstitial_skip_btn.disabled = true
		interstitial_skip_btn.text = "O'tkazib yuborish (3s)"
		
	if interstitial_overlay:
		interstitial_overlay.visible = true
		interstitial_overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(interstitial_overlay, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2)
		
	_native_show_interstitial()

func _on_skip_interstitial_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	_finish_interstitial()

func _finish_interstitial() -> void:
	is_interstitial_active = false
	if interstitial_overlay:
		interstitial_overlay.visible = false
		
	if pending_interstitial_callback.is_valid():
		pending_interstitial_callback.call()
		pending_interstitial_callback = Callable()
		
	interstitial_ad_completed.emit()

	is_rewarded_finished = false
	rewarded_elapsed = 0.0
	
	if rewarded_progress: rewarded_progress.value = 0.0
	if rewarded_timer_label:
		rewarded_timer_label.text = "5s"
		rewarded_timer_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.35))
	if rewarded_status_label:
		rewarded_status_label.text = "Keyingi darajani ochish uchun video tomosha qilinmoqda..."
		rewarded_status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.9, 0.88, 0.94))
	if rewarded_claim_btn:
		rewarded_claim_btn.disabled = true
		rewarded_claim_btn.text = "Reklamani oxirigacha ko'ring (5s)"
		
	if rewarded_overlay:
		rewarded_overlay.visible = true
		rewarded_overlay.modulate.a = 0.0
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(rewarded_overlay, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2)
		
	rewarded_ad_started.emit()
	_native_show_rewarded()

func _on_claim_reward_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	is_rewarded_active = false
	if rewarded_overlay:
		rewarded_overlay.visible = false
		
	if pending_reward_callback.is_valid():
		pending_reward_callback.call()
		pending_reward_callback = Callable()
		
	rewarded_ad_completed.emit(true)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Process & Loop Updates
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	# Rewarded Video Update
	if is_rewarded_active and not is_rewarded_finished:
		rewarded_elapsed += delta
		var remaining := maxf(0.0, rewarded_duration_sec - rewarded_elapsed)
		var pct := clampf((rewarded_elapsed / rewarded_duration_sec) * 100.0, 0.0, 100.0)
		
		if rewarded_progress: rewarded_progress.value = pct
		if rewarded_timer_label: rewarded_timer_label.text = "%0.1fs" % remaining
		if rewarded_claim_btn: rewarded_claim_btn.text = "Reklamani oxirigacha ko'ring (%ds)" % int(ceilf(remaining))
		
		if rewarded_elapsed >= rewarded_duration_sec:
			is_rewarded_finished = true
			if rewarded_timer_label:
				rewarded_timer_label.text = "Tugadi!"
				rewarded_timer_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.35, 0.85, 0.45))
			if rewarded_status_label:
				rewarded_status_label.text = "Reklama yakunlandi! Daraja ochildi!"
				rewarded_status_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.35, 0.95, 0.55))
			if rewarded_claim_btn:
				rewarded_claim_btn.disabled = false
				rewarded_claim_btn.text = "DARAJANI OCHISH"
			SoundManager.play("win")

	# Interstitial Update
	if is_interstitial_active and not is_interstitial_finished:
		interstitial_elapsed += delta
		var rem := maxf(0.0, interstitial_duration_sec - interstitial_elapsed)
		var pct := clampf((interstitial_elapsed / interstitial_duration_sec) * 100.0, 0.0, 100.0)
		
		if interstitial_progress: interstitial_progress.value = pct
		if interstitial_timer_label: interstitial_timer_label.text = "%0.1fs" % rem
		
		# 3 soniyadan keyin o'tkazib yuborish tugmasi faollashadi
		if interstitial_elapsed >= 2.5:
			if interstitial_skip_btn:
				interstitial_skip_btn.disabled = false
				interstitial_skip_btn.text = "O'TKAZIB YUBORISH (X)"
				
		if interstitial_elapsed >= interstitial_duration_sec:
			is_interstitial_finished = true
			_finish_interstitial()

# Env - Wrong Way Central Environment & Configuration Manager
# Parses .env file from project root or falls back to system environment & defaults

static var _vars: Dictionary = {}
static var _is_loaded: bool = false

const DEFAULT_SUPABASE_URL := "https://wcwjobrrwwjfthpflzhg.supabase.co"
const DEFAULT_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY := "eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzdXBhYmFzZSIsInJlZiI6Indjd2pvYnJyd3dqZnRocGZsemhnIiwicm9sZSI6ImFub24iLCJpYXQiOjE3OTM0NzIzNTEsImV4cCI6MjEwOTA0ODM1MX0.16SXhNkvVehgIuNhcGH3l9bDS37mkmbGt12h8F2CyoY"

static func _ensure_loaded() -> void:
	if _is_loaded:
		return
	_is_loaded = true
	var paths := ["res://.env", ".env"]
	for p in paths:
		if FileAccess.file_exists(p):
			var f := FileAccess.open(p, FileAccess.READ)
			if f:
				while not f.eof_reached():
					var line := f.get_line().strip_edges()
					if line.is_empty() or line.begins_with("#"):
						continue
					var eq_idx := line.find("=")
					if eq_idx != -1:
						var k := line.substr(0, eq_idx).strip_edges()
						var v := line.substr(eq_idx + 1).strip_edges()
						if (v.begins_with('"') and v.ends_with('"')) or (v.begins_with("'") and v.ends_with("'")):
							v = v.substr(1, v.length() - 2)
						_vars[k] = v
				f.close()
				break

static func get_var(key: String, default_val: String = "") -> String:
	_ensure_loaded()
	if _vars.has(key) and not str(_vars[key]).is_empty():
		return str(_vars[key])
	var os_val := OS.get_environment(key)
	if not os_val.is_empty():
		return os_val
	return default_val

static func get_supabase_url() -> String:
	return get_var("SUPABASE_URL", DEFAULT_SUPABASE_URL)

static func get_supabase_anon_key() -> String:
	return get_var("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY", DEFAULT_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)

		if event.keycode == KEY_R and is_level_running and not get_tree().paused:
			restart_current_level()
		elif event.keycode == KEY_F11:
			toggle_fullscreen()
		elif event.keycode == KEY_F10 and OS.has_feature("editor"):
			var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")

# GoogleAuthService - Wrong Way Official Cross-Platform Google Authentication
# - Desktop (Windows/Mac/Linux): Opens official Google Sign-In in default browser & receives token via local loopback server
# - Mobile (Android): Connects to native Google Play Games Services v2 / Google Credential Manager bottom sheet
# - Automatic fallback and zero custom fake modals

signal auth_succeeded(user_data: Dictionary)
signal auth_failed(error_message: String)

const LOOPBACK_PORT: int = 8943
const REDIRECT_URI: String = "http://127.0.0.1:8943/callback"
const REFRESH_TOKEN_PATH := "user://google_refresh_token.txt"

var tcp_server: TCPServer
var is_listening: bool = false
var auth_timeout_timer: SceneTreeTimer
var http_user: HTTPRequest

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	http_user = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_user.name = "GoogleAuthUserHTTP"
	http_user.timeout = 6.0
	add_child(http_user)
	http_user.request_completed.connect(_on_user_info_completed)

func start_google_sign_in() -> void:
	if OS.get_name() == "Android":
		_start_android_sign_in()
	else:
		_start_desktop_oauth()

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Android Native Google Play Games / Sign-In
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _start_android_sign_in() -> void:
	print("GoogleAuthService: Android muhitida Google Sign-In ishga tushirilmoqda...")
	
	# 1. Native Android Google Account Chooser (OS darajasidagi haqiqiy tizim oynasi)
	if Engine.has_singleton("WrongWayAccountPicker"):
		var picker = Engine.get_singleton("WrongWayAccountPicker")
		if picker.has_signal("account_picked") and not picker.account_picked.is_connected(_on_android_account_picked):
			picker.account_picked.connect(_on_android_account_picked)
		if picker.has_signal("account_picker_failed") and not picker.account_picker_failed.is_connected(_on_android_account_picker_failed):
			picker.account_picker_failed.connect(_on_android_account_picker_failed)
			
		if picker.has_method("openAccountPicker"):
			picker.openAccountPicker()
			return

	# 2. Google Play Games Services v2
	if Engine.has_singleton("GodotPlayGames"):
		var pgs = Engine.get_singleton("GodotPlayGames")
		if pgs.has_signal("user_authenticated") and not pgs.user_authenticated.is_connected(_on_android_pgs_success):
			pgs.user_authenticated.connect(_on_android_pgs_success)
		if pgs.has_signal("authentication_failed") and not pgs.authentication_failed.is_connected(_on_android_pgs_failed):
			pgs.authentication_failed.connect(_on_android_pgs_failed)
			
		if pgs.has_method("signIn"):
			pgs.signIn()
			return

	# 2. Standart Android Google Sign-In
	if Engine.has_singleton("GoogleSignIn"):
		var gsi = Engine.get_singleton("GoogleSignIn")
		if gsi.has_signal("sign_in_success") and not gsi.sign_in_success.is_connected(_on_android_gsi_success):
			gsi.sign_in_success.connect(_on_android_gsi_success)
		if gsi.has_signal("sign_in_failed") and not gsi.sign_in_failed.is_connected(_on_android_gsi_failed):
			gsi.sign_in_failed.connect(_on_android_gsi_failed)
			
		if gsi.has_method("signIn"):
			gsi.signIn()
			return

	# Android'da Google plagin mavjud bo'lmasa, soxta hisob yaratmasdan xato qaytaramiz.
	auth_failed.emit("Google orqali kirish bu qurilmada mavjud emas.")

func _on_android_account_picked(acc_email: String, acc_name: String) -> void:
	print("GoogleAuthService: Android tizimidan Google hisobi tanlandi: ", acc_email, " (", acc_name, ")")
	var user_data := {"email": acc_email, "name": acc_name}
	ProfileManager.login_with_google(acc_email, acc_name)
	auth_succeeded.emit(user_data)

func _on_android_account_picker_failed(err_msg: String) -> void:
	print("GoogleAuthService: Android hisob tanlash bekor qilindi: ", err_msg)
	auth_failed.emit(err_msg)

func _on_android_pgs_success(is_auth: bool) -> void:
	if is_auth:
		var pgs = Engine.get_singleton("GodotPlayGames")
		var player_name: String = pgs.getPlayerName() if pgs.has_method("getPlayerName") else "Gamer"
		var player_id: String = pgs.getPlayerId() if pgs.has_method("getPlayerId") else ""
		var email_str := player_id + "@playgames.google.com" if not player_id.is_empty() else "player@playgames.google.com"
		
		print("GoogleAuthService: Play Games muvaffaqiyatli: ", player_name)
		var user_data := {"email": email_str, "name": player_name}
		ProfileManager.login_with_google(email_str, player_name)
		auth_succeeded.emit(user_data)
	else:
		_on_android_pgs_failed(-1)

func _on_android_pgs_failed(err_code: int) -> void:
	print("GoogleAuthService: Android Play Games xatosi: ", err_code)
	auth_failed.emit("Google Play Games xatosi: " + str(err_code))

func _on_android_gsi_success(account_info: Dictionary) -> void:
	var g_email: String = account_info.get("email", "")
	var g_name: String = account_info.get("displayName", "")
	print("GoogleAuthService: Google Sign-In muvaffaqiyatli: ", g_email)
	var user_data := {"email": g_email, "name": g_name}
	ProfileManager.login_with_google(g_email, g_name)
	auth_succeeded.emit(user_data)

func _on_android_gsi_failed(err_msg: String) -> void:
	print("GoogleAuthService: Google Sign-In xatosi: ", err_msg)
	auth_failed.emit(err_msg)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Desktop (Windows / Mac / Linux) Official Google Browser OAuth
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _start_desktop_oauth() -> void:
	_stop_loopback_server()
	
	tcp_server = TCPServer.new()
	var err := tcp_server.listen(LOOPBACK_PORT, "127.0.0.1")
	if err != OK:
		print("GoogleAuthService: Loopback serverni ishga tushirib bo'lmadi (Port %d band). Xato: %d" % [LOOPBACK_PORT, err])
		auth_failed.emit("Lokal serverni ochib bo'lmadi (Port %d band)" % LOOPBACK_PORT)
		return
		
	is_listening = true
	print("GoogleAuthService: Lokal loopback server tinglamoqda: ", REDIRECT_URI)
	
	# Rasmiy Supabase Google OAuth havolasi
	var supabase_url: String = Env.get_supabase_url()
	var auth_url := "%s/auth/v1/authorize?provider=google&redirect_to=%s" % [supabase_url, REDIRECT_URI.uri_encode()]
	
	print("GoogleAuthService: Brauzerda rasmiy Google sahifasi ochilmoqda: ", auth_url)
	OS.shell_open(auth_url)
	
	# 90 soniyalik kutish taymeri
	auth_timeout_timer = get_tree().create_timer(90.0)
	auth_timeout_timer.timeout.connect(func():
		if is_listening:
			_stop_loopback_server()
			auth_failed.emit("Google orqali kirish vaqti tugadi (Timeout)")
	)

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_listening or not tcp_server:
		return
		
	if tcp_server.is_connection_available():
		var peer: StreamPeerTCP = tcp_server.take_connection()
		if peer:
			_handle_http_client(peer)

func _handle_http_client(peer: StreamPeerTCP) -> void:
	# HTTP so'rov kelishini qisqa kutamiz
	var start_ms := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	while peer.get_status() == StreamPeerTCP.STATUS_CONNECTED and peer.get_available_bytes() == 0:
		if Time.get_ticks_msec() - start_ms > 2000:
			break
		OS.delay_msec(10)
		
	var available := peer.get_available_bytes()
	if available <= 0:
		peer.disconnect_from_host()
		return
		
	var raw_req := peer.get_utf8_string(available)
	var lines := raw_req.split("\r\n")
	if lines.is_empty():
		peer.disconnect_from_host()
		return
		
	var request_line := lines[0] # masalan: GET /callback?code=... HTTP/1.1 yoki GET /callback#...

	response += "Connection: close\r\n\r\n"
	response += html_body

	# URL dagi parametrlarni ajratib olish
	_parse_auth_request(request_line)
	
	# Qisqa tanaffusdan keyin ulanishni yopish
	get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout.connect(func():
		peer.disconnect_from_host()

func _parse_auth_request(req_line: String) -> void:
	# Masalan: GET /callback?code=xyz... yoki GET /callback?access_token=xyz...
	var parts := req_line.split(" ")
	if parts.size() < 2:
		return
		
	var path_and_query: String = parts[1]
	if not path_and_query.contains("?"):
		return
		
	var query_str := path_and_query.split("?")[1]
	var query_params := {}
	for param in query_str.split("&"):
		var kv := param.split("=")
		if kv.size() == 2:
			query_params[kv[0]] = kv[1].uri_decode()
			
	print("GoogleAuthService: Callback parametrlari olindi: ", query_params.keys())
	
	# Agar xatolik bo'lsa
	if query_params.has("error"):
		var err_desc: String = query_params.get("error_description", query_params["error"])
		print("GoogleAuthService: OAuth xatosi: ", err_desc)
		auth_failed.emit(err_desc)
		_stop_loopback_server()
		return
		
	# Supabase Access Token orqali haqiqiy Google profilini olish
	if query_params.has("access_token"):
		var token: String = query_params["access_token"]
		if query_params.has("refresh_token"):
			_store_refresh_token(str(query_params["refresh_token"]))
		_fetch_supabase_user(token)
		return

	var user_email := ""
	var user_name := ""
	
	if query_params.has("user_email"):
		user_email = query_params["user_email"]
	if query_params.has("user_name"):
		user_name = query_params["user_name"]
		
	if user_email.is_empty():
		print("GoogleAuthService: Callbackda email parametri topilmadi.")
		auth_failed.emit("Google hisob ma'lumotlari topilmadi.")
		return
		
	_stop_loopback_server()
	ProfileManager.login_with_google(user_email, user_name)
	auth_succeeded.emit({"email": user_email, "name": user_name})

func _fetch_supabase_user(access_token: String) -> void:
	if not http_user:
		return
	var url := Env.get_supabase_url() + "/auth/v1/user"
	var anon_key := Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + access_token
	]
	http_user.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_GET)

func _on_user_info_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	_stop_loopback_server()
	if response_code == 200:
		var txt := body.get_string_from_utf8()
		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
		if parsed is Dictionary and parsed.has("email"):
			var u_email: String = str(parsed["email"]).strip_edges()
			var u_name := ""
			var meta = parsed.get("user_metadata", {})
			if meta is Dictionary:
				u_name = str(meta.get("full_name", meta.get("name", ""))).strip_edges()
			if u_name.is_empty():
				u_name = ProfileManager.get_name_from_email(u_email)
				
			print("GoogleAuthService: Haqiqiy Google foydalanuvchisi olindi: ", u_email, " (", u_name, ")")
			ProfileManager.login_with_google(u_email, u_name)
			_bring_game_window_to_front()
			auth_succeeded.emit({"email": u_email, "name": u_name})
			return
			
	print("GoogleAuthService: User info olishda xatolik (HTTP %d)" % response_code)
	_bring_game_window_to_front()
	auth_failed.emit("Google hisob ma'lumotlarini olishda xatolik yuz berdi (HTTP %d)" % response_code)

func _store_refresh_token(token: String) -> void:
	if token.is_empty():
		return
	var f := FileAccess.open(REFRESH_TOKEN_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if f:
		f.store_string(token)
		f.close()

func _bring_game_window_to_front() -> void:
	if OS.has_feature("pc"):
		DisplayServer.window_request_attention()
		DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON_TOP, true)
		DisplayServer.window_set_flag(DisplayServer.WINDOW_FLAG_ALWAYS_ON_TOP, false)

func _stop_loopback_server() -> void:
	is_listening = false
	if tcp_server:
		tcp_server.stop()
		tcp_server = null
	print("GoogleAuthService: Loopback server to'xtatildi.")

func get_icon(icon_name: String, scale: float = 1.0) -> Texture2D:
	var key := "%s_%.1f" % [icon_name, scale]
	if _cache.has(key):
		return _cache[key]

	if not SVG_ICONS.has(icon_name):
		push_warning("IconFactory: Icon not found: " + icon_name)
		return null

	var svg_str: String = SVG_ICONS[icon_name]
	var img := Image.new()
	var err := img.load_svg_from_string(svg_str, scale)
	if err == OK:
		var tex := ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
		_cache[key] = tex
		return tex
	return null

func create_texture_rect(icon_name: String, custom_sz: Vector2 = Vector2(24, 24), scale: float = 1.0) -> TextureRect:
	var rect := TextureRect.new()
	rect.texture = get_icon(icon_name, scale)
	rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	rect.custom_minimum_size = custom_sz
	rect.size = custom_sz
	rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	return rect

extends Node

# LevelDatabase - Data-driven Level System (Supabase-integrated)
# 1. Local fallback from res://data/levels.json or user://levels_cache.json
# 2. Asynchronous background sync from Supabase REST API ('levels' table)
# 3. Transparent caching: if online, updates with the latest Supabase level data!

signal levels_synced_from_cloud(count: int)

const CACHE_FILE_PATH := "user://levels_cache.json"

var _levels_cache: Dictionary = {}
var is_loaded: bool = false
var http_sync: HTTPRequest

func _ready() -> void:
	load_local_levels()
	_init_supabase_sync()

func load_local_levels() -> void:
	_levels_cache.clear()
	
	# 1. Asosiy manba - loyihadagi res://data/levels.json
	var file_path := "res://data/levels.json"
	if FileAccess.file_exists(file_path):
		var file := FileAccess.open(file_path, FileAccess.READ)
		if file:
			var json_text := file.get_as_text()
			file.close()
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(json_text)
			if parsed is Array:
				_populate_cache(parsed)
				
	# 2. Agar user keshida to'liqroq ma'lumot bo'lsa (faqat kamida 60 ta bo'lsa)
	if FileAccess.file_exists(CACHE_FILE_PATH):
		var u_file := FileAccess.open(CACHE_FILE_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
		if u_file:
			var u_text := u_file.get_as_text()
			u_file.close()
			var u_parsed = JSON.parse_string(u_text)
			if u_parsed is Array and u_parsed.size() >= 60:
				_populate_cache(u_parsed)
			else:
				# Eski keshni butunlay tozalab tashlaymiz
				DirAccess.remove_absolute(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(CACHE_FILE_PATH))
			
	is_loaded = true
	print("LevelDatabase: %d ta daraja muvaffaqiyatli yuklandi!" % _levels_cache.size())

func _populate_cache(items: Array) -> void:
	for item in items:
		if item is Dictionary and item.has("id"):
			var lvl_id: int = int(item["id"])
			_levels_cache[lvl_id] = item

func _init_supabase_sync() -> void:
	http_sync = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_sync.name = "SupabaseLevelSync"
	add_child(http_sync)
	http_sync.request_completed.connect(_on_sync_completed)
	
	# Backgroundda Supabase'dan eng so'nggi darajalarni olish
	fetch_from_supabase()

func fetch_from_supabase() -> void:
	if not http_sync:
		return
	var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/levels?select=*&order=id.asc"
	var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key
	]
	var err := http_sync.request(url, headers)
	if err != OK:
		print("LevelDatabase: Supabase so'rovida xatolik: ", err)

func _on_sync_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	if response_code == 200:
		var json_str := body.get_string_from_utf8()
		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(json_str)
		# Faqatgina Supabase'da kamida 60 ta to'liq daraja bo'lgandagina keshlaymiz
		if parsed is Array and parsed.size() >= 60:
			_populate_cache(parsed)
			# Keshga saqlash
			var save_file := FileAccess.open(CACHE_FILE_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
			if save_file:
				save_file.store_string(json_str)
				save_file.close()
			print("LevelDatabase: Supabase'dan %d ta daraja yangilandi va keshlandi!" % parsed.size())
			levels_synced_from_cloud.emit(parsed.size())
		else:
			print("LevelDatabase: Supabase'dagi darajalar soni kam (%d < 60), lokal 60 ta daraja saqlab qolindi." % (parsed.size() if parsed is Array else 0))
	else:
		print("LevelDatabase: Supabase sinxronizatsiyasi o'tkazib yuborildi (Offline/Status: %d)" % response_code)

func get_level(level_id: int) -> Dictionary:
	if not is_loaded:
		load_local_levels()
	return _levels_cache.get(level_id, {})

func has_level(level_id: int) -> bool:
	if not is_loaded:
		load_local_levels()
	return _levels_cache.has(level_id)

func get_all_levels() -> Array:
	if not is_loaded:
		load_local_levels()
	return _levels_cache.values()

extends Node

# LocaleManager: Multi-language localization system for Wrong Way
# Supports: uz (O'zbek), ru (Русский), en (English), tr (Türkçe)

signal language_changed(lang_code: String)

var current_language: String = "uz"

func _ready() -> void:
	# Load language from SaveManager if available
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm and "current_language" in sm:
		current_language = sm.current_language

func set_language(lang_code: String) -> void:
	if not LANGUAGES.has(lang_code):
		return
	current_language = lang_code
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm and "current_language" in sm:
		sm.current_language = lang_code
		sm.save_data()
	language_changed.emit(lang_code)

func t(key: String, args: Array = []) -> String:
	var dict: Dictionary = STRINGS.get(current_language, STRINGS["uz"])
	var text: String = dict.get(key, key)
	if not args.is_empty():
		return text % args
	return text

# Convenience shorthand
func tr_text(key: String, args: Array = []) -> String:
	return t(key, args)

extends Node

# ProfileManager - Wrong Way Player Identity & Auth System
# - Manages Device UUID, Supabase Player Tag (e.g. WW-4467), Username & Avatar
# - Local caching in user://player_profile.json
# - Seamless background sync with Supabase profiles table via Env configuration

signal profile_loaded(profile_data: Dictionary)
signal profile_updated(profile_data: Dictionary)
signal google_login_finished(success: bool, error_msg: String)

const PROFILE_CACHE_PATH := "user://player_profile.json"
const FRIENDS_CACHE_PATH := "user://saved_friends.json"
const GOOGLE_ACCOUNTS_PATH := "user://google_accounts.json"
const DEVICE_ID_PATH := "user://device_id.txt"

var device_id: String = ""
var player_id: String = ""
var player_tag: String = "WW-0000"
var username: String = "Player"
var avatar_index: int = 1
var auth_provider: String = "guest"
var email: String = ""
var has_chosen_auth: bool = false
var is_ready_online: bool = false
var saved_friends: Array = []

var http_guest: HTTPRequest
var http_google: HTTPRequest
var http_update: HTTPRequest
var http_cloud: HTTPRequest

var id_overlay: CanvasLayer
var id_corner_lbl: Label

func _ready() -> void:
	http_guest = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_guest.name = "ProfileGuestHTTP"
	http_guest.timeout = 6.0
	add_child(http_guest)
	http_guest.request_completed.connect(_on_guest_completed)
	
	http_google = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_google.name = "ProfileGoogleHTTP"
	http_google.timeout = 6.0
	add_child(http_google)
	http_google.request_completed.connect(_on_google_completed)
	
	http_update = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_update.name = "ProfileUpdateHTTP"
	http_update.timeout = 6.0
	add_child(http_update)
	http_update.request_completed.connect(_on_update_completed)

	http_cloud = HTTPRequest.new()
	http_cloud.name = "ProfileCloudHTTP"
	http_cloud.timeout = 6.0
	add_child(http_cloud)
	http_cloud.request_completed.connect(_on_cloud_completed)

	_load_or_create_device_id()
	_load_local_profile()
	_load_saved_friends()
	_setup_corner_id_overlay()
	
	# Agar avval Google bilan kirgan bo'lsa, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri Google profili sinxronlanadi
	if auth_provider == "google" and not email.is_empty():
		login_with_google(email, username)
	else:
		sync_with_supabase()

func _load_or_create_device_id() -> void:
	if FileAccess.file_exists(DEVICE_ID_PATH):
		var f := FileAccess.open(DEVICE_ID_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
		if f:
			device_id = f.get_as_text().strip_edges()
			f.close()
			
	if device_id.is_empty():
		var unique := OS.get_unique_id()
		if unique.is_empty():
			unique = "dev_" + str(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) + "_" + str(randi() % 100000)
		device_id = unique
		var f := FileAccess.open(DEVICE_ID_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
		if f:
			f.store_string(device_id)
			f.close()

func _load_local_profile() -> void:
	if FileAccess.file_exists(PROFILE_CACHE_PATH):
		var f := FileAccess.open(PROFILE_CACHE_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
		if f:
			var txt := f.get_as_text()
			f.close()
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
			if parsed is Dictionary:
				_apply_profile_dict(parsed)

func get_name_from_email(e: String) -> String:
	var prefix := e.split("@")[0].strip_edges()
	var letters := ""
	for i in range(prefix.length()):
		var ch := prefix[i]
		if not ch.is_valid_int():
			letters += ch
	if letters.length() >= 3:
		return letters.capitalize()
	return prefix.capitalize()

func _apply_profile_dict(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if data.has("id"): player_id = str(data["id"])
	if data.has("player_tag"): player_tag = str(data["player_tag"])
	
	if data.has("email") and data["email"] != null and typeof(data["email"]) == TYPE_STRING:
		var raw_e: String = str(data["email"]).strip_edges()
		if raw_e != "<null>" and raw_e != "null" and not raw_e.is_empty():
			email = raw_e
		else:
			email = ""
	else:
		email = ""
		
	if data.has("username"):
		var raw_u: String = str(data["username"]).strip_edges()
		if (raw_u.is_empty() or raw_u.to_lower() == "player") and not email.is_empty():
			username = get_name_from_email(email)
		elif not raw_u.is_empty():
			username = raw_u
		else:
			username = "Player"
			
	if data.has("avatar_url"):
		var av: String = str(data["avatar_url"])
		if av.begins_with("av_"):
			avatar_index = av.trim_prefix("av_").to_int()
		else:
			avatar_index = 1
	else:
		avatar_index = 1
		
	if avatar_index < 1 or avatar_index > 5:
		avatar_index = 1
		
	if data.has("auth_provider"):
		var server_provider := str(data["auth_provider"])
		# Agar lokal holatda mehmonga chiqilgan bo'lsa, serverdagi eski Google ma'lumoti uni bosib ketmasligi kerak
		if auth_provider == "guest" and email.is_empty() and server_provider == "google":
			pass
		else:
			auth_provider = server_provider
	
	if data.has("has_chosen_auth"):
		has_chosen_auth = bool(data["has_chosen_auth"])
	elif auth_provider == "google" and not email.is_empty():
		has_chosen_auth = true
	elif not player_id.is_empty() and username != "Player":
		has_chosen_auth = true

	# Bulutdan kelgan yutuqlarni lokal saqlash tizimi bilan birlashtirish
	if data.has("save_data") and data["save_data"] is Dictionary:
		var save_sys = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
		if save_sys and save_sys.has_method("merge_cloud_save"):
			save_sys.merge_cloud_save(data["save_data"])
	
	_update_corner_id_text()
	profile_loaded.emit(get_profile_dict())

func get_profile_dict() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"id": player_id,
		"player_tag": player_tag,
		"username": username,
		"email": email,
		"avatar_index": avatar_index,
		"avatar_url": "av_" + str(avatar_index),
		"auth_provider": auth_provider,
		"device_id": device_id,
		"has_chosen_auth": has_chosen_auth
	}

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Supabase Guest Sync
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func sync_with_supabase() -> void:
	if not http_guest:
		return
	if http_guest.get_http_client_status() != HTTPClient.STATUS_DISCONNECTED:
		http_guest.cancel_request()
		
	var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/rpc/register_or_login_guest"
	var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key,
		"Content-Type: application/json"
	]
	var payload := JSON.stringify({
		"p_device_id": device_id,
		"p_username": username,
		"p_avatar_url": "av_" + str(avatar_index)
	})
	http_guest.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func _on_guest_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	if response_code == 200:
		var txt := body.get_string_from_utf8()
		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
		if parsed is Dictionary and parsed.has("id"):
			_apply_profile_dict(parsed)
			_save_local_cache(get_profile_dict())
			is_ready_online = true
			print("ProfileManager: Mehmon sifatida ulandi: ", username, " (", player_tag, ")")
			profile_updated.emit(get_profile_dict())
			sync_save_to_cloud()
	else:
		print("ProfileManager: Mehmon oflayn rejimda (HTTP %d)" % response_code)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Supabase Google Login / Link
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func login_with_google(google_email: String, display_name: String = "") -> void:
	if not http_google:
		return
	var clean_email := google_email.strip_edges().to_lower()
	if clean_email.is_empty() or clean_email == "<null>" or clean_email == "null" or not clean_email.contains("@"):
		print("ProfileManager: Noto'g'ri email bilan Google kirish bekor qilindi: ", clean_email)
		return
		
	var clean_name := display_name.strip_edges()
	if clean_name.is_empty() or clean_name.to_lower() == "player":
		clean_name = get_name_from_email(clean_email)
		
	username = clean_name
	email = clean_email
	auth_provider = "google"
	has_chosen_auth = true
	_save_local_cache(get_profile_dict())
	profile_updated.emit(get_profile_dict())
	
	add_known_google_account(clean_email, clean_name)
	
	print("ProfileManager: Google orqali kirish so'rovi yuborilmoqda: ", clean_email, " (", clean_name, ")")
	
	var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/rpc/login_or_link_google"
	var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key,
		"Content-Type: application/json"
	]
	var payload := JSON.stringify({
		"p_device_id": device_id,
		"p_email": clean_email,
		"p_username": clean_name,
		"p_avatar_url": "av_" + str(avatar_index)
	})
	http_google.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func _on_google_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	var txt := body.get_string_from_utf8()
	print("ProfileManager: Google javob keldi (HTTP %d)" % response_code)
	if response_code == 200:
		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
		if parsed is Dictionary and parsed.has("id"):
			has_chosen_auth = true
			_apply_profile_dict(parsed)
			_save_local_cache(get_profile_dict())
			is_ready_online = true
			print("ProfileManager: Google hisobi muvaffaqiyatli ulandi! Name: ", username, " Email: ", email, " Tag: ", player_tag)
			
			# Bulutli saqlash sinxronlash
			if parsed.has("save_data") and parsed["save_data"] is Dictionary:
				var save_sys = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
				if save_sys and save_sys.has_method("merge_cloud_save"):
					save_sys.merge_cloud_save(parsed["save_data"])
			sync_save_to_cloud()
			
			profile_updated.emit(get_profile_dict())
			google_login_finished.emit(true, "")
			return
			
	print("ProfileManager: Google xatolik: ", txt)
	google_login_finished.emit(false, "Serverga ulanishda xatolik (HTTP %d)" % response_code)

func logout_to_guest() -> void:
	auth_provider = "guest"
	email = ""
	username = "Player"
	avatar_index = 1
	has_chosen_auth = false
	
	# Yangi toza mehmon sessiyasi yaratish (Google hisobi bilan aralashib ketmasligi uchun)
	device_id = "dev_" + str(Time.get_unix_time_from_system()) + "_" + str(randi() % 100000)
	var f := FileAccess.open(DEVICE_ID_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if f:
		f.store_string(device_id)
		f.close()
		
	player_id = ""
	player_tag = "WW-" + str(randi_range(1000, 9999))
	_save_local_cache(get_profile_dict())
	_update_corner_id_text()
	profile_updated.emit(get_profile_dict())
	sync_with_supabase()

func save_profile() -> void:
	_save_local_cache(get_profile_dict())
	profile_updated.emit(get_profile_dict())

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Bulutli Yutuqlar Sinxronizatsiyasi (Cloud Save)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func sync_save_to_cloud() -> void:
	if not is_ready_online or player_id.is_empty():
		return
	if not http_cloud:
		return
	if http_cloud.get_http_client_status() != HTTPClient.STATUS_DISCONNECTED:
		return
		
	var save_sys = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if not save_sys or not save_sys.has_method("get_save_payload"):
		return
		
	var payload_dict: Dictionary = save_sys.get_save_payload()
	var total_stars: int = save_sys.get_total_stars()
	var highest_lvl: int = save_sys.get_highest_unlocked_level()
	
	var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/rpc/sync_cloud_save"
	var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key,
		"Content-Type: application/json"
	]
	var body := JSON.stringify({
		"p_player_id": player_id,
		"p_save_data": payload_dict,
		"p_total_stars": total_stars,
		"p_highest_level": highest_lvl
	})
	http_cloud.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, body)

func _on_cloud_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, _body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	if response_code in [200, 204]:
		print("ProfileManager: Yutuqlar bulutga muvaffaqiyatli saqlandi!")

func get_known_google_accounts() -> Array:
	var accounts: Array = []
	if FileAccess.file_exists(GOOGLE_ACCOUNTS_PATH):
		var f := FileAccess.open(GOOGLE_ACCOUNTS_PATH, FileAccess.READ)
		if f:
			var txt := f.get_as_text()
			f.close()
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
			if parsed is Array:
				accounts = parsed

	# Joriy hisobni ro'yxatda aks ettirish (foydalanuvchi ma'lumotlari uchun)
	if not email.is_empty() and email.contains("@"):
		var found_saved := false
		for acc in accounts:
			if acc is Dictionary and acc.get("email", "").to_lower() == email.to_lower():
				found_saved = true
				break
		if not found_saved:
			accounts.append({
				"email": email,
				"name": username if not username.is_empty() else "Google Player",
				"avatar": "av_" + str(avatar_index)
			})
			
	return accounts

func add_known_google_account(acc_email: String, acc_name: String = "") -> void:
	if acc_email.is_empty():
		return
	var clean_email := acc_email.strip_edges().to_lower()
	var accounts := get_known_google_accounts()
	
	for i in range(accounts.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var item = accounts[i]
		if item is Dictionary and item.get("email", "").to_lower() == clean_email:
			accounts.remove_at(i)
			
	var display := acc_name if not acc_name.is_empty() else clean_email.split("@")[0].capitalize()
	accounts.insert(0, {
		"email": clean_email,
		"name": display,
		"avatar": "av_" + str(avatar_index)
	})
	
	if accounts.size() > 5:
		accounts.resize(5)
		
	var f := FileAccess.open(GOOGLE_ACCOUNTS_PATH, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if f:
		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(accounts))
		f.close()

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Profil tahrirlash (Ism va Avatar)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func update_profile(new_name: String, new_avatar_idx: int) -> void:
	username = new_name.strip_edges()
	avatar_index = new_avatar_idx
	var av_url := "av_" + str(avatar_index)
	
	var cur := get_profile_dict()
	_save_local_cache(cur)
	profile_updated.emit(cur)
	
	if is_ready_online and not player_id.is_empty():
		var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/rpc/update_player_profile"
		var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
		var headers := [
			"apikey: " + anon_key,
			"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key,
			"Content-Type: application/json"
		]
		var payload := JSON.stringify({
			"p_player_id": player_id,
			"p_username": username,
			"p_avatar_url": av_url
		})
		http_update.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func _on_update_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, _body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	if response_code in [200, 204]:
		print("ProfileManager: Profil Supabase'da yangilandi!")

func _write_json_atomic(path: String, text: String) -> void:
	var tmp := path + ".tmp"
	var f := FileAccess.open(tmp, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if not f:
		return
	f.store_string(text)
	f.close()

func add_recent_friend(tag: String, friend_name: String = "", av_url: String = "") -> void:
	var clean_tag := tag.strip_edges().to_upper()
	if clean_tag.is_empty() or clean_tag == player_tag:
		return
	for i in range(saved_friends.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var item = saved_friends[i]
		if item is Dictionary and item.get("player_tag", "") == clean_tag:
			saved_friends.remove_at(i)
	saved_friends.insert(0, {
		"player_tag": clean_tag,
		"username": friend_name if not friend_name.is_empty() else clean_tag,
		"avatar_url": av_url
	})
	if saved_friends.size() > 12:
		saved_friends.resize(12)
	save_friends_cache()

func get_saved_friends() -> Array:
	return saved_friends

func _write_config_atomic(config: ConfigFile) -> void:
	# Atomik saqlash: avval .tmp faylga yoziladi, so'ng eski fayl .bak'ga ko'chiriladi
	# va .tmp asosiy fayl ustiga rename qilinadi. Crash/disk to'lishida progress yo'qolmaydi.
	var tmp_path := SAVE_PATH + ".tmp"
	var bak_path := SAVE_PATH + ".bak"
	var err := config.save(tmp_path)
	if err != OK:
		push_error("SaveManager: saqlashda xatolik (kod %d): %s" % [err, tmp_path])
		return
	var abs_save := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(SAVE_PATH)
	var abs_tmp := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(tmp_path)
	var abs_bak := ProjectSettings.globalize_path(bak_path)
	if FileAccess.file_exists(SAVE_PATH):
		DirAccess.copy_absolute(abs_save, abs_bak)
	var ren_err := DirAccess.rename_absolute(abs_tmp, abs_save)
	if ren_err != OK:
		push_error("SaveManager: atomik o'zgartirishda xatolik (kod %d)" % ren_err)

func record_result(lvl: int, time_ms: float, deaths: int) -> int:
	var stars: int = 1
	if deaths == 0:
		stars = 3
	elif deaths <= 2:
		stars = 2
	else:
		stars = 1

	var str_lvl := str(lvl)
	var prev_stars: int = int(level_stars.get(str_lvl, 0))
	if stars > prev_stars:
		level_stars[str_lvl] = stars

	var prev_time: float = float(level_best_times.get(str_lvl, 999999999.0))
	if time_ms < prev_time:
		level_best_times[str_lvl] = time_ms

	var prev_deaths: int = int(level_best_deaths.get(str_lvl, 999999))
	if deaths < prev_deaths:
		level_best_deaths[str_lvl] = deaths

	if time_ms < overall_best_ms:
		overall_best_ms = time_ms
		overall_best_text = "%.2fs (%d-lvl)" % [time_ms / 1000.0, lvl]

	if stars >= 2:
		var next_lvl := lvl + 1
		if next_lvl <= 60 and not unlocked_levels.has(next_lvl):
			unlocked_levels.append(next_lvl)

	save_data()
	
	var pm = get_node_or_null("/root/ProfileManager")
	if pm and pm.has_method("sync_save_to_cloud"):
		pm.sync_save_to_cloud()
		
	return stars

		"level_best_times": level_best_times,
		"level_best_deaths": level_best_deaths,
		"overall_best_ms": overall_best_ms,
		"overall_best_text": overall_best_text,
		"ad_unlocked_levels": ad_unlocked_levels,
		"total_stars": get_total_stars(),
		"highest_level": get_highest_unlocked_level()
	}

func merge_cloud_save(cloud_data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if not cloud_data is Dictionary or cloud_data.is_empty():
		return
		
	var changed := false
	
	# 1. Unlocked levels
	if cloud_data.has("unlocked_levels"):
		var c_unlocked = cloud_data["unlocked_levels"]
		if c_unlocked is Array:
			for lvl in c_unlocked:
				var ilvl := int(lvl)
				if ilvl >= 1 and not unlocked_levels.has(ilvl):
					unlocked_levels.append(ilvl)
					changed = true
					
	# 2. Level stars
	if cloud_data.has("level_stars"):
		var c_stars = cloud_data["level_stars"]
		if c_stars is Dictionary:
			for k in c_stars.keys():
				var str_k := str(k)
				var c_s := int(c_stars[k])
				var l_s := int(level_stars.get(str_k, 0))
				if c_s > l_s:
					level_stars[str_k] = c_s
					changed = true
					
	# 3. Best times
	if cloud_data.has("level_best_times"):
		var c_times = cloud_data["level_best_times"]
		if c_times is Dictionary:
			for k in c_times.keys():
				var str_k := str(k)
				var c_t := float(c_times[k])
				var l_t := float(level_best_times.get(str_k, 999999999.0))
				if c_t < l_t:
					level_best_times[str_k] = c_t
					changed = true
					
	# 4. Overall best
	if cloud_data.has("overall_best_ms"):
		var c_ob := float(cloud_data["overall_best_ms"])
		if c_ob < overall_best_ms:
			overall_best_ms = c_ob
			if cloud_data.has("overall_best_text"):
				overall_best_text = str(cloud_data["overall_best_text"])
			changed = true
			
	if not unlocked_levels.has(1):
		unlocked_levels.push_front(1)
		
	if changed:
		save_data()
		print("SaveManager: Bulutli saqlangan o'yin muvaffaqiyatli sinxronlandi!")

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Yangilangan Reklama orqali Daraja Ochish Tizimi:
# 1. Faqat birinchi qulflangan darajagagina ruxsat (sakrab ketish taqiqlanadi).
# 2. Ochmoqchi bo'lgan darajadan oldingisini kamida bir marta o'ynagan bo'lishi shart (1-ni o'ynamay 2-ni ocholmaydi).
# 3. Bitta daraja oralab (cheriz) reklama ruxsat beriladi (masalan 2 dan o'tolmasa 3 ni reklama bilan ochadi, 4 da bu yo'q, 5 da bor va h.k.).
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func is_level_ad_unlockable(lvl: int) -> bool:
	if lvl <= 1 or lvl > 60:
		return false
	if is_level_unlocked(lvl):
		return false
		
	# 1. Faqat eng birinchi qulflangan daraja bo'lishi kerak
	var first_locked := -1
	for l in range(1, 61):
		if not is_level_unlocked(l):
			first_locked = l
			break
	if lvl != first_locked:
		return false
		
	# 2. Ochmoqchi bo'lgan darajadan oldingisini kamida bir marta o'ynagan bo'lishi shart
	if not attempted_levels.has(lvl - 1):
		return false
		
	# 3. Bitta daraja oralab (cheriz) reklama ruxsat beriladi
	if last_ad_unlocked_level > 0:
		if (lvl - last_ad_unlocked_level) < 2:
			return false
			
	return true

func get_lock_reason_dialog(lvl: int) -> Dictionary:
	var first_locked := -1
	for l in range(1, 61):
		if not is_level_unlocked(l):
			first_locked = l
			break
			
	if lvl != first_locked:
		return {
			"title": LocaleManager.t("lock_title"),
			"text": LocaleManager.t("lock_must_open_earlier")
		}
		
	if not attempted_levels.has(lvl - 1):
		return {
			"title": LocaleManager.t("lock_title"),
			"text": LocaleManager.t("lock_need_attempt", [lvl - 1])
		}
		
	if last_ad_unlocked_level > 0 and (lvl - last_ad_unlocked_level) < 2:
		var next_allowed := last_ad_unlocked_level + 2
		return {
			"title": LocaleManager.t("lock_title"),
			"text": LocaleManager.t("lock_cooldown", [last_ad_unlocked_level, next_allowed])
		}
		
	return {
		"title": LocaleManager.t("lock_title"),
		"text": LocaleManager.t("lock_need_stars", [lvl - 1])
	}

func get_level_best_time_sec(lvl: int) -> int:
	var str_lvl := str(lvl)
	if level_best_times.has(str_lvl):
		var t_ms: float = float(level_best_times[str_lvl])
		if t_ms < 999999000.0:
			# Faqat butun sekundlar (millisekundsiz)
			return maxi(1, int(round(t_ms / 1000.0)))
	return -1

func get_total_beaten_time_sec() -> int:

var players: Dictionary = {}
var music_player: AudioStreamPlayer = null
var is_gameplay_mode: bool = false
var music_vol_tween: Tween = null

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	_create_procedural_sounds()
	_setup_music_player()
	# GameManager autoload tartibda keyinroq yuklanadi, shuning uchun deferred ulaymiz.
	_connect_gameplay_mode.call_deferred()

func _connect_gameplay_mode() -> void:
	var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
	if gm:
		gm.level_started.connect(func(_lvl): set_gameplay_mode(true))

func _get_target_music_db() -> float:
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm and not sm.music_enabled:
		return -80.0
	var vol_linear: float = sm.music_volume if sm else 0.8
	if vol_linear <= 0.01:
		return -80.0
	var base_db: float = linear_to_db(vol_linear)
	if is_gameplay_mode:
		base_db -= 8.0 # O'yin va pauzada yumshoq fon ovozi
	return clampf(base_db, -80.0, 6.0)

func set_gameplay_mode(in_gameplay: bool) -> void:
	is_gameplay_mode = in_gameplay
	update_music_volume(true)

func update_music_volume(animate: bool = false) -> void:
	if not music_player: return
	var target_db := _get_target_music_db()
	if music_vol_tween and music_vol_tween.is_valid():
		music_vol_tween.kill()
		
	if animate and music_player.playing:
		music_vol_tween = create_tween()
		music_vol_tween.tween_property(music_player, "volume_db", target_db, 0.5)\
			.set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	else:
		music_player.volume_db = target_db

func update_sfx_volume() -> void:
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	var vol_linear: float = sm.sfx_volume if sm else 1.0
	var target_db: float = -80.0 if vol_linear <= 0.01 else linear_to_db(vol_linear)
	for p in players.values():
		if p is AudioStreamPlayer:
			p.volume_db = target_db

func _setup_music_player() -> void:
	music_player = AudioStreamPlayer.new()
	music_player.name = "MusicPlayer"
	music_player.bus = "Master"
	music_player.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	music_player.volume_db = _get_target_music_db()
	add_child(music_player)
	
	music_player.finished.connect(func():
		var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
		if sm == null or sm.music_enabled:
			music_player.play()
	)
	
	_load_bgm()
	
	# Start music if enabled
	call_deferred("_check_initial_music")

func _check_initial_music() -> void:
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm == null or sm.music_enabled:
		play_music()

func _load_bgm() -> void:
	var path := "res://assets/audio/bgm_ambient.wav"
	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
		var stream = load(path)
		if stream is AudioStreamWAV:
			var bytes_per_frame: int = 4 if stream.stereo else 2
			var total_frames: int = stream.data.size() / bytes_per_frame
			stream.loop_mode = AudioStreamWAV.LOOP_FORWARD
			stream.loop_begin = 0
			stream.loop_end = total_frames
		music_player.stream = stream

func play_music() -> void:
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm and not sm.music_enabled:
		return
	if music_player:
		if music_player.stream == null:
			_load_bgm()
		if music_player.stream and not music_player.playing:
			music_player.volume_db = _get_target_music_db()
			music_player.play()

func stop_music() -> void:
	if music_player:
		music_player.stop()

func set_music_enabled(enabled: bool) -> void:
	if enabled:
		play_music()
	else:
		stop_music()

func _create_procedural_sounds() -> void:

func _generate_tone(f_start: float, f_end: float, duration: float, type: String, gain: float) -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var samples_count := int(rate * duration)
	var data := PackedByteArray()
	data.resize(samples_count * 2) # 16-bit (har bir sample 2 bayt)
	
	var phase := 0.0
	for i in range(samples_count):
		var t := float(i) / rate
		var prog := t / duration
		var freq: float = lerp(f_start, f_end, prog)
		phase += 2.0 * PI * freq / rate
		
		var raw_sample := 0.0
		match type:
			"sine":
				raw_sample = sin(phase)
			"square":
				raw_sample = 1.0 if sin(phase) >= 0.0 else -1.0
			"sawtooth":
				raw_sample = 2.0 * (phase / (2.0 * PI) - floor(phase / (2.0 * PI) + 0.5))
			"triangle":
				raw_sample = 2.0 * abs(2.0 * (phase / (2.0 * PI) - floor(phase / (2.0 * PI) + 0.5))) - 1.0
				
		var env := (1.0 - prog) * gain
		var sample_val := clampi(int(raw_sample * env * 32767.0), -32768, 32767)
		
		# Little-endian 16-bit
		data[i * 2] = sample_val & 0xFF
		data[i * 2 + 1] = (sample_val >> 8) & 0xFF
		
	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	wav.mix_rate = rate
	wav.data = data
	return wav

func _generate_win_chord() -> AudioStreamWAV:
	var rate := 22050
	var duration := 0.6
	var samples_count := int(rate * duration)
	var data := PackedByteArray()
	data.resize(samples_count * 2)
	
	var freqs: Array[float] = [523.25, 659.25, 783.99, 1046.5]
	var phases: Array[float] = [0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0]
	
	for i in range(samples_count):
		var t := float(i) / rate
		var total_sample := 0.0
		for j in range(freqs.size()):
			var note_t: float = t - (float(j) * 0.08)
			if note_t >= 0.0 and note_t <= 0.2:
				phases[j] += 2.0 * PI * freqs[j] / rate
				var env := (1.0 - (note_t / 0.2)) * 0.12
				total_sample += sin(phases[j]) * env
				
		var sample_val := clampi(int(total_sample * 32767.0), -32768, 32767)
		data[i * 2] = sample_val & 0xFF
		data[i * 2 + 1] = (sample_val >> 8) & 0xFF
		
	var wav := AudioStreamWAV.new()
	wav.format = AudioStreamWAV.FORMAT_16_BITS
	wav.mix_rate = rate
	wav.data = data
	return wav

extends RefCounted
class_name UIResponsive

## UIResponsive: Universal Adaptive & Responsive UI Engine for Godot 4
## Handles fluid screen scaling, notch/camera cutout safe areas, and dynamic layout positioning
## across all mobile (16:9, 18:9, 19.5:9, 20:9, 21:9), tablet (4:3, 16:10), foldable, and desktop screens.

## Returns safe area insets (left, right, top, bottom) in canvas coordinates.
static func get_safe_insets(caller: Control = null) -> Dictionary:
	var safe := DisplayServer.get_display_safe_area()
	var win_size := DisplayServer.window_get_size()
	
	if win_size.x <= 0 or win_size.y <= 0:
		return {"left": 0.0, "right": 0.0, "top": 0.0, "bottom": 0.0}
	
	var vp_size := Vector2(960.0, 540.0)
	if caller and caller.is_inside_tree():
		vp_size = caller.get_viewport_rect().size
	elif Engine.get_main_loop() and Engine.get_main_loop().root:
		vp_size = Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
		
	var scale_x := vp_size.x / float(win_size.x)
	var scale_y := vp_size.y / float(win_size.y)
	
	var inset_l := float(safe.position.x) * scale_x
	var inset_t := float(safe.position.y) * scale_y
	var inset_r := float(win_size.x - (safe.position.x + safe.size.x)) * scale_x
	var inset_b := float(win_size.y - (safe.position.y + safe.size.y)) * scale_y
	
	return {
		"left": maxf(0.0, inset_l),
		"right": maxf(0.0, inset_r),
		"top": maxf(0.0, inset_t),
		"bottom": maxf(0.0, inset_b)
	}

## Returns the true visible viewport size in canvas units.
static func get_viewport_size(caller: Control = null) -> Vector2:
	if caller and caller.is_inside_tree():
		return caller.get_viewport_rect().size
	elif Engine.get_main_loop() and Engine.get_main_loop().root:
		return Engine.get_main_loop().root.get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	return Vector2(960.0, 540.0)

## Computes responsive, ergonomic touch button layout across any aspect ratio and resolution.
static func get_default_touch_positions(caller: Control = null) -> Dictionary:
	var vp := get_viewport_size(caller)
	var insets := get_safe_insets(caller)
	
	var margin_l: float = 24.0 + insets["left"]
	var margin_r: float = 24.0 + insets["right"]
	var margin_b: float = 20.0 + insets["bottom"]
	
	var btn_w: float = 64.0
	var btn_h: float = 64.0
	var jump_w: float = 68.0
	var jump_h: float = 68.0
	var gap: float = 16.0
	
	var base_y := vp.y - margin_b - btn_h
	var jump_y := vp.y - margin_b - jump_h
	
	var pos_left := Vector2(margin_l, base_y)
	var pos_right := Vector2(margin_l + btn_w + gap, base_y)
	var pos_jump := Vector2(vp.x - margin_r - jump_w, jump_y)
	var pos_dash := Vector2(pos_jump.x - gap - btn_w, base_y)
	
	return {
		"left": pos_left,
		"right": pos_right,
		"dash": pos_dash,
		"jump": pos_jump
	}

extends CharacterBody2D
class_name PlayerController

signal died
signal respawned
signal entered_exit

const SPEED: float = 320.0
const DASH_SPEED: float = 660.0
const DASH_DURATION: float = 0.16
const DASH_COOLDOWN: float = 0.40
const JUMP_VELOCITY: float = -560.0
const GRAVITY: float = 1450.0
const MAX_SHORT_JUMP_FALL: float = -280.0

var coyote_timer: float = 0.0
var jump_buffer: float = 0.0
var facing: int = 1
var is_dead: bool = false
var is_entering_door: bool = false
var spawn_position: Vector2
var controls_inverted: bool = false
var is_invulnerable: bool = false
var invulnerable_timer: float = 0.0

# Genshin Impact uslubidagi bir martalik Dash (Shift) holati
var is_dashing: bool = false
var dash_timer: float = 0.0
var dash_cooldown_timer: float = 0.0
var dash_dir: float = 1.0
var ghost_trail_timer: float = 0.0

@onready var visual: Node2D = $Visual
@onready var collision_shape: CollisionShape2D = $CollisionShape2D

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("player")
	spawn_position = global_position
	if not InputMap.has_action("dash"):
		InputMap.add_action("dash")
		var ev := InputEventKey.new()
		ev.keycode = KEY_SHIFT
		InputMap.action_add_event("dash", ev)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_dead or is_entering_door or GameManager.is_countdown_active:
		velocity = Vector2.ZERO
		return

	if invulnerable_timer > 0.0:
		invulnerable_timer -= delta
		if invulnerable_timer <= 0.0:
			is_invulnerable = false

	# Dash taymerlari va sharpali qoldiq (ghost afterimage)
	if dash_cooldown_timer > 0.0:
		dash_cooldown_timer -= delta

	if is_dashing:
		dash_timer -= delta
		ghost_trail_timer -= delta
		if ghost_trail_timer <= 0.0:
			ghost_trail_timer = 0.038
			_spawn_dash_ghost()
		if dash_timer <= 0.0:
			is_dashing = false

	# Coyote Time & Jump Buffer
	if is_on_floor():
		coyote_timer = 0.16
	else:
		coyote_timer -= delta

	if jump_buffer > 0.0:
		jump_buffer -= delta

	# Gorizontal harakat
	var move_dir := Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if controls_inverted:
		move_dir = -move_dir

	# Dash faollashtirish (Faqat bir marta bosilganda - Genshin Impact uslubida)
	# QAT'IY QOIDA: is_action_just_pressed ishlatiladi, shuning uchun Shift bosib turilsa tez yururmaydi!
	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("dash") and not is_dashing and dash_cooldown_timer <= 0.0:
		var target_dir := move_dir
		if target_dir == 0.0:
			target_dir = float(facing)
		dash_dir = target_dir
		is_dashing = true
		dash_timer = DASH_DURATION
		dash_cooldown_timer = DASH_COOLDOWN
		ghost_trail_timer = 0.0
		_spawn_dash_ghost()
		if visual:
			visual.scale = Vector2(1.38, 0.72)
		if is_inside_tree():
			var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
			if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
				sm.play("dash")

	if is_dashing:
		velocity.x = dash_dir * DASH_SPEED
	elif move_dir != 0:
		facing = signi(int(move_dir))
		velocity.x = move_dir * SPEED
	else:
		velocity.x = 0.0

	if Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump"):
		jump_buffer = 0.16

	# Sakrash
	if jump_buffer > 0.0 and coyote_timer > 0.0:
		velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
		coyote_timer = 0.0
		jump_buffer = 0.0
		if visual:
			visual.scale = Vector2(0.75, 1.35)
		if is_inside_tree():
			var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
			if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
				sm.play("jump")

	# Sakrash tugmasi erta qo'yib yuborilganda pastga tortish
	if Input.is_action_just_released("jump") and velocity.y < MAX_SHORT_JUMP_FALL:
		velocity.y = MAX_SHORT_JUMP_FALL

	# Gravitatsiya va shaklni asl holatiga qaytarish (lerp)
	velocity.y += GRAVITY * delta
	# Terminal velocity (yorib o'tishni oldini olish)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y, 1200.0)

	if visual:
		visual.scale = visual.scale.lerp(Vector2.ONE, delta * 10.0)

	move_and_slide()
	if visual:
		visual.queue_redraw()

	# O'lim tekisligi config'dan o'qiladi yoki dinamik hisoblanadi
	var death_y: float = 750.0
	var trap_cfg = get_node_or_null("/root/TrapConfig")
	if trap_cfg and "death_plane_y" in trap_cfg:
		death_y = float(trap_cfg.death_plane_y)
	else:
		death_y = maxf(get_viewport_rect().size.y, 540.0) + 210.0

	if global_position.y > death_y:
		kill()

func kill() -> void:
	if is_dead or is_entering_door or is_invulnerable:
		return
	is_dead = true
	is_dashing = false
	dash_timer = 0.0
	dash_cooldown_timer = 0.0
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	if is_inside_tree():
		var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
		if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
			sm.play("die")
		var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
		if gm and gm.has_method("record_death"):
			gm.record_death()
	died.emit()
	
	visible = false
	if collision_shape:
		collision_shape.set_deferred("disabled", true)
	_spawn_particles()
	
	# O'lik gavdani xaritadagi tuzoqlar zonasidan chetga olamiz
	global_position = Vector2(-9999, -9999)
	
	# Original: setTimeout(() => resetPlayer(), 340)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.34).timeout
	if is_instance_valid(self):
		respawn()

func die() -> void:
	kill()

func respawn(at_position: Vector2 = spawn_position) -> void:
	global_position = at_position
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	is_dead = false
	is_dashing = false
	dash_timer = 0.0
	dash_cooldown_timer = 0.0
	is_entering_door = false
	controls_inverted = false
	is_invulnerable = true
	invulnerable_timer = 0.22 # 220ms spawn protection (takroriy o'limni oldini oladi)
	coyote_timer = 0.0
	jump_buffer = 0.0
	visible = true
	if collision_shape:
		collision_shape.set_deferred("disabled", false)
	if visual:
		visual.scale = Vector2.ONE
	respawned.emit()

func enter_door(target_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	if is_entering_door or is_dead:
		return
	is_entering_door = true
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	entered_exit.emit()
	
	# Original animatsiya: o'lcham 0 ga qarab kichrayib markazga tortiladi
	var tween := create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	tween.tween_property(self, "global_position", target_pos, 0.18)
	if visual:
		tween.tween_property(visual, "scale", Vector2.ZERO, 0.18)
	await tween.finished
	visible = false

func enter_finish(target_pos: Vector2) -> void:
	enter_door(target_pos)

func _spawn_particles() -> void:
	var p_scene: PackedScene = load("res://scenes/player/death_particles.tscn")
	if p_scene:
		var p: CPUParticles2D = p_scene.instantiate()
		p.global_position = global_position - Vector2(0, 16)
		get_parent().add_child(p)

func _spawn_dash_ghost() -> void:
	if not is_inside_tree() or not get_parent():
		return
	var ghost := Node2D.new()
	ghost.global_position = global_position
	if visual:
		ghost.scale = visual.scale
	ghost.set_script(load("res://scripts/player/dash_ghost.gd"))
	get_parent().add_child(ghost)

	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	var dir := 1.0 if clockwise else -1.0
	current_angle += orbit_speed * dir * delta
	spin_angle += 16.0 * dir * delta
	
	_update_blade_position()
	if col_shape:
		col_shape.position = blade_offset
	queue_redraw()

func _update_blade_position() -> void:
	if orbit_radius > 0.0:
		blade_offset = Vector2(cos(current_angle), sin(current_angle)) * orbit_radius
	else:
		blade_offset = Vector2.ZERO

func _draw() -> void:
	if orbit_radius > 0.0:
		# 1. Markaziy o'q (32px to'r markazi)
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 6.0, Color("#1e1b29"))
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 3.5, Color("#475569"))
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 1.5, Color("#cbd5e1"))
		
		# 2. Bog'lovchi metall zanjir
		var chain_links := maxi(2, int(orbit_radius / 16.0))
		for i in range(1, chain_links):
			var t := float(i) / float(chain_links)
			var link_pos := blade_offset * t
			draw_circle(link_pos, 3.5, Color("#334155"))
			draw_circle(link_pos, 1.5, Color("#64748b"))
		draw_line(Vector2.ZERO, blade_offset, Color("#1e293b"), 2.5)
	
	# 3. 32px diametrli arra diski
	_draw_saw_blade(blade_offset, saw_radius, spin_angle)

func _draw_saw_blade(pos: Vector2, r: float, spin: float) -> void:
	var is_winter := false
	var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
	if gm and gm.has_method("is_winter_theme"):
		is_winter = gm.is_winter_theme()

	var teeth_count := 8
	var inner_r := r * 0.70
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var step := (PI * 2.0) / float(teeth_count)
	
	for i in range(teeth_count):
		var a0 := spin + float(i) * step
		var a1 := a0 + step * 0.45
		var a2 := a0 + step * 0.80
		
		pts.append(pos + Vector2(cos(a0), sin(a0)) * inner_r)
		pts.append(pos + Vector2(cos(a1), sin(a1)) * r)
		pts.append(pos + Vector2(cos(a2), sin(a2)) * inner_r)
		
	if is_winter:
		# Muzli arra tishlari
		draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.95))
		draw_polyline(pts, Color("#ffffff"), 1.2)
		draw_circle(pos, inner_r * 0.85, Color("#0f172a"))
		draw_circle(pos, inner_r * 0.65, Color("#0284c7"))
		draw_circle(pos, 4.0, Color("#1e293b"))
		draw_circle(pos, 2.0, Color("#e0f2fe"))
	else:
		draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color("#94a3b8"))
		draw_polyline(pts, Color("#f1f5f9"), 1.0)
		draw_circle(pos, inner_r * 0.85, Color("#475569"))
		draw_circle(pos, inner_r * 0.65, Color("#dc2626"))
		draw_circle(pos, 4.0, Color("#0f172a"))
		draw_circle(pos, 2.0, Color("#e2e8f0"))

func _on_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if body is PlayerController or body.is_in_group("player"):
		if "is_dead" in body and body.is_dead:
			return
		if "is_invulnerable" in body and body.is_invulnerable:
			return
		if body.has_method("kill"):
			body.kill()

func reset_trap() -> void:
	current_angle = deg_to_rad(start_angle_deg)
	_update_blade_position()
	if col_shape:
		col_shape.position = blade_offset

extends AnimatableBody2D
class_name CrashingPillar

# Wrong Way - Unexpected Event: Crashing Ceiling Pillar (Shift qoyasining qulashi)
# Suspended invisibly/silently at the ceiling.
# As the player approaches, it suddenly breaks off and SLAMS into the ground!

@export var pillar_size: Vector2 = Vector2(50, 200)
@export var trigger_distance: float = 160.0
@export var crash_speed: float = 1200.0

var is_triggered: bool = false
var is_grounded: bool = false
var original_pos: Vector2
var crash_velocity: float = 0.0

@onready var col_shape: CollisionShape2D = $CollisionShape2D
@onready var kill_area: Area2D = $KillArea

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("traps")
	original_pos = position
	_update_shapes()
	
	if kill_area:
		kill_area.body_entered.connect(_on_kill_entered)

func _update_shapes() -> void:
	if col_shape:
		var rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
		rect.size = pillar_size
		col_shape.shape = rect
		col_shape.position = pillar_size / 2.0
		
	if kill_area:
		var k_shape = kill_area.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D")
		if k_shape:
			var k_rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
			# Ustun pastki zarba qismi
			k_rect.size = Vector2(pillar_size.x - 4.0, 16.0)
			k_shape.shape = k_rect
			k_shape.position = Vector2(pillar_size.x / 2.0, pillar_size.y - 8.0)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_triggered:
		_check_trigger()
		return
		
	if not is_grounded:
		crash_velocity += 2400.0 * delta
		position.y += crash_velocity * delta
		
		# Polga urilish (yerni topsin)
		# Qattiq 190.0 o'rniga parametr orqali
		var drop_dist = 190.0
		if "drop_distance" in self:
			drop_dist = float(self.get("drop_distance"))
		elif "platform_size" in self:
			drop_dist = float(self.get("platform_size").y)
		else:
			drop_dist = maxf(190.0, 500.0 - original_pos.y)

		if position.y >= original_pos.y + drop_dist:
			position.y = original_pos.y + drop_dist
			is_grounded = true
			crash_velocity = 0.0
			SoundManager.play("trap")
			GameManager.request_screen_shake.emit(14.0)
			if kill_area:
				kill_area.set_deferred("monitoring", false)
			queue_redraw()

func _check_trigger() -> void:
	var player = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player")
	if not player:
		return
	var px = player.global_position.x
	var my_x = global_position.x + pillar_size.x / 2.0
	
	if absf(px - my_x) <= trigger_distance:
		trigger_crash()

func trigger_crash() -> void:
	if is_triggered:
		return
	is_triggered = true
	SoundManager.play("click")
	GameManager.request_screen_shake.emit(4.0)
	
	# Qisqa tebranish (ogohlantiruvchi yorilish)
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x - 3.0, 0.05)
	tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x + 3.0, 0.05)
	tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x, 0.04)

func _on_kill_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if not is_grounded and (body is PlayerController or body.is_in_group("player")):
		if body.has_method("kill"):
			body.kill()
		elif body.has_method("die"):
			body.die()

func reset_trap() -> void:
	is_triggered = false
	is_grounded = false
	crash_velocity = 0.0
	position = original_pos
	if kill_area:
		kill_area.set_deferred("monitoring", true)
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	var rect := Rect2(0, 0, pillar_size.x, pillar_size.y)
	# Asosiy quyuq tosh ustun
	draw_rect(rect, Color(0.07, 0.09, 0.14, 1.0))
	# Yon hoshiyalar
	draw_line(Vector2(0, 0), Vector2(0, pillar_size.y), Color(0.24, 0.32, 0.44, 0.8), 1.5)
	draw_line(Vector2(pillar_size.x, 0), Vector2(pillar_size.x, pillar_size.y), Color(0.24, 0.32, 0.44, 0.8), 1.5)
	
	# Tosh g'ishtlar relyefi
	for y in range(25, int(pillar_size.y), 35):
		draw_line(Vector2(0, y), Vector2(pillar_size.x, y), Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.08, 0.9), 1.2)
	
	# Pastki o'tkir tishli qoya qirrasi
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(0, pillar_size.y),
		Vector2(12, pillar_size.y + 8),
		Vector2(25, pillar_size.y + 4),
		Vector2(38, pillar_size.y + 9),
		Vector2(pillar_size.x, pillar_size.y)
	])
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(0.07, 0.09, 0.14, 1.0))
	draw_polyline(pts, Color(0.35, 0.45, 0.60, 0.85), 1.5)

extends StaticBody2D
class_name CrumblingPlatform

# Wrong Way - Unexpected Event: Crumbling Platform / Collapsing Floor
# Looks identical to a solid platform, but when stepped on:
# Trembles and cracks for 0.25s, then collapses into the abyss!

@export var platform_size: Vector2 = Vector2(140, 28)
@export var collapse_delay: float = 0.28 # Kutilmagan qulash kechikishi
@export var fall_speed: float = 900.0

var is_triggered: bool = false
var is_falling: bool = false
var original_pos: Vector2
var fall_velocity: float = 0.0
var crack_progress: float = 0.0
var shake_tw: Tween
var crack_tw: Tween

@onready var col_shape: CollisionShape2D = $CollisionShape2D
@onready var step_area: Area2D = $StepArea

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("traps")
	original_pos = position
	_update_shapes()
	
	if step_area:
		step_area.body_entered.connect(_on_step_entered)

func _update_shapes() -> void:
	if col_shape:
		var rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
		rect.size = platform_size
		col_shape.shape = rect
		col_shape.position = platform_size / 2.0
		
	if step_area:
		var s_shape = step_area.get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D")
		if s_shape:
			var s_rect := RectangleShape2D.new()
			# Tepasiga tushganda sezish
			s_rect.size = Vector2(platform_size.x - 4.0, 10.0)
			s_shape.shape = s_rect
			s_shape.position = Vector2(platform_size.x / 2.0, -4.0)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_falling:
		fall_velocity += 1600.0 * delta
		position.y += fall_velocity * delta
		queue_redraw()
		if position.y > original_pos.y + 600.0:
			set_physics_process(false)
			if col_shape:
				col_shape.set_deferred("disabled", true)

func _on_step_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if is_triggered:
		return
	if body is PlayerController or body.is_in_group("player"):
		if "is_dead" in body and body.is_dead:
			return
		if "is_invulnerable" in body and body.is_invulnerable:
			return
		trigger_crumble()

func trigger_crumble() -> void:
	is_triggered = true
	SoundManager.play("trap")
	GameManager.request_screen_shake.emit(4.0)
	
	# Platforma qaltiraydi va yoriladi
	if shake_tw and shake_tw.is_valid(): shake_tw.kill()
	shake_tw = create_tween().set_loops()
	for i in range(4):
		shake_tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x + 3.0, collapse_delay / 8.0)
		shake_tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x - 3.0, collapse_delay / 8.0)
		shake_tw.tween_property(self, "position:x", original_pos.x, collapse_delay / 8.0)
	
	# Yoriqlar chuqurlashadi
	if crack_tw and crack_tw.is_valid(): crack_tw.kill()
	crack_tw = create_tween()
	crack_tw.tween_property(self, "crack_progress", 1.0, collapse_delay)
	
	crack_tw.finished.connect(func():
		if is_instance_valid(self) and is_triggered:
			is_falling = true
			if shake_tw and shake_tw.is_valid(): shake_tw.kill()
			position = original_pos
			GameManager.request_screen_shake.emit(6.0)
	)

func reset_trap() -> void:
	if shake_tw and shake_tw.is_valid(): shake_tw.kill()
	if crack_tw and crack_tw.is_valid(): crack_tw.kill()
	is_triggered = false
	is_falling = false
	fall_velocity = 0.0
	crack_progress = 0.0
	position = original_pos
	set_physics_process(true)
	if col_shape:
		col_shape.set_deferred("disabled", false)
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	var rect := Rect2(0, 0, platform_size.x, platform_size.y)
	var is_winter := false
	var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
	if gm and gm.has_method("is_winter_theme"):
		is_winter = gm.is_winter_theme()

	var base_col := Color("#0d131f") if is_winter else Color("#1c1a22")
	draw_rect(rect, base_col, true)

	if is_winter:
		var snow_h := 5.5
		if platform_size.x > 36.0:
			draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(platform_size.x, snow_h)), Color("#f1f5f9"), true)
			draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(platform_size.x, 2.0)), Color("#ffffff"), true)
			draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2(0, snow_h - 1.5), Vector2(platform_size.x, 1.5)), Color("#94a3b8"), true)
			var icicle_step := 32.0
			var num_icicles := int((platform_size.x - 20.0) / icicle_step)
			for i in range(num_icicles):
				var ix := 14.0 + float(i) * icicle_step
				var ilen := 4.0 if (i % 2 == 0) else 6.0
				draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([
					Vector2(ix - 2.0, snow_h),
					Vector2(ix + 2.0, snow_h),
					Vector2(ix, snow_h + ilen)
				]), Color("#bae6fd"))
		else:
			draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(2.5, platform_size.y)), Color(0.49, 0.86, 0.99, 0.6), true)
	else:
		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, Vector2(platform_size.x, 3.0)), Color("#342f3a"), true)
	
	# Kutilmagan yoriqlar (bosilganda tez tarqaladi)
	if crack_progress > 0.05:
		var cx := platform_size.x * 0.5
		var alpha := clampf(crack_progress, 0.0, 1.0)
		var crack_col := Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, alpha * 0.9)
		
		# Asosiy yoriq
		draw_line(Vector2(cx, 0), Vector2(cx - 10 * crack_progress, platform_size.y * 0.5), crack_col, 1.8)
		draw_line(Vector2(cx - 10 * crack_progress, platform_size.y * 0.5), Vector2(cx + 8 * crack_progress, platform_size.y), crack_col, 1.6)
		# Qo'shimcha yoriqlar
		draw_line(Vector2(cx - 10 * crack_progress, platform_size.y * 0.5), Vector2(cx - 24 * crack_progress, platform_size.y * 0.8), crack_col, 1.2)
		draw_line(Vector2(cx + 4, platform_size.y * 0.3), Vector2(cx + 20 * crack_progress, platform_size.y * 0.6), crack_col, 1.2)

FILE: scripts/traps/crusher.gd

extends Area2D
class_name Crusher

@export var crusher_size: Vector2 = Vector2(64, 64)
@export var target_y: float = 325.0
@export var trigger_distance: float = 64.0
@export var returns_up: bool = true
@export var wait_at_bottom: float = 0.7
@export var rise_speed: float = 140.0
@export var retrigger_delay: float = 0.8

enum State { IDLE, FALLING, WAITING_BOTTOM, RISING, COOLDOWN }
var state: State = State.IDLE

var initial_position: Vector2
var speed: float = 0.0
var timer: float = 0.0
var player_ref: Node2D = null
var has_crushed: bool = false

var is_triggered: bool:
	get: return state != State.IDLE
var is_falling: bool:
	get: return state == State.FALLING

@onready var col_shape: CollisionShape2D = get_node_or_null("CollisionShape2D")

func _ready() -> void:
	add_to_group("traps")
	initial_position = global_position
	if col_shape:
		col_shape.shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
		col_shape.shape.size = crusher_size + Vector2(0, 8)
		col_shape.position = (crusher_size + Vector2(0, 8)) / 2.0
	body_entered.connect(_on_body_entered)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	match state:
		State.IDLE:
			if has_crushed:
				return
			if player_ref == null:
				player_ref = get_tree().get_first_node_in_group("player") as Node2D
			if player_ref != null and is_instance_valid(player_ref):
				if "is_dead" in player_ref and player_ref.is_dead:
					return
				var crusher_center_x := global_position.x + crusher_size.x / 2.0
				var player_center_x: float = player_ref.global_position.x
				if absf(player_center_x - crusher_center_x) < trigger_distance:
					state = State.FALLING
					speed = 0.0
					var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
					if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
						sm.play("trap")
		
		State.FALLING:
			speed += 3600.0 * delta
			global_position.y += speed * delta
			if global_position.y >= target_y:
				global_position.y = target_y
				var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
				if sm == null or sm.shake_enabled:
					var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
					if gm and gm.has_signal("request_screen_shake"):
						gm.request_screen_shake.emit(8.0)
				if returns_up:
					state = State.WAITING_BOTTOM
					timer = wait_at_bottom
				else:
					has_crushed = true
					state = State.IDLE
		
		State.WAITING_BOTTOM:
			timer -= delta
			if timer <= 0.0:
				state = State.RISING
		
		State.RISING:
			global_position.y -= rise_speed * delta
			if global_position.y <= initial_position.y:
				global_position.y = initial_position.y
				if retrigger_delay > 0.0:
					state = State.COOLDOWN
					timer = retrigger_delay
				else:
					state = State.IDLE
		
		State.COOLDOWN:
			timer -= delta
			if timer <= 0.0:
				state = State.IDLE

func _on_body_entered(body: Node2D) -> void:
	if body is PlayerController or body.is_in_group("player"):
		if "is_dead" in body and body.is_dead:
			return
		if "is_invulnerable" in body and body.is_invulnerable:
			return
		if body.has_method("kill"):
			body.kill()
		elif body.has_method("die"):
			body.die()

func reset_trap() -> void:
	state = State.IDLE
	speed = 0.0
	timer = 0.0
	has_crushed = false
	global_position = initial_position

func _draw() -> void:
	var is_winter := false
	var gm = get_node_or_null("/root/GameManager")
	if gm and gm.has_method("is_winter_theme"):
		is_winter = gm.is_winter_theme()

	var w := crusher_size.x
	var h := crusher_size.y
	
	# Zanjir (shiftgacha ko'tariluvchi osilgan temir zanjir)
	var chain_x := w / 2.0
	var link_spacing := 12.0
	var current_y := 0.0
	while current_y > -600.0:
		# Zanjir halqasi
		draw_rect(Rect2(chain_x - 3.0, current_y - 10.0, 6.0, 10.0), Color("#1a2230"), false, 1.8)
		draw_line(Vector2(chain_x, current_y - 10.0), Vector2(chain_x, current_y - 12.0), Color("#2a3548"), 1.5)
		current_y -= link_spacing
	
	# Zanjir qotirgich halqasi (crusher tepasida)
	draw_circle(Vector2(chain_x, 0), 5.0, Color("#262e3e"))
	draw_circle(Vector2(chain_x, 0), 2.5, Color("#0c0e14"))
	
	# Asosiy ezuvchi blok korpusi
	var body_col := Color("#0d131f") if is_winter else Color("#0c0e14")
	draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, w, h), body_col, true)
	
	if is_winter:
		# Crusher tepasidagi qor qatlami
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, w, 5.0), Color("#ffffff"), true)
		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 4.0, w, 1.5), Color("#94a3b8"), true)
		draw_line(Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(1, h), Color(0.40, 0.70, 0.95, 0.4), 1.0)
		draw_line(Vector2(w - 1, 1), Vector2(w - 1, h), Color(0.40, 0.70, 0.95, 0.4), 1.0)
	else:
		# Korpusning metall qirralari
		draw_line(Vector2(0, 1), Vector2(w, 1), Color("#475569"), 2.0)
		draw_line(Vector2(1, 1), Vector2(1, h), Color("#334155"), 1.5)
		draw_line(Vector2(w - 1, 1), Vector2(w - 1, h), Color("#334155"), 1.5)
		draw_rect(Rect2(4.0, h - 8.0, w - 8.0, 3.0), Color("#2a2536"), true)
	
	# Tishlar: barcha tikanlar bilan 100% BIR XIL po'lat tishlar
	var teeth := 4
	var tw := w / float(teeth)
	var tooth_len := 13.0
	for i in range(teeth):
		var p1 := Vector2(float(i) * tw, h)
		var p2 := Vector2((float(i) + 0.5) * tw, h + tooth_len)
		var p3 := Vector2(float(i + 1) * tw, h)
		if is_winter:
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([p1, p2, p3]), Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.92))
			draw_line(p1, p2, Color("#ffffff"), 1.5)
			draw_line(p2, p3, Color("#0284c7"), 1.2)
		else:
			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([p1, p2, p3]), Color("#1e1b26"))
			var inner_tooth := PackedVector2Array([
				Vector2((float(i) + 0.2) * tw, h),
				p2,
				Vector2((float(i) + 0.55) * tw, h)
			])
			draw_colored_polygon(inner_tooth, Color("#2a2536"))
			draw_line(p1, p2, Color("#ffffff"), 1.5)
			draw_line(p2, p3, Color("#5c566a"), 1.2)
			draw_circle(p2, 1.4, Color.WHITE)
