# AuthModal - Wrong Way Official Google Account Chooser Dialog
# Directly presents user's real Google accounts for 1-click authentication

signal auth_completed(provider: String)

@onready var modal_card: Control = $CenterContainer/CardPanel
@onready var close_btn: Button = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/CloseBtn
@onready var google_logo: TextureRect = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/GoogleLogo
@onready var accounts_container: VBoxContainer = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/AccountsScroll/AccountsVBox
@onready var other_account_btn: Button = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/OtherAccountBtn
@onready var custom_email_row: HBoxContainer = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/CustomEmailRow
@onready var email_input: LineEdit = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/CustomEmailRow/EmailInput
@onready var connect_btn: Button = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/CustomEmailRow/ConnectBtn
@onready var status_lbl: Label = $CenterContainer/CardPanel/ContentVBox/StatusLabel

var is_authenticating: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	visible = false
	if close_btn: close_btn.pressed.connect(close)
	if other_account_btn:
		other_account_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			if custom_email_row:
				custom_email_row.visible = !custom_email_row.visible
				if custom_email_row.visible and email_input:
					email_input.grab_focus()
		)
	if connect_btn: connect_btn.pressed.connect(_on_custom_connect_pressed)
	if email_input: email_input.text_submitted.connect(func(_t): _on_custom_connect_pressed())
	
	if google_logo:
		google_logo.texture = IconFactory.get_icon("google", 1.0)
		
	ProfileManager.google_login_finished.connect(_on_login_finished)

func open(_closable: bool = true) -> void:
	visible = true
	modulate.a = 0.0
	is_authenticating = false
	if status_lbl: status_lbl.text = ""
	if custom_email_row: custom_email_row.visible = false
	if email_input: email_input.text = ""
	
	_populate_google_accounts()
	
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2)

func close() -> void:
	if is_authenticating:
		return
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.15)
	await tw.finished
	visible = false

func _populate_google_accounts() -> void:
	if not accounts_container:
		return
		
	for child in accounts_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
		
	var accounts: Array = ProfileManager.get_known_google_accounts()
	for acc in accounts:
		if acc is Dictionary:
			var aname: String = acc.get("name", "Player")
			var aemail: String = acc.get("email", "")
			if not aemail.is_empty():
				_create_account_card(aname, aemail)

	var name_lbl := Label.new()
	name_lbl.text = acc_name
	name_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	name_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
	vbox.add_child(name_lbl)
	
	var email_lbl := Label.new()
	email_lbl.text = acc_email
	email_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	email_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.60, 0.70, 0.85, 0.90))
	vbox.add_child(email_lbl)
	
	hbox.add_child(vbox)
	
	var arrow_lbl := Label.new()
	arrow_lbl.text = "›"
	arrow_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 20)
	arrow_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.85))
	arrow_lbl.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	hbox.add_child(arrow_lbl)
	
	btn.pressed.connect(func():
		_select_google_account(acc_email, acc_name)
	)
	
	accounts_container.add_child(btn)

func _select_google_account(acc_email: String, acc_name: String) -> void:
	if is_authenticating:
		return
	is_authenticating = true
	SoundManager.play("click")
	_set_status("Google hisobiga ulanmoqda...", false)
	ProfileManager.login_with_google(acc_email, acc_name)
	
	# 8 soniyalik xavfsizlik taymeri
	var auth_generation := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	set_meta("auth_token", auth_generation)
	get_tree().create_timer(8.0).timeout.connect(func():
		if is_authenticating and get_meta("auth_token", 0) == auth_generation:
			is_authenticating = false
			_set_status("Server javob bermadi. Internetni tekshirib qayta urining.", true)
	)

func _on_custom_connect_pressed() -> void:
	if not email_input or is_authenticating:
		return
	var raw_email := email_input.text.strip_edges()
	if not _is_valid_email(raw_email):
		_set_status("Haqiqiy Gmail manzil kiriting (user@gmail.com)", true)
		return
		
	var custom_name := raw_email.split("@")[0].capitalize()
	_select_google_account(raw_email, custom_name)

func _is_valid_email(e: String) -> bool:
	return e.contains("@") and e.contains(".") and e.length() >= 6

func _on_login_finished(success: bool, error_msg: String) -> void:
	is_authenticating = false
	if success:
		_set_status("Ulandi! Xush kelibsiz, " + ProfileManager.username + "!", false)
		auth_completed.emit("google")
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.15)
		await tw.finished
		visible = false
	else:
		_set_status(error_msg if not error_msg.is_empty() else "Serverga ulanishda xatolik", true)

func _set_status(text: String, is_err: bool) -> void:
	if status_lbl:
		status_lbl.text = text
		status_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.95, 0.35, 0.35) if is_err else Color(0.38, 0.85, 0.55))

# Wrong Way - Biome Transition Mist Pass
# Atmospheric boundary between distinct chapters (Forest -> Winter Snow -> Green Forest)
# Focused on a slender, ethereal mist curtain with atmospheric motes and a lock gate badge.
# No artificial drawn roads or bridges.

@export var pass_index: int = 1 # 1: Forest -> Snow, 2: Snow -> Green Forest

var mist_back: ColorRect
var mist_front: ColorRect
var particles: CPUParticles2D
var lock_card: PanelContainer

var is_unlocked: bool = false
var is_card_active: bool = false

const PASS_WIDTH: float = 80.0
const PASS_HEIGHT: float = 540.0

func _ready() -> void:
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH, PASS_HEIGHT)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	
	_setup_mist_layers()
	_setup_particles()
	_setup_lock_card()
	update_state()

func _setup_mist_layers() -> void:
	var shader = preload("res://shaders/fog_transition.gdshader")
	
	# Layer 1: Background mist veil
	mist_back = ColorRect.new()
	mist_back.name = "MistBack"
	mist_back.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	mist_back.position = Vector2(-35.0, 0.0)
	mist_back.size = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH + 70.0, PASS_HEIGHT)
	
	var mat_back = ShaderMaterial.new()
	mat_back.shader = shader
	_apply_mist_colors(mat_back, 1.10, 0.045, 0.70)
	mist_back.material = mat_back
	add_child(mist_back)
	
	# Layer 2: Foreground soft drifting wisps
	mist_front = ColorRect.new()
	mist_front.name = "MistFront"
	mist_front.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	mist_front.position = Vector2(-25.0, 0.0)
	mist_front.size = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH + 50.0, PASS_HEIGHT)
	
	var mat_front = ShaderMaterial.new()
	mat_front.shader = shader
	_apply_mist_colors(mat_front, 0.70, 0.070, 0.80)
	mist_front.material = mat_front
	add_child(mist_front)

func _apply_mist_colors(mat: ShaderMaterial, density_val: float, speed_val: float, edge_exp: float) -> void:
	mat.set_shader_parameter("density", density_val)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("speed", speed_val)
	mat.set_shader_parameter("edge_fade_exp", edge_exp)
	if pass_index == 1:
		mat.set_shader_parameter("fog_color_left", Color(0.68, 0.76, 0.88, 0.75))
		mat.set_shader_parameter("fog_color_right", Color(0.88, 0.94, 1.00, 0.85))
		mat.set_shader_parameter("glow_color", Color(0.55, 0.82, 1.00, 0.45))
	else:
		mat.set_shader_parameter("fog_color_left", Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.00, 0.75))
		mat.set_shader_parameter("fog_color_right", Color(0.62, 0.88, 0.70, 0.80))
		mat.set_shader_parameter("glow_color", Color(0.48, 0.95, 0.65, 0.40))

func _setup_particles() -> void:
	particles = CPUParticles2D.new()
	particles.name = "AtmosphericMotes"
	particles.position = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH * 0.5, 0)
	particles.amount = 22
	particles.lifetime = 4.0
	particles.emission_shape = CPUParticles2D.EMISSION_SHAPE_RECTANGLE
	particles.emission_rect_extents = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH * 0.45, 8.0)
	
	if pass_index == 1:
		# Snowflakes drifting gently from cold snow peaks into forest
		particles.direction = Vector2(-0.40, 1.0)
		particles.spread = 22.0
		particles.gravity = Vector2(0, 14)
		particles.initial_velocity_min = 22.0
		particles.initial_velocity_max = 42.0
		particles.scale_amount_min = 2.0
		particles.scale_amount_max = 3.5
		particles.color = Color(0.92, 0.96, 1.0, 0.78)
	else:
		# Floating emerald spores & summer embers rising
		particles.position = Vector2(PASS_WIDTH * 0.5, PASS_HEIGHT)
		particles.direction = Vector2(-0.20, -1.0)
		particles.spread = 28.0
		particles.gravity = Vector2(0, -8)
		particles.initial_velocity_min = 16.0
		particles.initial_velocity_max = 34.0
		particles.scale_amount_min = 1.8
		particles.scale_amount_max = 3.0
		particles.color = Color(0.65, 1.0, 0.75, 0.70)
		
	add_child(particles)

func _setup_lock_card() -> void:
	# Foydalanuvchi talabiga ko'ra chegaradagi (border pass) qulflangan yozuvi butunlay olib tashlandi
	lock_card = null

func set_card_active(active: bool) -> void:
	is_card_active = active
	if lock_card:
		lock_card.visible = (!is_unlocked and is_card_active)

func update_state() -> void:
	if pass_index == 1:
		is_unlocked = SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(2)
	else:
		is_unlocked = SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(3)
		
	if lock_card:
		lock_card.visible = (!is_unlocked and is_card_active)
		var lbl_title: Label = lock_card.get_node_or_null("VBox/HBox/Title")
		var lbl_sub: Label = lock_card.get_node_or_null("VBox/Sub")
		if pass_index == 1:
			if lbl_title: lbl_title.text = "2-BOB QULFLANGAN"
			if lbl_sub: lbl_sub.text = "1-bobni (20-darajani) yakunlang"
		else:
			if lbl_title: lbl_title.text = "3-BOB QULFLANGAN"
			if lbl_sub: lbl_sub.text = "2-bobni (40-darajani) yakunlang"

extends Control
class_name CloudLayer

# CloudLayer: Animated fluffy cloud bank along the bottom edge of the level select map.
# Teases upcoming worlds and creates a dreamy game-world boundary below level 20.

var anim_time: float = 0.0

# Pre-computed cloud puff positions
var back_puffs: Array[Vector3] = []  # Vector3(x, base_y, radius)
var mid_puffs: Array[Vector3] = []
var front_puffs: Array[Vector3] = []

@onready var notice_label: Label = Label.new()
@onready var badge_panel: Panel = Panel.new()

func _ready() -> void:
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 100)
	
	_generate_cloud_puffs()
	_setup_coming_soon_badge()
	
	LocaleManager.language_changed.connect(_on_language_changed)
	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_on_viewport_size_changed)
	_update_badge_text()

func _on_viewport_size_changed() -> void:
	_generate_cloud_puffs()
	if badge_panel:
		var cur_w: float = maxf(size.x, get_viewport_rect().size.x)
		badge_panel.position.x = (cur_w - 230.0) * 0.5


func _generate_cloud_puffs() -> void:
	var max_w: float = maxf(size.x, maxf(get_viewport_rect().size.x, 1400.0))
	back_puffs.clear()
	mid_puffs.clear()
	front_puffs.clear()
	
	# Orqa qatlam bulutlari (to'qroq krem)
	var x: float = -40.0
	while x <= max_w + 60.0:
		var r := randf_range(45.0, 65.0)
		back_puffs.append(Vector3(x, 50.0, r))
		x += randf_range(40.0, 60.0)
		
	# O'rta qatlam bulutlari
	x = -30.0
	while x <= max_w + 50.0:
		var r := randf_range(38.0, 56.0)
		mid_puffs.append(Vector3(x, 60.0, r))
		x += randf_range(35.0, 55.0)

	# Old qatlam bulutlari (oppoq va yorqin)
	x = -20.0
	while x <= max_w + 40.0:
		var r := randf_range(32.0, 48.0)
		front_puffs.append(Vector3(x, 70.0, r))
		x += randf_range(30.0, 45.0)

func _setup_coming_soon_badge() -> void:
	badge_panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	badge_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(230, 28)
	badge_panel.size = Vector2(230, 28)
	var max_w: float = maxf(size.x, get_viewport_rect().size.x)
	badge_panel.position = Vector2((max_w - 230.0) * 0.5, 62.0)
	
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.20, 0.18, 0.24, 0.85)
	style.border_color = Color(0.38, 0.35, 0.44, 0.9)
	style.border_width_left = 1
	style.border_width_top = 1
	style.border_width_right = 1
	style.border_width_bottom = 1
	style.corner_radius_top_left = 14
	style.corner_radius_top_right = 14
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 14
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 14
	badge_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	notice_label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	notice_label.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(230, 28)
	notice_label.size = Vector2(230, 28)
	notice_label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	notice_label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	notice_label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	notice_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.92, 0.90, 0.95))
	
	badge_panel.add_child(notice_label)
	add_child(badge_panel)

func _on_language_changed(_lang: String) -> void:
	_update_badge_text()

func _update_badge_text() -> void:
	var cur := LocaleManager.current_language
	match cur:
		"ru": notice_label.text = "Новые миры скоро..."
		"en": notice_label.text = "New worlds coming soon..."
		"tr": notice_label.text = "Yeni dünyalar yakında..."
		_: notice_label.text = "Yangi dunyolar tez kunda..."

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	anim_time += delta
	# Sekin nafas oluvchi suzish effekti
	if badge_panel:
		badge_panel.position.y = 62.0 + sin(anim_time * 1.8) * 2.5
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	# 1. Orqa bulut qatlami
	var col_back := Color(0.85, 0.81, 0.74, 0.82)
	for i in range(back_puffs.size()):
		var p = back_puffs[i]
		var dy := sin(anim_time * 1.2 + i * 0.4) * 3.0
		draw_circle(Vector2(p.x, p.y + dy), p.z, col_back)

	# 2. O'rta bulut qatlami
	var col_mid := Color(0.92, 0.89, 0.83, 0.90)
	for i in range(mid_puffs.size()):
		var p = mid_puffs[i]
		var dy := cos(anim_time * 1.5 + i * 0.5) * 3.5
		draw_circle(Vector2(p.x, p.y + dy), p.z, col_mid)

	# 3. Old asosiy oq bulut qatlami
	var col_front := Color(0.97, 0.95, 0.91, 0.97)
	for i in range(front_puffs.size()):
		var p = front_puffs[i]
		var dy := sin(anim_time * 1.7 + i * 0.6) * 2.5
		draw_circle(Vector2(p.x, p.y + dy), p.z, col_front)

	# 4. Pastki qismni to'liq qoplovchi qatlam
	var fill_w: float = maxf(size.x, maxf(get_viewport_rect().size.x, 1400.0)) + 100.0
	draw_rect(Rect2(-50.0, 75.0, fill_w, 150.0), col_front, true)

extends Control
class_name ControlCustomizer

signal closed
signal layout_saved

@onready var drag_left: Control = $DragLeft
@onready var drag_right: Control = $DragRight
@onready var drag_jump: Control = $DragJump
@onready var drag_dash: Control = get_node_or_null("DragDash")

@onready var reset_btn: Button = $TopBar/BtnBox/ResetBtn
@onready var save_btn: Button = $TopBar/BtnBox/SaveBtn
@onready var close_btn: Button = $TopBar/BtnBox/CloseBtn
@onready var title_lbl: Label = $TopBar/TitleBox/TitleLbl
@onready var subtitle_lbl: Label = $TopBar/TitleBox/SubtitleLbl

func _get_default_positions() -> Dictionary:
	return UIResponsive.get_default_touch_positions(self)

func _load_current_positions() -> void:
	var defs := _get_default_positions()
	if drag_left: drag_left.position = SaveManager.get_touch_pos("left", defs["left"])
	if drag_right: drag_right.position = SaveManager.get_touch_pos("right", defs["right"])
	if drag_jump: drag_jump.position = SaveManager.get_touch_pos("jump", defs["jump"])
	if drag_dash: drag_dash.position = SaveManager.get_touch_pos("dash", defs["dash"])

func _update_texts() -> void:
	if title_lbl:
		title_lbl.text = LocaleManager.t("controls_customizer_title")
	if subtitle_lbl:
		subtitle_lbl.text = LocaleManager.t("controls_customizer_hint")
	if reset_btn:
		reset_btn.text = "  " + LocaleManager.t("btn_reset_default")
		reset_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("restart", 0.75)
	if save_btn:
		save_btn.text = "  " + LocaleManager.t("btn_save")
		save_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("check", 0.75)

func _setup_drag_widget(node: Control, icon_name: String, sz: Vector2) -> void:
	if not node: return
	node.custom_minimum_size = sz
	node.size = sz
	node.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	
	var icon_rect = TextureRect.new()
	icon_rect.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	icon_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	icon_rect.texture = IconFactory.get_icon(icon_name, 1.0)
	icon_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
	icon_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
	node.add_child(icon_rect)
	
	node.gui_input.connect(func(event: InputEvent):
		var is_press := false
		var is_release := false
		var is_drag := false
		var local_pos := Vector2.ZERO
		if event is InputEventMouseButton:
			var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
			if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
				is_press = mb.pressed
				is_release = not mb.pressed
				local_pos = mb.position
		elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
			if dragging_node == node:
				is_drag = true
				local_pos = (event as InputEventMouseMotion).position
		elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
			var st := event as InputEventScreenTouch
			is_press = st.pressed
			is_release = not st.pressed
			local_pos = st.position
		elif event is InputEventScreenDrag:
			if dragging_node == node:
				is_drag = true
				local_pos = (event as InputEventScreenDrag).position

		if is_press:
			dragging_node = node
			drag_touch_offset = local_pos
			node.queue_redraw()
		elif is_release and dragging_node == node:
			dragging_node = null
			node.queue_redraw()
		elif is_drag:
			var new_pos := node.position + local_pos - drag_touch_offset
			var vp := get_viewport_rect().size
			var max_x := maxf(10.0, vp.x - node.size.x - 10.0)
			var max_y := maxf(64.0, vp.y - node.size.y - 10.0)
			node.position = Vector2(clampf(new_pos.x, 10.0, max_x), clampf(new_pos.y, 64.0, max_y))
	)
	
	# Drag paytida nozik neon hoshiya chizish
	node.draw.connect(func():
		var is_act = (dragging_node == node)
		var c = Color(0.3, 0.8, 1.0, 0.95) if is_act else Color(0.5, 0.65, 0.9, 0.5)
		var r = Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, node.size)
		node.draw_rect(r, Color(0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.25 if is_act else 0.0), true)
		node.draw_rect(r, c, false, 1.5 if is_act else 1.0)
	)

var dragging_node: Control = null
var drag_touch_offset: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

func _ready() -> void:
	visible = false
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	
	_setup_drag_widget(drag_left, "circle_btn_left", Vector2(64, 64))
	_setup_drag_widget(drag_right, "circle_btn_right", Vector2(64, 64))
	_setup_drag_widget(drag_jump, "circle_btn_jump", Vector2(68, 68))
	if not drag_dash:
		var dd := Control.new()
		dd.name = "DragDash"
		dd.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
		add_child(dd)
		drag_dash = dd
	_setup_drag_widget(drag_dash, "circle_btn_dash", Vector2(64, 64))
	
	if reset_btn: reset_btn.pressed.connect(_on_reset_pressed)
	if save_btn: save_btn.pressed.connect(_on_save_pressed)
	if close_btn: close_btn.pressed.connect(_on_close_pressed)

func open() -> void:
	_load_current_positions()
	_update_texts()
	visible = true
	SoundManager.play("click")

func close() -> void:
	visible = false
	closed.emit()

func _on_reset_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	var defs := _get_default_positions()
	if drag_left: drag_left.position = defs["left"]
	if drag_right: drag_right.position = defs["right"]
	if drag_jump: drag_jump.position = defs["jump"]
	if drag_dash: drag_dash.position = defs["dash"]
	SaveManager.reset_touch_layout()

func _on_save_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if drag_left: SaveManager.set_touch_pos("left", drag_left.position)
	if drag_right: SaveManager.set_touch_pos("right", drag_right.position)
	if drag_jump: SaveManager.set_touch_pos("jump", drag_jump.position)
	if drag_dash: SaveManager.set_touch_pos("dash", drag_dash.position)
	layout_saved.emit()
	close()

func _on_close_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	close()

func _apply_custom_touch_layout() -> void:
	var def_positions := UIResponsive.get_default_touch_positions(self)
	var insets := UIResponsive.get_safe_insets(self)
	
	if pause_btn:
		pause_btn.position = Vector2(20.0 + insets["left"], 16.0 + insets["top"])
		
	var right_box: Control = get_node_or_null("TopHUD/RightBox")
	if right_box:
		var vp := UIResponsive.get_viewport_size(self)
		right_box.position = Vector2(vp.x - right_box.size.x - 20.0 - insets["right"], 16.0 + insets["top"])
	
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm:
		if left_btn: left_btn.position = sm.get_touch_pos("left", def_positions["left"])
		if right_btn: right_btn.position = sm.get_touch_pos("right", def_positions["right"])
		if dash_btn: dash_btn.position = sm.get_touch_pos("dash", def_positions["dash"])
		if jump_btn: jump_btn.position = sm.get_touch_pos("jump", def_positions["jump"])
	else:
		if left_btn: left_btn.position = def_positions["left"]
		if right_btn: right_btn.position = def_positions["right"]
		if dash_btn: dash_btn.position = def_positions["dash"]
		if jump_btn: jump_btn.position = def_positions["jump"]

	if time_label:

			var elapsed_sec: float = (float(Time.get_ticks_msec()) - GameManager.level_start_time) / 1000.0
			time_label.text = "%ds" % int(maxf(elapsed_sec, 0.0))

func start_duel_countdown() -> void:
	if not countdown_box or not countdown_label:
		GameManager.is_countdown_active = false
		GameManager.is_level_running = true
		DuelService.start_match()
		return
		
	countdown_box.visible = true
	GameManager.is_countdown_active = true
	GameManager.is_level_running = false
	
	for count in [3, 2, 1]:
		countdown_label.text = str(count)
		countdown_label.scale = Vector2(1.6, 1.6)
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(countdown_label, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.35)
		SoundManager.play("click")
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.85).timeout
		
	countdown_label.text = "START!"
	countdown_label.scale = Vector2(1.6, 1.6)
	var tw2 := create_tween()
	tw2.tween_property(countdown_label, "scale", Vector2.ONE, 0.35)
	SoundManager.play("win")
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.45).timeout
	countdown_box.visible = false
	
	GameManager.is_countdown_active = false
	GameManager.is_level_running = true
	GameManager.level_start_time = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	DuelService.start_match()

func _on_player_died(deaths_count: int) -> void:
	current_deaths = deaths_count
	_update_deaths_display()

func _update_deaths_display() -> void:
	if deaths_label:
		deaths_label.text = "%d" % current_deaths

func _setup_touch_btn(btn: Button, action: String) -> void:
	btn.gui_input.connect(func(event: InputEvent):
		if event is InputEventScreenTouch:
			var st := event as InputEventScreenTouch
			if st.pressed:
				Input.action_press(action)
			else:
				Input.action_release(action)
	)
	btn.button_down.connect(func(): Input.action_press(action))
	btn.button_up.connect(func(): Input.action_release(action))
	btn.mouse_exited.connect(func():
		if Input.is_action_pressed(action):
			Input.action_release(action)
	)

func _on_pause_btn_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	var parent_canvas = get_parent()
	if parent_canvas:
		var pause_modal = parent_canvas.get_node_or_null("PauseModal")
		if pause_modal and pause_modal.has_method("open_pause"):
			pause_modal.open_pause()
			return
	var pause_node = get_tree().current_scene.find_child("PauseModal", true, false)
	if pause_node and pause_node.has_method("open_pause"):
		pause_node.open_pause()

extends Control

# GlobalDuelFeed - Animated Live Rotating Duel Feed
# - Displays recent competitive victory events
# - Sleek capsule cards with top drop-in fade and smooth exit
# - Continuous rotation cycle through recent duels
# - Responsive, non-intrusive UI placed near main menu top-right

@onready var container: VBoxContainer = $FeedContainer

var feed_items: Array = []
var current_feed_idx: int = 0
var cycle_timer: float = 0.0
const CYCLE_INTERVAL: float = 4.2
var fetch_timer: float = 0.0
const FETCH_INTERVAL: float = 18.0

# Baza bo'sh bo'lganda yoki oflaynda aylanib turish uchun namunaviy duellar
const DEFAULT_SAMPLE_DUELS: Array = [
	{
		"winner_name": "AlphaPlayer",
		"loser_name": "BetaRacer",
		"zone_id": 1,
		"level_id": 20
	},
	{
		"winner_name": "ShadowNinja",
		"loser_name": "SpeedRunner",
		"zone_id": 1,
		"level_id": 15
	},
	{
		"winner_name": "Champion",
		"loser_name": "GhostHunter",
		"zone_id": 2,
		"level_id": 5
	}
]

func _ready() -> void:
	if container:
		container.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
		
	feed_items = DEFAULT_SAMPLE_DUELS.duplicate()
	fetch_feed()
	# Birinchi kartani darhol ko'rsatish
	_show_next_card()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	cycle_timer += delta
	if cycle_timer >= CYCLE_INTERVAL:
		cycle_timer = 0.0
		_show_next_card()
		
	fetch_timer += delta
	if fetch_timer >= FETCH_INTERVAL:
		fetch_timer = 0.0
		fetch_feed()

func fetch_feed() -> void:
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, code, _h, body):
		http.queue_free()
		if code == 200:
			var txt: String = body.get_string_from_utf8()
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
			if parsed is Array and parsed.size() > 0:
				feed_items = parsed
				current_feed_idx = current_feed_idx % feed_items.size()
	)
	var url: String = Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/rpc/get_global_duel_feed"
	var anon_key: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	var headers := PackedStringArray([
		"apikey: " + anon_key,
		"Authorization: Bearer " + anon_key,
		"Content-Type: application/json"
	])
	var payload := JSON.stringify({"p_limit": 6})
	http.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func _show_next_card() -> void:
	if not container or feed_items.is_empty():
		return
		
	# Maksimal 1 ta faol karta (WRONG WAY sarlavhasi ustida bittalab silliq aylanib turadi)
	if container.get_child_count() >= 1:
		for old_child in container.get_children():
			var oldest: Control = old_child as Control
			if oldest and is_instance_valid(oldest) and not oldest.is_queued_for_deletion():
				_animate_card_exit(oldest)
				
	if current_feed_idx < 0 or current_feed_idx >= feed_items.size():
		current_feed_idx = 0
		
	var item = feed_items[current_feed_idx]
	current_feed_idx = (current_feed_idx + 1) % feed_items.size()
	
	if item is Dictionary:
		_add_animated_feed_card(item)

func _add_animated_feed_card(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(250, 32)
	card.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.14, 0.88)
	style.border_color = Color(0.24, 0.45, 0.72, 0.65)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45)
	style.shadow_size = 5
	style.content_margin_left = 10
	style.content_margin_right = 10
	style.content_margin_top = 4
	style.content_margin_bottom = 4
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
	hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	hbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	
	# Crown Icon
	var crown := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("crown_gold", Vector2(14, 14), 0.8)
	crown.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	hbox.add_child(crown)
	
	# Winner
	var winner_name: String = str(data.get("winner_name", "G'olib"))
	var win_lbl := Label.new()
	win_lbl.text = winner_name
	win_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	win_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
	hbox.add_child(win_lbl)
	
	# Separator Indicator
	var arrow_lbl := Label.new()
	arrow_lbl.text = "▸"
	arrow_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	arrow_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97))
	hbox.add_child(arrow_lbl)
	
	# Loser
	var loser_name: String = str(data.get("loser_name", "Raqib"))
	var lose_lbl := Label.new()
	lose_lbl.text = loser_name
	lose_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	lose_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.68, 0.74, 0.85))
	hbox.add_child(lose_lbl)
	
	# Level badge
	var z: int = int(data.get("zone_id", 1))
	var l: int = int(data.get("level_id", 1))
	var lvl_lbl := Label.new()
	lvl_lbl.text = "(Z%d·L%d)" % [z, l]
	lvl_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)
	lvl_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.40, 0.75, 1.0, 0.9))
	hbox.add_child(lvl_lbl)
	
	card.add_child(hbox)
	container.add_child(card)
	
	# Silliq yuqoridan tushish (uncha baland emas: -10px) va tiniqlashish animatsiyasi
	card.modulate.a = 0.0
	card.position.y = -10.0
	
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(card, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.38).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(card, "position:y", 0.0, 0.38).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	
	# Belgilangan vaqtdan so'ng o'z-o'zidan xiralashib yo'qolish
	var exit_tw := create_tween()
	exit_tw.tween_interval(3.6)
	exit_tw.tween_callback(func():
		if is_instance_valid(card) and not card.is_queued_for_deletion():
			_animate_card_exit(card)
	)

func _animate_card_exit(card: Control) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(card) or card.is_queued_for_deletion():
		return
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(card, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tw.parallel().tween_property(card, "position:y", card.position.y + 6.0, 0.4).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	tw.tween_callback(func():
		if is_instance_valid(card):
			card.queue_free()
	)

		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style_glass_press)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.94))

# Sort rule requested:
# 1. Total Stars (DESC - most stars always ranks higher)
# 2. Total Time in seconds (ASC - lowest time ranks higher)
# 3. Total Deaths (ASC - fewer deaths ranks higher)
func _sort_players(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> bool:
	var a_stars: int = a.get("stars", 0)
	var b_stars: int = b.get("stars", 0)
	if a_stars != b_stars:
		return a_stars > b_stars
		
	var a_time: int = a.get("time_sec", 0)
	var b_time: int = b.get("time_sec", 0)
	if a_time != b_time:
		return a_time < b_time
		
	var a_deaths: int = a.get("deaths", 0)
	var b_deaths: int = b.get("deaths", 0)
	return a_deaths < b_deaths

func _fetch_supabase_leaderboard() -> void:
	if is_fetching or not http_request:
		return
	is_fetching = true
	var url := Env.get_supabase_url() + "/rest/v1/profiles?select=id,username,avatar_index,stars,time_sec,deaths&order=stars.desc,time_sec.asc&limit=50"
	var headers := [
		"apikey: " + Env.get_supabase_anon_key(),
		"Authorization: Bearer " + Env.get_supabase_anon_key()
	]
	http_request.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_GET)

func _on_http_completed(_result: int, response_code: int, _headers: PackedStringArray, body: PackedByteArray) -> void:
	is_fetching = false
	if response_code == 200:
		var txt := body.get_string_from_utf8()
		var parsed = JSON.parse_string(txt)
		if parsed is Array:
			remote_players.clear()
			var av_keys := ["avatar_player", "avatar_ninja", "avatar_shadow", "avatar_robot", "avatar_pro"]
			for row in parsed:
				if row is Dictionary:
					var p_id: String = str(row.get("id", ""))
					# O'z profilimizni lokal holatda pastda qo'shamiz
					if p_id == ProfileManager.player_id:
						continue
					var a_idx: int = int(row.get("avatar_index", 1)) - 1
					if a_idx < 0 or a_idx >= av_keys.size(): a_idx = 0
					var u_name: String = str(row.get("username", "O'yinchi"))
					remote_players.append({
						"id": p_id,
						"name": u_name,
						"avatar": av_keys[a_idx],
						"stars": int(row.get("stars", 0)),
						"time_sec": int(row.get("time_sec", 0)),
						"deaths": int(row.get("deaths", 0)),
						"is_me": false
					})
			_refresh_list()

func _refresh_list() -> void:
	if not list_box:
		return
	for ch in list_box.get_children():
		ch.queue_free()
		
	# Live Player Stats
	var my_stars: int = SaveManager.get_total_stars()
	var my_time: int = SaveManager.get_total_beaten_time_sec()
	var my_deaths: int = SaveManager.get_total_beaten_deaths()
	
	var my_display_name := ProfileManager.username
	var my_you_str := LocaleManager.t("player_you")
	if my_display_name.is_empty() or my_display_name.to_lower() == "player" or my_display_name.to_lower() == my_you_str.to_lower() or my_display_name.to_lower() == "siz":
		my_display_name = my_you_str
	else:
		my_display_name = "%s (%s)" % [my_display_name, my_you_str]
		
	var av_keys := ["avatar_player", "avatar_ninja", "avatar_shadow", "avatar_robot", "avatar_pro"]
	var av_idx := (ProfileManager.avatar_index - 1) % av_keys.size()
	if av_idx < 0: av_idx = 0
	var my_avatar: String = av_keys[av_idx]
	
	var my_data := {
		"name": my_display_name,
		"avatar": my_avatar,
		"stars": my_stars,
		"time_sec": my_time,
		"deaths": my_deaths,
		"is_me": true
	}
	
	var raw_list: Array = []
	if current_tab == TabMode.GLOBAL:
		raw_list = remote_players.duplicate(true)
	else:
		# Do'stlar ro'yxati
		for p in remote_players:
			if ProfileManager.is_friend(p.get("id", "")):
				raw_list.append(p)
		
	raw_list.append(my_data)
	raw_list.sort_custom(_sort_players)
	
	var my_rank: int = 1
	for idx in range(raw_list.size()):
		var player_data: Dictionary = raw_list[idx]
		var rank: int = idx + 1
		if player_data.get("is_me", false):
			my_rank = rank
		var row: Control = _build_row(rank, player_data)
		list_box.add_child(row)
		
	# Update pinned bottom stats bar
	if my_rank_label:
		my_rank_label.text = "#%d" % my_rank
		if my_rank == 1:
			my_rank_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#facc15"))
		elif my_rank == 2:
			my_rank_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#e2e8f0"))
		elif my_rank == 3:
			my_rank_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#f59e0b"))
		else:
			my_rank_label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#38bdf8"))
			
	if my_stats_label:
		my_stats_label.text = "%d yulduz   •   %ds   •   %d o'lim" % [my_stars, my_time, my_deaths]

func _build_row(rank: int, data: Dictionary) -> Control:
	var row := PanelContainer.new()
	row.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 56)
	
	var is_me: bool = data.get("is_me", false)
	
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.corner_radius_top_left = 10
	style.corner_radius_top_right = 10
	style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 10
	style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 10
	
	if is_me:
		style.bg_color = Color(0.10, 0.20, 0.32, 0.90)
		style.border_color = Color("#38bdf8")
		style.border_width_left = 1
		style.border_width_top = 1
		style.border_width_right = 1
		style.border_width_bottom = 1
		style.shadow_color = Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.25)
		style.shadow_size = 6
	else:
		style.bg_color = Color(0.08, 0.10, 0.15, 0.75)
		style.border_color = Color(0.20, 0.25, 0.35, 0.50)
		style.border_width_left = 1
		style.border_width_top = 1
		style.border_width_right = 1
		style.border_width_bottom = 1
	
	style.content_margin_left = 10.0
	style.content_margin_right = 12.0
	style.content_margin_top = 6.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 6.0
	row.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_BEGIN
	hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	row.add_child(hbox)
	
	# Left: Avatar container with rank decoration on top
	var avatar_box := Control.new()
	avatar_box.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(40, 44)
	avatar_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	
	# Base Avatar
	var avatar_icon: TextureRect = IconFactory.create_texture_rect(data.get("avatar", "avatar_player"), Vector2(34, 34), 1.0)
	avatar_icon.position = Vector2(3, 8)
	avatar_box.add_child(avatar_icon)
	
	# Rank decorations on top of avatar:
	# 1-o'rin: sariq toj (crown_gold)
	# 2-o'rin: 2 ta yulduzcha (star_gold)
	# 3-o'rin: 1 ta yulduzcha (star_gold)
	if rank == 1:
		var crown_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("crown_gold", Vector2(20, 20), 0.8)
		crown_icon.position = Vector2(10, -5)
		avatar_box.add_child(crown_icon)
	elif rank == 2:
		var star_box := HBoxContainer.new()
		star_box.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(26, 12)
		star_box.position = Vector2(7, -3)
		star_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
		star_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		var s1 := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("star_gold", Vector2(11, 11), 0.45)
		var s2 := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("star_gold", Vector2(11, 11), 0.45)
		star_box.add_child(s1)
		star_box.add_child(s2)
		avatar_box.add_child(star_box)
	elif rank == 3:
		var s_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("star_gold", Vector2(13, 13), 0.55)
		s_icon.position = Vector2(13, -3)
		avatar_box.add_child(s_icon)
		
	hbox.add_child(avatar_box)
	
	# Center: Name and results row underneath
	var info_box := VBoxContainer.new()
	info_box.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	info_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	info_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	
	var name_lbl := Label.new()
	var player_name: String = data.get("name", "Player")
	if is_me:
		name_lbl.text = "%s (SIZ)" % player_name
		name_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#38bdf8"))
	else:
		name_lbl.text = player_name
		name_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#f8fafc"))
	name_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
	info_box.add_child(name_lbl)
	
	var stats_lbl := Label.new()
	var stars: int = data.get("stars", 0)
	var time_sec: int = data.get("time_sec", 0)
	var deaths: int = data.get("deaths", 0)
	stats_lbl.text = "%d yulduz   •   %ds   •   %d o'lim" % [stars, time_sec, deaths]
	stats_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	stats_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#94a3b8") if not is_me else Color("#bae6fd"))
	info_box.add_child(stats_lbl)
	
	hbox.add_child(info_box)
	
	# Right: Rank Number
	var rank_lbl := Label.new()
	rank_lbl.text = "#%d" % rank
	rank_lbl.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 0)
	rank_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT
	rank_lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if rank == 1:
		rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#facc15")) # Gold
		rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	elif rank == 2:
		rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#e2e8f0")) # Silver
		rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	elif rank == 3:
		rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#f59e0b")) # Bronze
		rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	else:
		rank_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#64748b")) # Slate
		rank_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	hbox.add_child(rank_lbl)
	
	return row

func _get_step_width() -> float:
	return get_viewport_rect().size.x

func _get_map_offset() -> Vector2:
	var vp := get_viewport_rect().size
	var ox := (vp.x - 960.0) * 0.5
	var oy := (vp.y - 540.0) * 0.5
	return Vector2(ox, oy)

func _setup_widescreen_layout() -> void:
	var step_w := _get_step_width()
	if ch1_view:
		ch1_view.offset_left = 0.0
		ch1_view.offset_right = 0.0
	if ch2_view:
		ch2_view.offset_left = step_w
		ch2_view.offset_right = step_w
	if ch3_view:
		ch3_view.offset_left = step_w * 2.0
		ch3_view.offset_right = step_w * 2.0
		
	var insets := UIResponsive.get_safe_insets(self)
	if back_btn:
		back_btn.position.x = 20.0 + insets["left"]
	if total_stars_chip:
		total_stars_chip.position.x = step_w - total_stars_chip.size.x - 20.0 - insets["right"]
	if side_nav_right:
		side_nav_right.position.x = step_w - side_nav_right.size.x - 16.0 - insets["right"]
	if side_nav_left:
		side_nav_left.position.x = 16.0 + insets["left"]
		
	if toast_panel and toast_panel.visible:
		toast_panel.position.x = (step_w - toast_panel.size.x) * 0.5
		
	_reposition_all_chapter_nodes()

func _reposition_all_chapter_nodes() -> void:
	_position_nodes(1, node_layer1)
	_position_nodes(2, node_layer2)
	_position_nodes(3, node_layer3)

func _position_nodes(chapter: int, container: Control) -> void:
	if not container or not is_inside_tree():
		return
	var positions := CHAPTER_1_POS
	if chapter == 2:
		positions = CHAPTER_2_POS
	elif chapter == 3:
		positions = CHAPTER_3_POS
	var offset := _get_map_offset()
	var children := container.get_children()
	for i in range(mini(children.size(), positions.size())):
		var btn = children[i] as Control
		if btn:
			btn.position = positions[i] + offset - Vector2(18, 18)

	style.border_color = Color("#f59e0b")
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.65)
	style.shadow_size = 14
	style.content_margin_left = 14.0
	style.content_margin_right = 14.0
	style.content_margin_top = 8.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
	toast_panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	toast_panel.add_child(hbox)
	
	var lock_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("lock", Vector2(20, 20), 0.9)
	hbox.add_child(lock_icon)
	
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
	hbox.add_child(vbox)
	
	toast_title_lbl = Label.new()
	toast_title_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	toast_title_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.98, 0.90, 0.55))
	vbox.add_child(toast_title_lbl)
	
	toast_msg_lbl = Label.new()
	toast_msg_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	toast_msg_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.80, 0.86, 0.96))
	vbox.add_child(toast_msg_lbl)
	
	add_child(toast_panel)

func _show_notice(title_text: String, message_text: String) -> void:
	if not toast_panel:
		_setup_toast_ui()
		
	if toast_title_lbl:
		toast_title_lbl.text = title_text
	if toast_msg_lbl:
		toast_msg_lbl.text = message_text
		
	if toast_tween and toast_tween.is_valid():
		toast_tween.kill()
		
	toast_panel.visible = true
	toast_panel.position.y = 55.0
	toast_panel.modulate.a = 0.0
	
	toast_tween = create_tween()
	toast_tween.set_parallel(true)
	toast_tween.tween_property(toast_panel, "position:y", 75.0, 0.25).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BACK).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	toast_tween.tween_property(toast_panel, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.25)
	
	toast_tween.chain().tween_interval(2.5)
	
	var fade_out = toast_tween.chain().set_parallel(true)
	fade_out.tween_property(toast_panel, "position:y", 60.0, 0.25).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
	fade_out.tween_property(toast_panel, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.25)
	toast_tween.chain().tween_callback(func(): toast_panel.visible = false)

func _on_side_nav_right_pressed() -> void:
	if current_chapter == 1:
		switch_to_chapter(2, true)
	elif current_chapter == 2:
		switch_to_chapter(3, true)

func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if is_animating:
		return
		
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			if mb.pressed:
				is_dragging = true
				has_dragged = false
				drag_start_x = mb.position.x
				slider_start_x = chapter_slider.position.x
				drag_accum_dist = 0.0
			else:
				if is_dragging:
					is_dragging = false
					if has_dragged:
						_finish_drag()
						get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
						
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and is_dragging:
		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		var dx: float = mm.position.x - drag_start_x
		drag_accum_dist += absf(mm.relative.x)
		if drag_accum_dist > 8.0:
			has_dragged = true
			
		if has_dragged:
			var step_w := _get_step_width()
			var target_x: float = slider_start_x + dx
			target_x = clampf(target_x, -step_w * 2.0 - 50.0, 50.0)
			chapter_slider.position.x = target_x
			_update_realtime_drag_feedback(target_x)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
			
	elif event is InputEventScreenTouch:
		var st := event as InputEventScreenTouch
		if st.pressed:
			is_dragging = true
			has_dragged = false
			drag_start_x = st.position.x
			slider_start_x = chapter_slider.position.x
			drag_accum_dist = 0.0
		else:
			if is_dragging:
				is_dragging = false
				if has_dragged:
					_finish_drag()
					get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
					
	elif event is InputEventScreenDrag and is_dragging:
		var sd := event as InputEventScreenDrag
		var dx: float = sd.position.x - drag_start_x
		drag_accum_dist += absf(sd.relative.x)
		if drag_accum_dist > 8.0:
			has_dragged = true
			
		if has_dragged:
			var step_w := _get_step_width()
			var target_x: float = slider_start_x + dx
			target_x = clampf(target_x, -step_w * 2.0 - 50.0, 50.0)
			chapter_slider.position.x = target_x
			_update_realtime_drag_feedback(target_x)
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _update_realtime_drag_feedback(slider_x: float) -> void:
	var step_w := _get_step_width()
	var target_ch: int = 1
	if slider_x <= -step_w * 1.5:
		target_ch = 3
	elif slider_x <= -step_w * 0.5:
		target_ch = 2
	else:
		target_ch = 1
	if btn_ch1 and btn_ch2:
		_set_btn_active(btn_ch1, target_ch == 1)
		_set_btn_active(btn_ch2, target_ch == 2)
		if btn_ch3: _set_btn_active(btn_ch3, target_ch == 3)
	if title_label:
		var title_key := "chapter_1_title"
		if target_ch == 2: title_key = "chapter_2_title"
		elif target_ch == 3: title_key = "chapter_3_title"
		title_label.text = "< ◇ ── " + LocaleManager.t(title_key).to_upper() + " ── ◇ >"
	if lock_card_ch2:
		lock_card_ch2.visible = (!SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(2) and slider_x <= -step_w * 0.75 and slider_x >= -step_w * 1.25)
	if lock_card_ch3:
		lock_card_ch3.visible = (!SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(3) and slider_x <= -step_w * 1.75)
	if pass1 and pass1.has_method("set_card_active"):
		pass1.set_card_active(slider_x < -150.0 and slider_x > -step_w + 150.0)
	if pass2 and pass2.has_method("set_card_active"):
		pass2.set_card_active(slider_x < -step_w - 150.0 and slider_x > -step_w * 2.0 + 150.0)

func _finish_drag() -> void:
	var step_w := _get_step_width()
	var slider_x := chapter_slider.position.x
	if slider_x <= -step_w * 1.5:
		switch_to_chapter(3, true)
	elif slider_x <= -step_w * 0.5:
		switch_to_chapter(2, true)
	else:
		switch_to_chapter(1, true)

func switch_to_chapter(target_chapter: int, animated: bool = true) -> void:
	current_chapter = target_chapter
	var step_w := _get_step_width()
	var target_x: float = 0.0
	if current_chapter == 2:
		target_x = -step_w
	elif current_chapter == 3:
		target_x = -step_w * 2.0
	
	if pass1 and pass1.has_method("set_card_active"):
		pass1.set_card_active(false)
	if pass2 and pass2.has_method("set_card_active"):
		pass2.set_card_active(false)
	
	_update_top_bar_data()
	_update_nav_buttons()
	_update_chapter_locks()
	
	if not animated:
		chapter_slider.position.x = target_x
		return
		
	# Silliq kinematik animatsiya: 60fps cubic tween
	is_animating = true
	SoundManager.play("click")
	
	var tw := create_tween().set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(chapter_slider, "position:x", target_x, 0.38)
	tw.finished.connect(func():
		is_animating = false
	)

func _update_top_bar_data() -> void:
	if title_label:
		var title_key := "chapter_1_title"
		if current_chapter == 2:
			title_key = "chapter_2_title"
		elif current_chapter == 3:
			title_key = "chapter_3_title"
		title_label.text = "< ◇ ── " + LocaleManager.t(title_key).to_upper() + " ── ◇ >"
		
	if total_stars_chip:
		var ch_stars := SaveManager.get_chapter_stars(current_chapter)
		total_stars_chip.text = "     %d / 60" % ch_stars

func _update_nav_buttons() -> void:
	if side_nav_right:
		side_nav_right.visible = (current_chapter < 3)
		if current_chapter == 1:
			side_nav_right.text = "2-BOB ▶"
		elif current_chapter == 2:
			side_nav_right.text = "3-BOB ▶"
	if side_nav_left:
		side_nav_left.visible = (current_chapter > 1)
		if current_chapter == 2:
			side_nav_left.text = "◀ 1-BOB"
		elif current_chapter == 3:
			side_nav_left.text = "◀ 2-BOB"
		
	if btn_ch1 and btn_ch2:
		_set_btn_active(btn_ch1, current_chapter == 1)
		_set_btn_active(btn_ch2, current_chapter == 2)
		if btn_ch3:
			_set_btn_active(btn_ch3, current_chapter == 3)

func _set_btn_active(btn: Button, active: bool) -> void:
	if active:
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style_white)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style_white_hov)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style_white_press)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", empty_focus)
		var dark_c := Color(0.08, 0.08, 0.12)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", dark_c)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", dark_c)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", dark_c)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", dark_c)
	else:
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style_glass)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style_glass_hov)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style_glass_press)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", empty_focus)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.94))
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_pressed_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_focus_color", Color(0.85, 0.88, 0.94))

func _on_language_changed(_lang: String) -> void:
	_update_top_bar_data()
	_update_nav_buttons()
	_update_chapter_locks()
	_create_nodes_for_chapter(1)
	_create_nodes_for_chapter(2)
	_create_nodes_for_chapter(3)

func _create_nodes_for_chapter(chapter: int) -> void:
	var container: Control = null
	if chapter == 1:
		container = node_layer1
	elif chapter == 2:
		container = node_layer2
	elif chapter == 3:
		container = node_layer3
		
	if not container:
		return
		
	for child in container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()

	var positions := CHAPTER_1_POS
	if chapter == 2:
		positions = CHAPTER_2_POS
	elif chapter == 3:
		positions = CHAPTER_3_POS

	var start_lvl := 1
	if chapter == 2:
		start_lvl = 21
	elif chapter == 3:
		start_lvl = 41

	var max_unlocked: int = 1
	for lvl in SaveManager.unlocked_levels:
		if lvl > max_unlocked:
			max_unlocked = lvl

	for i in range(20):
		var lvl := start_lvl + i
		var pos: Vector2 = positions[i]
		var unlocked := SaveManager.is_level_unlocked(lvl)
		var stars: int = SaveManager.level_stars.get(str(lvl), 0)
		var is_active_target := (lvl == max_unlocked)
		
		# Dumaloq tugma (36x36 diametrli doira, radius 18)
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 36)
		btn.size = Vector2(36, 36)
		btn.position = pos + _get_map_offset() - Vector2(18, 18)
		btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(18)
		
		if unlocked:
			if is_active_target:
				style.bg_color = Color(0.10, 0.22, 0.38, 0.96)
				style.border_color = Color("#38bdf8")
				style.set_border_width_all(2)
				style.shadow_color = Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.50)
				style.shadow_size = 8
			else:
				style.bg_color = Color(0.06, 0.10, 0.18, 0.92)
				style.border_color = Color(0.35, 0.45, 0.62, 0.85)
				style.set_border_width_all(1.5)
				style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.50)
				style.shadow_size = 4
				
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
			
			btn.text = str(lvl)
			btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
			btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
			
			# Dumaloq doira TEPASIDA kattaroq 3 ta yulduzcha
			var star_box := HBoxContainer.new()
			star_box.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			star_box.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(36, 12)
			star_box.size = Vector2(36, 12)
			star_box.position = Vector2(0, -14) # Doira tepasida
			star_box.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
			star_box.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
			
			for s in range(3):
				var star_key := "star_gold" if s < stars else "star_dim"
				var star_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect(star_key, Vector2(10, 10), 0.52)
				star_box.add_child(star_icon)
			btn.add_child(star_box)
			
			btn.pressed.connect(func(): _on_level_btn_pressed(lvl))
		else:
			var can_ad_unlock := SaveManager.is_level_ad_unlockable(lvl)
			if can_ad_unlock:
				style.bg_color = Color(0.12, 0.10, 0.16, 0.90)
				style.border_color = Color("#eab308")
				style.set_border_width_all(1.5)
				style.shadow_color = Color(0.92, 0.70, 0.03, 0.25)
				style.shadow_size = 5
				
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
				
				btn.text = str(lvl)
				btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
				btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.98, 0.85, 0.40))
				
				var ad_badge := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("video_ad", Vector2(13, 13), 0.55)
				ad_badge.position = pos + Vector2(9, -17)
				ad_badge.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
				container.add_child(ad_badge)
				
				btn.pressed.connect(func():
					SoundManager.play("click")
					var adm = get_node_or_null("/root/AdManager")
					if adm and adm.has_method("show_rewarded_ad"):
						adm.show_rewarded_ad(func():
							SaveManager.unlock_level_via_ad(lvl)
							_create_nodes_for_chapter(current_chapter)
						)
					else:
						SaveManager.unlock_level_via_ad(lvl)
						_create_nodes_for_chapter(current_chapter)
				)
			else:
				style.bg_color = Color(0.04, 0.05, 0.08, 0.82)
				style.border_color = Color(0.20, 0.25, 0.35, 0.50)
				style.set_border_width_all(1)
				
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style)
				btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
				
				btn.text = str(lvl)
				btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
				btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.45, 0.50, 0.60))
				
				var lock_badge := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("lock", Vector2(12, 12), 0.50)
				lock_badge.position = pos + Vector2(9, -17)
				lock_badge.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
				container.add_child(lock_badge)
				
				btn.pressed.connect(func():
					SoundManager.play("click")
					var info: Dictionary = SaveManager.get_lock_reason_dialog(lvl)
					var t: String = info.get("title", "Qulflangan")
					var m: String = info.get("text", "Bu daraja hozircha ochilmagan.")
					_show_notice(t, m)
				)
				
		container.add_child(btn)

func _on_level_btn_pressed(lvl: int) -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SaveManager.should_restore_result_modal = false
	SaveManager.navigation_source = "home_menu"
	
	var level_scene_path := "res://scenes/levels/level_%02d.tscn" % lvl
	if lvl > 60 and not ResourceLoader.exists(level_scene_path):
		_show_notice("DARJA: %d" % lvl, "Yangi darajalar tez kunda navbatdagi katta yangilanishda taqdim etiladi!")
		return
		
	var already_beaten := SaveManager.is_level_completed(lvl)
	if already_beaten and not SaveManager.debug_unlock_all:
		var adm = get_node_or_null("/root/AdManager")
		if adm and adm.has_method("show_interstitial_ad"):
			adm.show_interstitial_ad(func():
				GameManager.start_game(lvl)
			)
		else:
			GameManager.start_game(lvl)
	else:
		GameManager.start_game(lvl)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Boblar Bulutlari (Ochilmaganda ko'rinadi, ochilganda yo'qoladi)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Boblar Qulflari va Holatlari (Clean Chapter Locks & Badges)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
var lock_card_ch2: Control = null
var lock_card_ch3: Control = null

func _update_chapter_locks() -> void:
	var ch2_unlocked: bool = SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(2)
	var ch3_unlocked: bool = SaveManager.is_chapter_unlocked(3)
	
	if backdrop_ch2:
		backdrop_ch2.modulate = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) if ch2_unlocked else Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.68, 1.0)
	if backdrop_ch3:
		backdrop_ch3.modulate = Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0) if ch3_unlocked else Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.68, 1.0)
		
	if pass1 and pass1.has_method("update_state"):
		pass1.update_state()
	if pass2 and pass2.has_method("update_state"):
		pass2.update_state()
		
	if not ch2_unlocked:
		if not lock_card_ch2 and ch2_view:
			lock_card_ch2 = _create_chapter_lock_card(2)
			ch2_view.add_child(lock_card_ch2)
		if lock_card_ch2:
			lock_card_ch2.visible = (current_chapter == 2)
			_refresh_lock_card_texts(lock_card_ch2, 2)
	else:
		if lock_card_ch2:
			lock_card_ch2.visible = false
			
	if not ch3_unlocked:
		if not lock_card_ch3 and ch3_view:
			lock_card_ch3 = _create_chapter_lock_card(3)
			ch3_view.add_child(lock_card_ch3)
		if lock_card_ch3:
			lock_card_ch3.visible = (current_chapter == 3)
			_refresh_lock_card_texts(lock_card_ch3, 3)
	else:
		if lock_card_ch3:
			lock_card_ch3.visible = false

func _create_chapter_lock_card(chapter: int) -> Control:
	var card_w: float = 340.0
	var card_h: float = 56.0
	
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	card.name = "ChapterLockCard%d" % chapter
	card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(card_w, card_h)
	card.size = Vector2(card_w, card_h)
	# Yo'l va daraja doirachalariga xalaqit bermasligi uchun tepada (top-bar ostida)
	card.position = Vector2((get_viewport_rect().size.x - card_w) * 0.5, 68.0)
	card.z_as_relative = false
	card.z_index = 100
	card.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.06, 0.08, 0.13, 0.94)
	style.border_color = Color(0.35, 0.45, 0.65, 0.85)
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
	style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.65)
	style.shadow_size = 12
	style.content_margin_left = 14.0
	style.content_margin_right = 14.0
	style.content_margin_top = 8.0
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.name = "VBox"
	vbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	vbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	card.add_child(vbox)
	
	var hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	hbox.name = "HBox"
	hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	hbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	vbox.add_child(hbox)
	
	var lock_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("lock", Vector2(18, 18), 0.85)
	lock_icon.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	hbox.add_child(lock_icon)
	
	var lbl_title := Label.new()
	lbl_title.name = "Title"
	lbl_title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 15)
	lbl_title.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.96, 0.98, 1.0))
	lbl_title.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	hbox.add_child(lbl_title)
	
	var lbl_sub := Label.new()
	lbl_sub.name = "Sub"
	lbl_sub.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	lbl_sub.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	lbl_sub.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.68, 0.75, 0.88))
	lbl_sub.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	vbox.add_child(lbl_sub)
	
	_refresh_lock_card_texts(card, chapter)
	return card

func _refresh_lock_card_texts(card: Control, chapter: int) -> void:
	if not card: return
	var lbl_title: Label = card.get_node_or_null("VBox/HBox/Title")
	var lbl_sub: Label = card.get_node_or_null("VBox/Sub")
	var t_key := "chapter_2_locked" if chapter == 2 else "chapter_3_locked"
	var r_key := "chapter_2_unlock_req" if chapter == 2 else "chapter_3_unlock_req"
	if lbl_title:
		lbl_title.text = LocaleManager.t(t_key)
	if lbl_sub:
		lbl_sub.text = LocaleManager.t(r_key)

FILE: scripts/ui/menu_character.gd
LINES: 236 | SIZE: 8091 bytes

extends Control

# MenuCharacter - Interactive Animated Wrong Way Character for Main Menu
# - Stands proudly under the "WRONG WAY" title
# - Natural breathing squash & stretch animation
# - Expressive eyes with blinking
# - Interactive PC mouse cursor tracking (pupils follow the cursor dynamically!)
# - Interactive click / tap reaction (cute hop & happy eyes)
# - Interactive Exit hover reaction (quivering sad, tearful pleading eyes)

var body_w: float = 34.0
var body_h: float = 40.0

var _time: float = 0.0
var is_blinking: bool = false
var blink_timer: float = 3.2
var blink_duration: float = 0.13

# Cursor tracking
var current_pupil_offset: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var target_pupil_offset: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

# Reaction: Happy
var is_happy: bool = false
var happy_timer: float = 0.0
var hop_offset_y: float = 0.0

# Reaction: Sad (Exit Hover)
var is_sad: bool = false
var sad_factor: float = 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	custom_minimum_size = Vector2(body_w + 16, body_h + 16)
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
	blink_timer = randf_range(2.5, 4.5)

func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
		_trigger_hop()

func _trigger_hop() -> void:
	if is_sad:
		return
	is_happy = true
	happy_timer = 0.8
	var tw := create_tween()
	tw.tween_property(self, "hop_offset_y", -14.0, 0.12).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_QUAD).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	tw.tween_property(self, "hop_offset_y", 0.0, 0.18).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_BOUNCE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_OUT)
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
		sm.play("click")

func set_sad_emotion(sad: bool) -> void:
	is_sad = sad
	queue_redraw()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	_time += delta
	
	# Smooth emotional transition for sad/pleading state
	if is_sad:
		sad_factor = move_toward(sad_factor, 1.0, delta * 6.5)
	else:
		sad_factor = move_toward(sad_factor, 0.0, delta * 5.0)
	
	# Blinking (disabled during sad or happy states)
	if not is_happy and sad_factor < 0.1:
		blink_timer -= delta
		if blink_timer <= 0.0:
			is_blinking = true
			blink_duration -= delta
			if blink_duration <= 0.0:
				is_blinking = false
				blink_timer = randf_range(3.0, 5.5)
				blink_duration = 0.13
	elif is_happy:
		is_blinking = false
		happy_timer -= delta
		if happy_timer <= 0.0:
			is_happy = false
	else:
		is_blinking = false
			
	# Mouse cursor tracking (PC & Desktop)
	var mouse_pos := get_global_mouse_position()
	var eye_center_global := global_position + Vector2(custom_minimum_size.x * 0.5, custom_minimum_size.y * 0.5 - 2.0)
	var diff := mouse_pos - eye_center_global
	var dist := diff.length()
	
	if dist > 4.0:
		var dir := diff.normalized()
		var strength := clampf(dist / 140.0, 0.15, 1.0)
		target_pupil_offset = Vector2(dir.x * 2.8 * strength, dir.y * 2.8 * strength)
	else:
		target_pupil_offset = Vector2.ZERO
		
	# When sad, gaze looks pleadingly up-left towards Quit button
	if sad_factor > 0.001:
		var sad_look := Vector2(-2.5, -2.4)
		target_pupil_offset = target_pupil_offset.lerp(sad_look, sad_factor * 0.85)
		
	current_pupil_offset = current_pupil_offset.lerp(target_pupil_offset, delta * 12.0)
	
	queue_redraw()

func _draw() -> void:
	var center := Vector2(custom_minimum_size.x * 0.5, custom_minimum_size.y - 4.0 + hop_offset_y)
	
	# Breathing squash & stretch
	var breath := sin(_time * 2.6) * 0.03
	var h := body_h * (1.0 + breath)
	var w := body_w * (1.0 - breath * 0.5)
	
	if is_happy:
		# Happy stretch
		w *= 1.08
		h *= 0.94
	elif sad_factor > 0.001:
		# Trembling body (whimpering / shivering with sadness)
		var tremble := sin(_time * 28.0) * (0.85 * sad_factor)
		center.x += tremble
		center.y += 1.2 * sad_factor
		h *= (1.0 - 0.05 * sad_factor)
		w *= (1.0 + 0.04 * sad_factor)
		
	var body_rect := Rect2(center.x - w * 0.5, center.y - h, w, h)
	
	# Shadow under character
	var shadow_rect := Rect2(center.x - body_w * 0.45, center.y - 2.0, body_w * 0.9, 4.0)
	draw_colored_polygon([
		Vector2(shadow_rect.position.x, shadow_rect.position.y + 2.0),
		Vector2(shadow_rect.position.x + shadow_rect.size.x * 0.5, shadow_rect.position.y),
		Vector2(shadow_rect.end.x, shadow_rect.position.y + 2.0),
		Vector2(shadow_rect.position.x + shadow_rect.size.x * 0.5, shadow_rect.end.y)
	], Color(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.35))
	
	# Chassis (tana)
	draw_rect(body_rect, Color("#18171f"), true)
	draw_rect(body_rect, Color("#2d2838"), false, 1.5)
	
	# Top subtle bevel highlight
	draw_line(
		Vector2(body_rect.position.x + 2, body_rect.position.y + 1),
		Vector2(body_rect.end.x - 2, body_rect.position.y + 1),
		Color(1, 1, 1, 0.12),
		1.0
	)
	
	# Eyes
	var eye_y := center.y - h * 0.52
	var eye_radius := Vector2(4.8, 6.0)
	var left_eye := Vector2(center.x - 7.5, eye_y)
	var right_eye := Vector2(center.x + 7.5, eye_y)
	
	if is_happy:
		# Happy squint arcs: ^^
		_draw_happy_eye(left_eye)
		_draw_happy_eye(right_eye)
	elif is_blinking and sad_factor < 0.2:
		# Blink slits
		draw_line(left_eye - Vector2(4.5, 0), left_eye + Vector2(4.5, 0), Color.WHITE, 2.0)
		draw_line(right_eye - Vector2(4.5, 0), right_eye + Vector2(4.5, 0), Color.WHITE, 2.0)
	else:
		# Sclera (White eye)
		_draw_ellipse(left_eye, eye_radius, Color.WHITE)
		_draw_ellipse(right_eye, eye_radius, Color.WHITE)
		
		# Pupils (following mouse or looking pleadingly at Exit)
		var p_radius := lerpf(2.2, 2.7, sad_factor)
		var p_left := left_eye + current_pupil_offset
		var p_right := right_eye + current_pupil_offset
		
		draw_circle(p_left, p_radius, Color("#100f14"))
		draw_circle(p_right, p_radius, Color("#100f14"))
		
		# White glints in pupils (extra glassy shimmer when sad)
		draw_circle(p_left + Vector2(-0.8, -0.8), 0.75, Color.WHITE)
		draw_circle(p_right + Vector2(-0.8, -0.8), 0.75, Color.WHITE)
		if sad_factor > 0.15:
			draw_circle(p_left + Vector2(0.9, 0.7), 0.55 * sad_factor, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8 * sad_factor))
			draw_circle(p_right + Vector2(0.9, 0.7), 0.55 * sad_factor, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8 * sad_factor))
			
		# Sad pleading eyebrows (slanting upward inwards: \  / )
		if sad_factor > 0.05:
			var brow_alpha := clampf(sad_factor * 1.2, 0.0, 1.0)
			var brow_col := Color(0.95, 0.96, 1.0, 0.9 * brow_alpha)
			draw_line(
				Vector2(left_eye.x - 5.5, eye_y - 7.5 + 1.0 * sad_factor),
				Vector2(left_eye.x + 4.5, eye_y - 9.8 - 0.8 * sad_factor),
				brow_col, 1.8, true
			)
			draw_line(
				Vector2(right_eye.x - 4.5, eye_y - 9.8 - 0.8 * sad_factor),
				Vector2(right_eye.x + 5.5, eye_y - 7.5 + 1.0 * sad_factor),
				brow_col, 1.8, true
			)
			
			# Cute glistening tear droplets under eyes
			var tear_col := Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.85 * brow_alpha)
			var left_tear := left_eye + Vector2(-3.4, 7.2)
			var right_tear := right_eye + Vector2(3.4, 7.2)
			draw_circle(left_tear, 1.6 * sad_factor, tear_col)
			draw_circle(left_tear + Vector2(-0.4, -0.4), 0.5 * sad_factor, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9 * brow_alpha))
			draw_circle(right_tear, 1.4 * sad_factor, tear_col)
			draw_circle(right_tear + Vector2(-0.3, -0.3), 0.45 * sad_factor, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9 * brow_alpha))
			
			# Sad little downturned mouth (quivering lip)
			_draw_sad_mouth(Vector2(center.x, eye_y + 9.5), sad_factor)

func _draw_ellipse(c: Vector2, r: Vector2, color: Color) -> void:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var segs := 18
	for i in range(segs):
		var th := float(i) * 2.0 * PI / float(segs)
		pts.append(c + Vector2(cos(th) * r.x, sin(th) * r.y))
	draw_colored_polygon(pts, color)

func _draw_happy_eye(c: Vector2) -> void:
	# Curved upward arc
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var segs := 8
	var r := 4.5
	for i in range(segs + 1):
		var th := PI + float(i) * PI / float(segs)
		pts.append(c + Vector2(cos(th) * r, sin(th) * 3.0))
	draw_polyline(pts, Color.WHITE, 2.2, true)

func _draw_sad_mouth(c: Vector2, factor: float) -> void:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
	var segs := 6
	var r := 3.2 * factor
	for i in range(segs + 1):
		var th := float(i) * PI / float(segs)
		pts.append(c + Vector2(-r * cos(th), -1.8 * sin(th) * factor))
	draw_polyline(pts, Color(0.85, 0.9, 1.0, 0.75 * factor), 1.5, true)

func _on_card_draw() -> void:
	if not card: return
	var s := card.size
	var arm := 12.0
	var c := Color(0.85, 0.90, 1.0, 0.55)
	var w := 1.5
	var m := 6.0
	
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, m + arm), Vector2(m, m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, m), Vector2(m + arm, m), c, w)
	
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m - arm, m), Vector2(s.x - m, m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m, m), Vector2(s.x - m, m + arm), c, w)
	
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, s.y - m - arm), Vector2(m, s.y - m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, s.y - m), Vector2(m + arm, s.y - m), c, w)
	
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m - arm, s.y - m), Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m), Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m - arm), c, w)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE or event.keycode == KEY_P:
			if settings_modal and settings_modal.visible:
				return
			if visible:
				_on_resume_pressed()
			elif GameManager.is_level_running:
				open_pause()

func open_pause() -> void:
	_update_texts()
	visible = true
	get_tree().paused = true
	if card:
		card.queue_redraw()
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SoundManager.set_music_volume_pause(true)

func _on_resume_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SoundManager.set_music_volume_pause(false)
	visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false

func _on_restart_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SoundManager.set_music_volume_pause(false)
	visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	GameManager.restart_current_level()

func _on_settings_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if settings_modal:
		settings_modal.open()

func _on_levels_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SoundManager.set_music_volume_pause(false)
	visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm:
		sm.navigation_source = "game_pause"
		sm.return_level_num = GameManager.current_level_id
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/main/level_select.tscn")

func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	SoundManager.set_music_volume_pause(false)
	visible = false
	get_tree().paused = false
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm:
		sm.navigation_source = "home_menu"
		sm.should_restore_result_modal = false
	GameManager.go_to_main_menu()

func _setup_avatar_buttons() -> void:
	if not avatar_grid:
		return
		
	for child in avatar_grid.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	avatar_buttons.clear()
	
	for i in range(AVATAR_KEYS.size()):
		var idx: int = i + 1
		var av_key: String = AVATAR_KEYS[i]
		
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56, 56)
		btn.size = Vector2(56, 56)
		btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon(av_key, 0.9)
		btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		btn.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		
		btn.pressed.connect(func():
			selected_avatar_idx = idx
			_update_avatar_preview()
			_refresh_avatar_grid_styles()
			var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
			if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
				sm.play("click")
		)
		
		avatar_grid.add_child(btn)
		avatar_buttons.append(btn)
		
	_refresh_avatar_grid_styles()

func _refresh_avatar_grid_styles() -> void:
	for i in range(avatar_buttons.size()):
		var btn: Button = avatar_buttons[i]
		var idx: int = i + 1
		var is_selected: bool = (idx == selected_avatar_idx)
		
		var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		style.set_corner_radius_all(14)
		style.corner_detail = 12
		
		if is_selected:
			style.bg_color = Color(0.12, 0.20, 0.32, 0.95)
			style.border_color = Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 1.0)
			style.set_border_width_all(2)
			style.shadow_color = Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.45)
			style.shadow_size = 6
		else:
			style.bg_color = Color(0.06, 0.09, 0.14, 0.75)
			style.border_color = Color(0.20, 0.28, 0.42, 0.5)
			style.set_border_width_all(1)
			
		var style_hov := style.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
		if not is_selected:
			style_hov.bg_color = Color(0.10, 0.15, 0.24, 0.9)
			style_hov.border_color = Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.7)
			
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", style)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", style_hov)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", style)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", style)

func _update_avatar_preview() -> void:
	if avatar_preview:
		var key_idx := (selected_avatar_idx - 1) % AVATAR_KEYS.size()
		if key_idx < 0: key_idx = 0
		var av_key := AVATAR_KEYS[key_idx]
		avatar_preview.texture = IconFactory.get_icon(av_key, 1.0)

func _load_stats() -> void:
	var save_sys = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if save_sys:
		if stars_label and save_sys.has_method("get_total_stars"):
			stars_label.text = "%d Yulduz" % save_sys.get_total_stars()
		if levels_label:
			var cur_lvl: int = 1
			if save_sys.has_method("get_highest_completed_level"):
				cur_lvl = save_sys.get_highest_completed_level()
			elif save_sys.has_method("get_highest_unlocked_level"):
				cur_lvl = save_sys.get_highest_unlocked_level()
			if cur_lvl <= 0:
				cur_lvl = 1
			levels_label.text = "%d-Daraja" % cur_lvl
		if best_label and save_sys.has_method("get_overall_best_text"):
			var best_str: String = save_sys.get_overall_best_text()
			if best_str != "Mavjud emas" and not best_str.is_empty():
				var time_part := best_str.split(" ")[0]
				best_label.text = time_part + " Rekord"
			else:
				best_label.text = "Rekord: —"

func _on_copy_tag() -> void:
	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(ProfileManager.player_tag)
	if copy_btn:
		copy_btn.text = ""
		copy_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("check", 0.75)
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_interval(1.2)
		tw.tween_callback(func():
			if copy_btn:
				copy_btn.text = ""
				copy_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("copy", 0.75)
		)
	_show_toast("ID nusxalandi: #" + ProfileManager.player_tag)

func _on_save_pressed() -> void:
	if not name_input:
		return
	var new_name := name_input.text.strip_edges()
	if new_name.is_empty():
		_show_toast("Ism bo'sh bo'lishi mumkin emas!")
		return
	if new_name.length() > 14:
		_show_toast("Ism 14 ta belgidan oshmasligi kerak!")
		return
		
	if save_btn:
		save_btn.disabled = true
		
	ProfileManager.update_profile(new_name, selected_avatar_idx)
	_show_toast("Profil muvaffaqiyatli saqlandi!")
	
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SoundManager")
	if sm and sm.has_method("play"):
		sm.play("click")
		
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.55).timeout
	if save_btn:
		save_btn.disabled = false
	close()

func _show_toast(msg: String) -> void:
	if toast_label:
		toast_label.text = msg
		toast_label.modulate.a = 1.0
		var tween := create_tween()
		tween.tween_property(toast_label, "modulate:a", 0.0, 2.0)

@onready var sound_vol_label: Label = get_node_or_null("Card/Content/SoundVolRow/SoundVolLabel")
@onready var sound_vol_slider: HSlider = get_node_or_null("Card/Content/SoundVolRow/SoundVolSlider")
