var style_white = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_white.tres")
var style_white_hov = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_white_hover.tres")
var style_white_press = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_white_pressed.tres")
var style_glass = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_glass.tres")
var style_glass_hov = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_glass_hover.tres")
var style_glass_press = preload("res://resources/themes/btn_capsule_glass_pressed.tres")

func _ready() -> void:
	visible = false
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	
	if card:
		card.draw.connect(_on_card_draw)
	
	_setup_icons()
	_setup_signals()
	_update_ui_texts()
	_update_toggles()
	_update_lang_buttons()

func _setup_icons() -> void:
	if title_icon_rect: title_icon_rect.texture = IconFactory.get_icon("gear", 1.1)
	if lang_icon_rect: lang_icon_rect.texture = IconFactory.get_icon("globe", 0.9)
	if close_btn:
		close_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("circle_btn_close", 1.0)
		close_btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		close_btn.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if music_vol_slider:
		music_vol_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber", IconFactory.get_icon("slider_grabber", 1.0))
		music_vol_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber_highlight", IconFactory.get_icon("slider_grabber_hover", 1.0))
	if sound_vol_slider:
		sound_vol_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber", IconFactory.get_icon("slider_grabber", 1.0))
		sound_vol_slider.add_theme_icon_override("grabber_highlight", IconFactory.get_icon("slider_grabber_hover", 1.0))

func _setup_signals() -> void:
	if btn_uz: btn_uz.pressed.connect(func(): _select_language("uz"))
	if btn_ru: btn_ru.pressed.connect(func(): _select_language("ru"))
	if btn_en: btn_en.pressed.connect(func(): _select_language("en"))
	if btn_tr: btn_tr.pressed.connect(func(): _select_language("tr"))
	
	if music_toggle_btn:
		music_toggle_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			SaveManager.music_enabled = not SaveManager.music_enabled
			SaveManager.save_data()
			SoundManager.set_music_enabled(SaveManager.music_enabled)
			_update_toggles()
		)

	if music_vol_slider:
		music_vol_slider.value_changed.connect(func(val: float):
			if music_vol_percent: music_vol_percent.text = "%d%%" % int(val)
			SaveManager.music_volume = clampf(val / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			SaveManager.save_data()
			SoundManager.update_music_volume(false)
		)
		
	if sound_toggle_btn:
		sound_toggle_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			SaveManager.sfx_enabled = not SaveManager.sfx_enabled
			SaveManager.save_data()
			_update_toggles()
		)

	if sound_vol_slider:
		sound_vol_slider.value_changed.connect(func(val: float):
			if sound_vol_percent: sound_vol_percent.text = "%d%%" % int(val)
			SaveManager.sfx_volume = clampf(val / 100.0, 0.0, 1.0)
			SaveManager.save_data()
			SoundManager.update_sfx_volume()
		)
		
	if shake_toggle_btn:
		shake_toggle_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			SaveManager.shake_enabled = not SaveManager.shake_enabled
			SaveManager.save_data()
			_update_toggles()
		)
		
	if customize_controls_btn:
		customize_controls_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			if control_customizer:
				control_customizer.open()
		)
		
	if close_btn:
		close_btn.pressed.connect(func():
			SoundManager.play("click")
			close()
		)
		
	if backdrop:
		backdrop.gui_input.connect(func(event: InputEvent):
			if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
				SoundManager.play("click")
				close()
		)

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if visible and event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
		if event.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
			SoundManager.play("click")
			close()
			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _on_card_draw() -> void:
	if not card: return
	var s := card.size
	var arm := 12.0
	var c := Color(0.85, 0.90, 1.0, 0.55)
	var w := 1.5
	var m := 6.0
	
	# Top-Left ┌
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, m + arm), Vector2(m, m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, m), Vector2(m + arm, m), c, w)
	
	# Top-Right ┐
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m - arm, m), Vector2(s.x - m, m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m, m), Vector2(s.x - m, m + arm), c, w)
	
	# Bottom-Left └
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, s.y - m - arm), Vector2(m, s.y - m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(m, s.y - m), Vector2(m + arm, s.y - m), c, w)
	
	# Bottom-Right ┘
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m - arm, s.y - m), Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m), c, w)
	card.draw_line(Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m), Vector2(s.x - m, s.y - m - arm), c, w)

func open() -> void:
	_update_ui_texts()
	_update_toggles()
	_update_lang_buttons()
	visible = true
	if card:
		card.queue_redraw()

func close() -> void:
	visible = false
	closed.emit()

func _select_language(lang: String) -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	LocaleManager.set_language(lang)
	_update_ui_texts()
	_update_lang_buttons()
	_update_toggles()

func _update_ui_texts() -> void:
	if title_label: title_label.text = LocaleManager.t("settings_title")
	if lang_label: lang_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_language")
	if music_label: music_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_music")
	if music_vol_label: music_vol_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_music_volume")
	if sound_label: sound_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_sound")
	if sound_vol_label: sound_vol_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_sound_volume")
	if shake_label: shake_label.text = LocaleManager.t("setting_shake")
	if controls_title: controls_title.text = LocaleManager.t("controls_title")
	if controls_desc: controls_desc.text = LocaleManager.t("controls_desc")
	if customize_controls_btn:
		customize_controls_btn.text = "  " + LocaleManager.t("btn_customize_controls")
		customize_controls_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("gamepad", 0.85)

func _update_lang_buttons() -> void:
	var cur := LocaleManager.current_language
	_style_btn(btn_uz, cur == "uz")
	_style_btn(btn_ru, cur == "ru")
	_style_btn(btn_en, cur == "en")
	_style_btn(btn_tr, cur == "tr")

func _style_btn(btn: Button, active: bool) -> void:

extends Control

# Wrong Way - High-End Commercial Splash & Loading Screen
# - Atmospheric Ken Burns background camera drift
# - Volumetric vignette & glow-pulsing logo
# - Animated loading progress bar with cycling hints
# - On 100% load:
#     * Returning/Authenticated player: Prominent "BOSHLASH" (START) prompt with player greeting
#     * New/First-time player: Clear Google & Guest choice
# - Seamless crossfade into Main Menu

@onready var bg_texture: TextureRect = $Background
@onready var vignette: ColorRect = $Vignette
@onready var logo_container: VBoxContainer = $CenterBox
@onready var bottom_box: VBoxContainer = $BottomBox
@onready var progress_bar: ProgressBar = $BottomBox/ProgressBar
@onready var status_label: Label = $BottomBox/StatusLabel
@onready var version_label: Label = $BottomBox/VersionLabel

@onready var auth_box: VBoxContainer = get_node_or_null("AuthBox")
@onready var auth_title: Label = get_node_or_null("AuthBox/AuthTitle")
@onready var google_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("AuthBox/GoogleBtn")
@onready var guest_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("AuthBox/GuestBtn")
@onready var auth_hint: Label = get_node_or_null("AuthBox/AuthHint")

@onready var start_box: VBoxContainer = get_node_or_null("StartBox")
@onready var greeting_label: Label = get_node_or_null("StartBox/GreetingLabel")
@onready var start_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("StartBox/StartBtn")
@onready var switch_account_btn: Button = get_node_or_null("StartBox/SwitchAccountBtn")

@onready var auth_modal: Control = get_node_or_null("AuthModal")
@onready var curtain: ColorRect = $Curtain

var load_progress: float = 0.0
var target_progress: float = 0.0
var is_transitioning: bool = false
var pulse_tween: Tween

const HINTS := [
	"Sozlamalar va saqlangan o'yinlar tekshirilmoqda...",
	"Tuzoqlarning barcha mexanizmlari yashirilmoqda...",
	"Hech qachon pol va eshiklarga ko'r-ko'rona ishonmang...",
	"Supabase global serveriga ulanmoqda...",
	"Hamma narsa tayyor. Qorong'u olamga xush kelibsiz!"
]

func _ready() -> void:
	if curtain:
		curtain.modulate.a = 1.0
		var fade_in := create_tween()
		fade_in.tween_property(curtain, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.45)

	if progress_bar:
		progress_bar.value = 0.0

	if auth_box:
		auth_box.visible = false
		auth_box.modulate.a = 0.0

	if start_box:
		start_box.visible = false
		start_box.modulate.a = 0.0

	_setup_buttons()
	_update_hint(0)
	_start_background_drift()
	_apply_safe_insets()
	get_viewport().size_changed.connect(_apply_safe_insets)
	_run_loading_flow()

func _apply_safe_insets() -> void:
	var insets := UIResponsive.get_safe_insets(self)
	var b_margin: float = float(insets.get("bottom", 0.0))
	if bottom_box:
		bottom_box.offset_bottom = -30.0 - b_margin
	if auth_box:
		auth_box.offset_bottom = -25.0 - b_margin
	if start_box:
		start_box.offset_bottom = -25.0 - b_margin

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if start_box and start_box.visible and not is_transitioning:
		if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
			if event.keycode == KEY_SPACE or event.keycode == KEY_ENTER:
				_on_start_pressed()
				get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func _setup_buttons() -> void:
	if google_btn:
		google_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("google", 1.0)
		google_btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		google_btn.pressed.connect(_on_google_pressed)

	if guest_btn:
		guest_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("guest_user", 1.0)
		guest_btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT
		guest_btn.pressed.connect(_on_guest_pressed)

	if start_btn:
		start_btn.icon = null
		start_btn.pressed.connect(_on_start_pressed)

	if switch_account_btn:
		switch_account_btn.pressed.connect(_on_switch_account_pressed)

	if auth_modal and auth_modal.has_signal("auth_completed"):
		auth_modal.auth_completed.connect(_on_auth_completed)

	GoogleAuthService.auth_succeeded.connect(func(_u):
		ProfileManager.has_chosen_auth = true
		ProfileManager.save_profile()
		if greeting_label:
			greeting_label.text = "Xush kelibsiz, " + ProfileManager.username + "!"
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.3).timeout
		_finish_and_open_main_menu()
	)
	GoogleAuthService.auth_failed.connect(func(err):
		print("SplashScreen: Google kirish xatosi: ", err)
	)

func _start_background_drift() -> void:
	if not bg_texture:
		return
	bg_texture.pivot_offset = Vector2(480, 270)
	var tween := create_tween().set_loops()
	tween.tween_property(bg_texture, "scale", Vector2(1.04, 1.04), 3.5).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)
	tween.tween_property(bg_texture, "scale", Vector2(1.0, 1.0), 3.5).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_SINE).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN_OUT)

func _update_hint(idx: int) -> void:
	if status_label and idx < HINTS.size():
		var tween := create_tween()
		tween.tween_property(status_label, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.12)
		tween.tween_callback(func():
			status_label.text = HINTS[idx]
		)
		tween.tween_property(status_label, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.18)

func _run_loading_flow() -> void:
	# 1-bosqich: Baza va o'yin holati
	target_progress = 25.0
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.35).timeout
	_update_hint(1)

	# 2-bosqich: Tuzoqlar va darajalar
	target_progress = 60.0
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.40).timeout
	_update_hint(2)

	# 3-bosqich: Server
	target_progress = 85.0
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.35).timeout
	_update_hint(3)

	# 4-bosqich: Tayyor
	target_progress = 100.0
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.30).timeout
	_update_hint(4)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.25).timeout

	_show_auth_selection()

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if load_progress < target_progress:
		load_progress = move_toward(load_progress, target_progress, delta * 120.0)
		if progress_bar:
			progress_bar.value = load_progress

func _show_auth_selection() -> void:
	# Loading barni silliq yashiramiz
	var tween := create_tween()
	if bottom_box:
		tween.tween_property(bottom_box, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.25)
		tween.tween_callback(func(): bottom_box.visible = false)

	# Foydalanuvchi allaqachon hisob tanlaganmi / tizimga kirganmi?
	var is_established: bool = ProfileManager.has_chosen_auth or (ProfileManager.auth_provider == "google" and not ProfileManager.email.is_empty()) or (not ProfileManager.player_id.is_empty() and ProfileManager.username != "Player")

	if is_established:
		# Avvaldan kirgan o'yinchiga qayta Google/Guest chiqmaydi, uning o'rniga "BOSHLASH" chiqadi!
		if greeting_label:
			greeting_label.text = "Xush kelibsiz, " + ProfileManager.username + "!"
		if start_box:
			start_box.visible = true
			start_box.modulate.a = 0.0
			tween.tween_property(start_box, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3)
			_pulse_start_button(start_btn)
	else:
		# Birinchi marta yangi o'yinchiga kirish usuli taklif etiladi
		if auth_title:
			auth_title.text = "O'yinga kirish usulini tanlang:"
		if google_btn:
			google_btn.text = "   Google orqali kirish"
		if guest_btn:
			guest_btn.text = "   Mehmon sifatida davom etish"
		if auth_hint:
			auth_hint.text = "Hisob bilan yutuqlaringiz bulutda saqlanadi"

		if auth_box:
			auth_box.visible = true
			auth_box.modulate.a = 0.0
			tween.tween_property(auth_box, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.3)

func _pulse_start_button(btn: Button) -> void:
	if not btn:
		return
	if pulse_tween and pulse_tween.is_valid():
		pulse_tween.kill()
	pulse_tween = create_tween().set_loops()

		return

	if curtain:

		fade_out.tween_property(curtain, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.40).set_trans(Tween.TRANS_CUBIC).set_ease(Tween.EASE_IN)
		await fade_out.finished

	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/main/main_menu.tscn")

class_name WinOverlay

@onready var crown_icon: TextureRect = $CrownIcon
@onready var spotlight_fx: Control = $SpotlightFX
@onready var line_accent: Control = $LineAccent

var last_lvl: int = 1
var last_time_ms: float = 0.0
var last_deaths: int = 0
var last_stars: int = 1
var anim_time: float = 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
	visible = false
	GameManager.level_completed.connect(_on_level_completed)
	GameManager.level_started.connect(func(_lvl): visible = false)
	DuelService.match_finished.connect(_on_duel_match_finished)

	if next_btn: next_btn.pressed.connect(_on_next_pressed)
	if replay_btn: replay_btn.pressed.connect(_on_replay_pressed)
	if map_btn: map_btn.pressed.connect(_on_map_pressed)
	if home_btn: home_btn.pressed.connect(_on_home_pressed)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if visible and crown_icon:
		anim_time += delta * 2.0
		# Crown yumshoq yuqoriga-pastga tebranishi
		crown_icon.position.y = 85.0 + sin(anim_time) * 3.5

func _setup_icons() -> void:
	if crown_icon:
		crown_icon.texture = IconFactory.get_icon("crown", 1.8)
	if next_btn:
		next_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("play_dark", 0.85)
	if replay_btn:
		replay_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("restart", 0.8)
	if map_btn:
		map_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("circle_btn_back", 1.0)
		map_btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		map_btn.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	if home_btn:
		home_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("circle_btn_home", 1.0)
		home_btn.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		home_btn.vertical_icon_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER

func _on_spotlight_draw() -> void:
	if not spotlight_fx: return
	var center_x := spotlight_fx.size.x * 0.5
	
	# Yumshoq spotlight nuri (tepadan pastga kengayuvchi)
	var top_w := 60.0
	var bot_w := 240.0
	var beam_h := 380.0
	
	var outer_poly := PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(center_x - top_w, 0.0),
		Vector2(center_x + top_w, 0.0),
		Vector2(center_x + bot_w, beam_h),
		Vector2(center_x - bot_w, beam_h)
	])
	spotlight_fx.draw_colored_polygon(outer_poly, Color(0.9, 0.95, 1.0, 0.04))
	
	var inner_poly := PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(center_x - 30.0, 0.0),
		Vector2(center_x + 30.0, 0.0),
		Vector2(center_x + 140.0, beam_h - 40.0),
		Vector2(center_x - 140.0, beam_h - 40.0)
	])
	spotlight_fx.draw_colored_polygon(inner_poly, Color(0.95, 0.98, 1.0, 0.03))
	
	# Yulduzlar atrofidagi olmos uchqunlari (reference rasmdagidek)
	var diamonds := [
		Vector2(center_x - 150.0, 160.0), Vector2(center_x + 150.0, 150.0),
		Vector2(center_x - 180.0, 240.0), Vector2(center_x + 180.0, 245.0),
		Vector2(center_x - 130.0, 280.0), Vector2(center_x + 130.0, 285.0)
	]
	for pt in diamonds:
		_draw_diamond(spotlight_fx, pt, 3.5, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35))

func _draw_diamond(canvas: Control, center: Vector2, r: float, col: Color) -> void:
	var pts := PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(center.x, center.y - r),
		Vector2(center.x + r, center.y),
		Vector2(center.x, center.y + r),
		Vector2(center.x - r, center.y)
	])
	canvas.draw_colored_polygon(pts, col)

func _on_line_accent_draw() -> void:
	if not line_accent: return
	var w := line_accent.size.x
	var cy := line_accent.size.y / 2.0
	var cx := w / 2.0
	
	# Markazida uzilish bo'lgan nafis chiziq
	var col_edge := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.05)
	var col_mid := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.45)
	line_accent.draw_line(Vector2(20, cy), Vector2(cx - 30, cy), col_mid, 1.0)
	line_accent.draw_line(Vector2(cx + 30, cy), Vector2(w - 20, cy), col_mid, 1.0)
	# Markaziy olmos
	_draw_diamond(line_accent, Vector2(cx, cy), 3.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6))

func _on_language_changed(_lang: String) -> void:
	if visible:
		_render_win_data()

func restore_result(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	if data.is_empty():
		return
	_on_level_completed(
		data.get("lvl", GameManager.current_level_id),
		data.get("time_ms", 0.0),
		data.get("deaths", 0),
		data.get("stars", 1)
	)

func _on_level_completed(lvl: int, time_ms: float, deaths: int, stars: int) -> void:
	last_lvl = lvl
	last_time_ms = time_ms
	last_deaths = deaths
	last_stars = stars
	
	if GameManager.is_duel_mode:
		# Duel rejimida finishni serverga yuborish
		DuelService.claim_finish(time_ms, deaths)
		return

	_render_win_data()
	visible = true
	if spotlight_fx: spotlight_fx.queue_redraw()
	if line_accent: line_accent.queue_redraw()

func _on_duel_match_finished(is_victory: bool, _winner_id: String) -> void:
	if not GameManager.is_duel_mode:
		return
	get_tree().paused = true
	visible = true
	
	if last_time_ms <= 0.0:
		last_time_ms = float(Time.get_ticks_msec()) - GameManager.level_start_time
		last_deaths = GameManager.level_deaths
	
	if is_victory:
		if win_title: win_title.text = "VICTORY"
		if subtitle: subtitle.text = "Siz duelda g'alaba qozondingiz!"
		SoundManager.play("win")
	else:
		if win_title: win_title.text = "DEFEAT"
		if subtitle: subtitle.text = "Raqibingiz marraga birinchi yetdi!"
		SoundManager.play("death")
		
	if stats_label:
		var time_sec: int = maxi(1, int(round(last_time_ms / 1000.0)))
		stats_label.text = "Vaqt: %ds   •   O'limlar: %d" % [time_sec, last_deaths]
		
	if next_btn:
		next_btn.text = "  Lobbyga qaytish"
		next_btn.visible = true
		
	if spotlight_fx: spotlight_fx.queue_redraw()
	if line_accent: line_accent.queue_redraw()

func _render_win_data() -> void:
	if win_title:
		win_title.text = "LEVEL COMPLETE"
	
	if subtitle:
		subtitle.text = LocaleManager.t("great_job")
		
	# 3 ta katta yulduz (glowing oq yulduzlar)
	if star_box:
		for child in star_box.get_children():
			child.queue_free()
		for s in range(3):
			var is_earned := (s < last_stars)
			var icon_key := "star_white" if is_earned else "star_dim"
			var star_icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect(icon_key, Vector2(44, 44), 1.7)
			star_box.add_child(star_icon)
			
	if stats_label:
		var time_sec: int = maxi(1, int(round(last_time_ms / 1000.0)))
		stats_label.text = "Vaqt: %ds   •   O'limlar: %d" % [time_sec, last_deaths]
		
	if next_btn:
		next_btn.text = "  " + LocaleManager.t("btn_next_lvl")
		# 2+ yulduz olingan bo'lsa va 60-darajadan kichik bo'lsa keyingi daraja faol
		next_btn.visible = (last_stars >= 2 and last_lvl < 60)
		
	if replay_btn:
		replay_btn.text = "  " + LocaleManager.t("btn_restart")

func _on_next_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	visible = false
	if GameManager.is_duel_mode:
		GameManager.is_duel_mode = false
		get_tree().paused = false
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/multiplayer/multiplayer_menu.tscn")
		return
	GameManager.start_game(last_lvl + 1)

func _on_replay_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	visible = false
	if GameManager.is_duel_mode:
		get_tree().paused = false
		last_time_ms = 0.0
		if DuelService.is_bot_duel:
			var ch: int = 1 if last_lvl <= 20 else (2 if last_lvl <= 40 else 3)
			var lvl_in_ch: int = ((last_lvl - 1) % 20) + 1
			DuelService.setup_bot_duel(ch, lvl_in_ch)
			GameManager.start_duel_game(last_lvl, randi())
			return
		else:
			GameManager.is_duel_mode = false
			get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/multiplayer/multiplayer_menu.tscn")
			return
	GameManager.start_game(last_lvl)

func _on_map_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	visible = false
	if GameManager.is_duel_mode:
		GameManager.is_duel_mode = false
		get_tree().paused = false
		get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/multiplayer/multiplayer_menu.tscn")
		return
	var sm = get_node_or_null("/root/SaveManager")
	if sm:
		sm.navigation_source = "result_modal"
		sm.return_level_num = last_lvl
		sm.should_restore_result_modal = true
		sm.pending_result_data = {
			"lvl": last_lvl,
			"time_ms": last_time_ms,
			"deaths": last_deaths,
			"stars": last_stars
		}
	GameManager.go_to_level_select()

func _on_home_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")

extends Node

const SAVE_DIR := "user://custom_levels/"
const MAX_SLOTS := 5
const GRID_SIZE := 32

func _ready() -> void:
	ensure_directory()

func ensure_directory() -> void:
	if not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(SAVE_DIR):
		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(SAVE_DIR)

func get_slot_path(slot: int) -> String:
	return SAVE_DIR + "custom_level_%d.json" % slot

func save_custom_level(slot: int, data: Dictionary) -> bool:
	ensure_directory()
	var file_path := get_slot_path(slot)
	var file := FileAccess.open(file_path, FileAccess.WRITE)
	if file == null:
		push_error("CustomLevelManager: Fayl ochib bo'lmadi: " + file_path)
		return false
	
	var json_string := JSON.stringify(data, "\t")
	file.store_string(json_string)
	file.close()
	return true

func load_custom_level(slot: int) -> Dictionary:
	var file_path := get_slot_path(slot)
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(file_path):
		return get_default_level()
		
	var file := FileAccess.open(file_path, FileAccess.READ)
	if file == null:
		return get_default_level()
		
	var content := file.get_as_text()
	file.close()
	
	var json := JSON.new()
	var err := json.parse(content)
	if err != OK or not (json.data is Dictionary):
		push_warning("CustomLevelManager: JSON o'qishda xatolik, standart daraja yuklanadi")
		return get_default_level()
		
	return json.data as Dictionary

func get_default_level() -> Dictionary:
	var default_elements: Array = []
	
	# Chap devor (gx = 0, gy = 3..12)
	for gy in range(3, 13):
		default_elements.append({"type": "platform", "gx": 0, "gy": gy, "x": 0, "y": gy * 32})
	
	# O'ng devor (gx = 29, gy = 3..12)
	for gy in range(3, 13):
		default_elements.append({"type": "platform", "gx": 29, "gy": gy, "x": 29 * 32, "y": gy * 32})
		
	# Chap pol (gx = 1..10, gy = 12)
	for gx in range(1, 11):
		default_elements.append({"type": "platform", "gx": gx, "gy": 12, "x": gx * 32, "y": 12 * 32})
		
	# O'rta tuzoq pol (gx = 11..14, gy = 12)
	for gx in range(11, 15):
		default_elements.append({"type": "trap_floor", "gx": gx, "gy": 12, "x": gx * 32, "y": 12 * 32})
		
	# O'ng pol (gx = 15..28, gy = 12)
	for gx in range(15, 29):
		default_elements.append({"type": "platform", "gx": gx, "gy": 12, "x": gx * 32, "y": 12 * 32})
		
	# Boshlang'ich tikanlar (gx = 19..20, gy = 11) - pol ustida
	default_elements.append({"type": "spikes", "gx": 19, "gy": 11, "x": 19 * 32, "y": 11 * 32})
	default_elements.append({"type": "spikes", "gx": 20, "gy": 11, "x": 20 * 32, "y": 11 * 32})

	return {
		"name": "Mening Zonam",
		"player_spawn": [144, 384],
		"exit_door": [848, 384],
		"elements": default_elements
	}

	card_hov_style.corner_radius_top_left = 8
	card_hov_style.corner_radius_top_right = 8
	card_hov_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 8
	card_hov_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 8
	
	card_act_style.bg_color = Color("#182234")
	card_act_style.border_color = Color("#f8fafc") # Oq nurli faol hoshiya
	card_act_style.border_width_left = 2
	card_act_style.border_width_top = 2
	card_act_style.border_width_right = 2
	card_act_style.border_width_bottom = 2
	card_act_style.corner_radius_top_left = 8
	card_act_style.corner_radius_top_right = 8
	card_act_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 8
	card_act_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 8

func _setup_palette_scroll() -> void:
	if palette_scroll:
		palette_scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER
		palette_scroll.vertical_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_SHOW_NEVER
		palette_scroll.gui_input.connect(_on_palette_gui_input)

func _on_palette_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			if mb.pressed:
				is_palette_dragging = true
				palette_drag_start_x = mb.global_position.x
				palette_scroll_start_x = float(palette_scroll.scroll_horizontal)
			else:
				is_palette_dragging = false
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion and is_palette_dragging:
		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		var diff := palette_drag_start_x - mm.global_position.x
		palette_scroll.scroll_horizontal = clampi(int(palette_scroll_start_x + diff), 0, 1000)

func _setup_slots() -> void:
	if not slot_btn: return
	
	# 1. OptionButton o'zining zamonaviy dizayni
	slot_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(115, 36)
	var btn_norm := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	btn_norm.bg_color = Color("#171524")
	btn_norm.border_color = Color("#3d3652")
	btn_norm.border_width_left = 1
	btn_norm.border_width_top = 1
	btn_norm.border_width_right = 1
	btn_norm.border_width_bottom = 1
	btn_norm.corner_radius_top_left = 8
	btn_norm.corner_radius_top_right = 8
	btn_norm.corner_radius_bottom_right = 8
	btn_norm.corner_radius_bottom_left = 8
	btn_norm.content_margin_left = 12.0
	btn_norm.content_margin_right = 12.0
	slot_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", btn_norm)
	
	var btn_hov := btn_norm.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	btn_hov.border_color = Color("#8b5cf6") # Neon binafsha hoshiya
	btn_hov.bg_color = Color("#221d33")
	slot_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", btn_hov)
	
	var btn_press := btn_norm.duplicate() as StyleBoxFlat
	btn_press.border_color = Color("#a78bfa")
	btn_press.bg_color = Color("#2b2440")
	slot_btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", btn_press)
	
	slot_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#f1f5f9"))
	slot_btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)

	# 2. Ochiladigan PopupMenu (Dropdown) dizayni
	var popup: PopupMenu = slot_btn.get_popup()
	if popup:
		var pop_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		pop_style.bg_color = Color(0.10, 0.09, 0.15, 0.98) # Dark obsidian slate
		pop_style.border_color = Color(0.38, 0.32, 0.52, 0.95) # Chiroyli binafsharang hoshiya
		pop_style.border_width_left = 1
		pop_style.border_width_top = 1
		pop_style.border_width_right = 1
		pop_style.border_width_bottom = 1
		pop_style.corner_radius_top_left = 10
		pop_style.corner_radius_top_right = 10
		pop_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 10
		pop_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 10
		pop_style.content_margin_left = 8.0
		pop_style.content_margin_right = 8.0
		pop_style.content_margin_top = 8.0
		pop_style.content_margin_bottom = 8.0
		pop_style.shadow_color = Color(0, 0, 0, 0.65)
		pop_style.shadow_size = 14
		popup.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", pop_style)
		
		var hover_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
		hover_style.bg_color = Color(0.22, 0.18, 0.32, 0.95)
		hover_style.border_color = Color(0.22, 0.85, 0.45, 1.0) # Chap tomondagi neon yashil chiziq
		hover_style.border_width_left = 3
		hover_style.corner_radius_top_left = 6
		hover_style.corner_radius_top_right = 6
		hover_style.corner_radius_bottom_right = 6
		hover_style.corner_radius_bottom_left = 6
		hover_style.content_margin_left = 12.0
		hover_style.content_margin_right = 12.0
		hover_style.content_margin_top = 6.0
		hover_style.content_margin_bottom = 6.0
		popup.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover_style)
		
		popup.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.92, 0.90, 0.96))
		popup.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
		popup.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
		popup.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 6)
		popup.add_theme_constant_override("item_start_padding", 10)
		popup.add_theme_constant_override("item_end_padding", 10)
		popup.add_theme_constant_override("icon_max_width", 20)

	# 3. Elementlarni to'ldirish
	slot_btn.fit_to_longest_item = false
	slot_btn.clear()
	for i in range(1, 6):
		var file_path := CustomLevelManager.get_slot_path(i)
		var is_saved := FileAccess.file_exists(file_path)

		var item_text := "%s  •  %s" % [LocaleManager.t("slot_label", [i]), status_str]
		var item_icon := IconFactory.get_icon("slot_saved" if is_saved else "slot_empty", 0.8)
		
		slot_btn.add_icon_item(item_icon, item_text, i)

	slot_btn.add_icon_item(IconFactory.get_icon("restart", 0.75), " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_reload_current"), 99)
	
	_select_current_slot_in_dropdown()
	if not slot_btn.item_selected.is_connected(_on_slot_selected):

func _select_current_slot_in_dropdown() -> void:
	for i in range(slot_btn.item_count):
		if slot_btn.get_item_id(i) == current_slot:
			slot_btn.select(i)
			slot_btn.text = LocaleManager.t("slot_label", [current_slot])
			break

func _build_palette() -> void:
	for child in palette_container.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
	tool_cards.clear()
	
	for item in TOOLS:
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(70, 62)
		btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		btn.flat = false
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", card_norm_style)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", card_hov_style)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", card_act_style)
		
		# Ichki karta tartibi: Ikona yuqorida, Yozuv pastda
		var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
		vbox.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		vbox.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		vbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
		
		var icon_rect := TextureRect.new()
		icon_rect.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(26, 26)
		icon_rect.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
		icon_rect.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
		icon_rect.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		icon_rect.texture = IconFactory.get_icon(item.icon, 1.0)
		vbox.add_child(icon_rect)
		
		var lbl := Label.new()
		lbl.text = LocaleManager.t(item.loc_key)
		lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)
		lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#cbd5e1"))
		lbl.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		vbox.add_child(lbl)
		
		btn.add_child(vbox)
		btn.pressed.connect(func(): _select_tool(item.id))
		palette_container.add_child(btn)
		
		tool_cards[item.id] = {
			"btn": btn,
			"lbl": lbl,
			"loc_key": item.loc_key
		}
		
	_select_tool("platform")

func _select_tool(tool_id: String) -> void:
	current_tool = tool_id
	SoundManager.play("click")
	
	for id in tool_cards:
		var data = tool_cards[id]
		var btn: Button = data["btn"]
		var lbl: Label = data["lbl"]
		if id == current_tool:
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", card_act_style)
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", card_act_style)
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#4ade80"))
		else:
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", card_norm_style)
			btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", card_hov_style)
			lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color("#94a3b8"))

func _on_language_changed(_lang: String) -> void:
	_update_all_texts()

func _update_all_texts() -> void:
	if title_lbl: title_lbl.text = LocaleManager.t("editor_title")
	_setup_slots()
	if back_btn:
		back_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("arrow_left", 0.8)
		back_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_back")
	_set_save_mode(is_save_mode)
	if clear_btn:
		clear_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("trash", 0.8)
		clear_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_clear")
	if test_btn:
		test_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("play", 0.85)
		test_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_test")
	if stop_test_btn:
		stop_test_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("stop", 0.85)
		stop_test_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_stop_test")
		
	for id in tool_cards:
		var data = tool_cards[id]
		var lbl: Label = data["lbl"]
		lbl.text = LocaleManager.t(data["loc_key"])

func _snap_to_cell(pos: Vector2) -> Vector2i:
	var gx: int = clampi(int(pos.x / float(GRID_SIZE)), 0, _get_cols() - 1)
	var gy: int = clampi(int(pos.y / float(GRID_SIZE)), MIN_ROW, MAX_ROW)
	return Vector2i(gx, gy)

func _on_canvas_gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if is_testing:
		return
		
	if event is InputEventMouseButton:
		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
			is_pointer_down = mb.pressed
			if is_pointer_down:
				last_placed_cell = Vector2i(-1, -1)
				_apply_tool_at_pos(mb.position)
			else:
				last_placed_cell = Vector2i(-1, -1)
	elif event is InputEventMouseMotion:
		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
		hover_cell = _snap_to_cell(mm.position)
		if is_pointer_down:
			_apply_tool_at_pos(mm.position)
		canvas.queue_redraw()

func _apply_tool_at_pos(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var cell := _snap_to_cell(pos)
	if cell == last_placed_cell:
		return
	last_placed_cell = cell
	
	if not is_save_mode:
		_set_save_mode(true)
	
	var key := "%d_%d" % [cell.x, cell.y]
	
	if current_tool == "erase":
		if cell_map.has(key):
			cell_map.erase(key)
			SoundManager.play("click")
			canvas.queue_redraw()
		return
		
	if current_tool == "player":
		player_spawn = Vector2(cell.x * GRID_SIZE + 16, cell.y * GRID_SIZE + 32)
		SoundManager.play("click")
		canvas.queue_redraw()
		return
		
	if current_tool == "door":
		exit_door_pos = Vector2(cell.x * GRID_SIZE + 16, cell.y * GRID_SIZE + 32)
		SoundManager.play("click")
		canvas.queue_redraw()
		return
		
	# Boshqa katakli element joylashtirish
	var elem := {
		"type": current_tool,
		"gx": cell.x,
		"gy": cell.y,
		"x": cell.x * GRID_SIZE,
		"y": cell.y * GRID_SIZE
	}
	
	match current_tool:
		"platform", "trap_floor":
			pass
		"spikes", "pop_up_spikes":
			pass
		"saw":
			elem["move_distance"] = 64.0
		"circular_saw":
			elem["orbit_radius"] = 64.0
			elem["saw_radius"] = 20.0
		"spike_ball":
			elem["chain_length"] = 64.0
			elem["ball_radius"] = 16.0
		"crusher":
			pass
		"spring":
			elem["bounce_force"] = -580.0
		"falling":
			elem["trigger_dist"] = 280.0
		"laser":
			elem["beam_length"] = 160.0
		"fake_door":
			pass
			
	cell_map[key] = elem
	SoundManager.play("click")
	canvas.queue_redraw()

func _on_canvas_draw() -> void:
	var cw := _get_canvas_width()
	# 1. 32px to'r koordinata nuqtalari (qorong'i atmosfera nuqtalari)
	for x in range(0, int(cw) + GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE):
		for y in range(MIN_ROW * GRID_SIZE, (MAX_ROW + 1) * GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE):
			canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(x, y), 1.2, Color(0.20, 0.26, 0.38, 0.45))
			
	# Asosiy standart pol yo'naltiruvchi chiziq (Row 12, y=384)
	canvas.draw_dashed_line(Vector2(0, 12 * GRID_SIZE), Vector2(cw, 12 * GRID_SIZE), Color(0.35, 0.45, 0.65, 0.35), 1.2, 8.0)
	
	# Maydon chegaralari
	canvas.draw_line(Vector2(0, MIN_ROW * GRID_SIZE), Vector2(cw, MIN_ROW * GRID_SIZE), Color(0.18, 0.24, 0.35, 0.8), 1.5)
	canvas.draw_line(Vector2(0, (MAX_ROW + 1) * GRID_SIZE), Vector2(cw, (MAX_ROW + 1) * GRID_SIZE), Color(0.18, 0.24, 0.35, 0.8), 1.5)
	
	# 2. Joylashtirilgan elementlarni chizish
	for key in cell_map:
		_draw_cell_element(cell_map[key])
		
	# 3. Chiqish darvozasi va O'yinchi
	_draw_door(exit_door_pos)
	_draw_player(player_spawn)
	
	# 4. Kursor indikatori (Hover)
	if not is_testing:
		var hx: float = float(hover_cell.x * GRID_SIZE)
		var hy: float = float(hover_cell.y * GRID_SIZE)
		if current_tool == "crusher":
			# 2x2 katak (64x64px)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(hx, hy, 64.0, 64.0), Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.8), false, 2.0)
		elif current_tool == "door" or current_tool == "fake_door":
			# 1x2 katak (32x64px)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(hx, hy - 32.0, 32.0, 64.0), Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.8), false, 2.0)
		else:
			# Standart 1x1 katak (32x32px)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(hx, hy, float(GRID_SIZE), float(GRID_SIZE)), Color(0.85, 0.92, 1.0, 0.8), false, 2.0)

func _draw_cell_element(elem: Dictionary) -> void:
	var t: String = elem.get("type", "platform")
	var gx: int = int(elem.get("gx", 0))
	var gy: int = int(elem.get("gy", 0))
	var x: float = float(gx * GRID_SIZE)
	var y: float = float(gy * GRID_SIZE)
	var sz := float(GRID_SIZE)
	
	match t:
		"platform":
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y, sz, sz), Color("#0a0b10"), true)
			var above_key := "%d_%d" % [gx, gy - 1]
			if not cell_map.has(above_key) or cell_map[above_key].get("type") != "platform":
				canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y, sz, 2.0), Color("#262e3e"), true)
		"trap_floor":
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y, sz, sz), Color("#1e1218"), true)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x, y), Vector2(x + sz, y + sz), Color("#ef4444", 0.4), 1.5)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y, sz, 2.0), Color("#f87171"), true)
		"spikes":
			var pts1 := PackedVector2Array([
				Vector2(x + 2.0, y + sz),
				Vector2(x + 8.0, y + 8.0),
				Vector2(x + 14.0, y + sz)
			])
			var pts2 := PackedVector2Array([
				Vector2(x + 18.0, y + sz),
				Vector2(x + 24.0, y + 8.0),
				Vector2(x + 30.0, y + sz)
			])
			canvas.draw_colored_polygon(pts1, Color("#0c0e14"))
			canvas.draw_colored_polygon(pts2, Color("#0c0e14"))
			canvas.draw_line(pts1[0], pts1[1], Color("#3a455a"), 1.0)
			canvas.draw_line(pts2[0], pts2[1], Color("#3a455a"), 1.0)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y + sz - 2.0, sz, 2.0), Color("#181e28"), true)
		"pop_up_spikes":
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y + sz - 4.0, sz, 4.0), Color("#141822"), true)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 8, y + sz - 4), Vector2(x + 16, y + 14), Color("#ef4444"), 2.0)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 24, y + sz - 4), Vector2(x + 16, y + 14), Color("#ef4444"), 2.0)
		"saw":
			var c := Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
			canvas.draw_circle(c, 16.0, Color("#3f3f46"))
			canvas.draw_circle(c, 7.0, Color("#dc2626"))
			canvas.draw_circle(c, 2.5, Color("#f8fafc"))
			canvas.draw_dashed_line(c - Vector2(32, 0), c + Vector2(32, 0), Color(0.8, 0.4, 0.2, 0.4), 1.0, 4.0)
		"circular_saw":
			var center := Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
			var orad: float = float(elem.get("orbit_radius", 64.0))
			var srad: float = 16.0
			canvas.draw_arc(center, orad, 0, TAU, 32, Color(0.9, 0.4, 0.4, 0.25), 1.0)
			canvas.draw_circle(center, 4.0, Color("#334155"))
			var bpos := center + Vector2(orad, 0)
			canvas.draw_line(center, bpos, Color("#475569"), 2.0)
			canvas.draw_circle(bpos, srad, Color("#94a3b8"))
			canvas.draw_circle(bpos, srad * 0.65, Color("#dc2626"))
			canvas.draw_circle(bpos, 2.5, Color("#f8fafc"))
		"spike_ball":
			var m_center := Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
			var clen: float = float(elem.get("chain_length", 64.0))
			var brad: float = 11.0
			var m_bpos := m_center + Vector2(0, clen)
			canvas.draw_arc(m_center, clen, 0, TAU, 32, Color(0.8, 0.3, 0.3, 0.25), 1.0)
			canvas.draw_circle(m_center, 5.0, Color("#1e1b29"))
			canvas.draw_line(m_center, m_bpos, Color("#334155"), 2.0)
			canvas.draw_circle(m_bpos, brad, Color("#18181b"))
			for i in range(8):
				var ang := float(i) * (TAU / 8.0)
				var tip := m_bpos + Vector2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * (brad + 5.0)
				canvas.draw_line(m_bpos, tip, Color("#e11d48"), 2.0)
		"crusher":
			# 2x standart: 64x64px siluet blok
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x, y, 64, 64), Color("#0c0e14"), true)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x, y + 1), Vector2(x + 64, y + 1), Color("#2a3548"), 2.0)
			for i in range(4):
				var p1 := Vector2(x + float(i) * 16.0, y + 64.0)
				var p2 := Vector2(x + (float(i) + 0.5) * 16.0, y + 74.0)
				var p3 := Vector2(x + float(i + 1) * 16.0, y + 64.0)
				canvas.draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([p1, p2, p3]), Color("#0c0e14"))
				canvas.draw_line(p1, p2, Color("#2a3548"), 1.0)
		"spring":
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x + 2, y + sz - 6.0, sz - 4.0, 6.0), Color("#181e28"), true)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x + 4, y + 10.0, sz - 8.0, 4.0), Color("#f59e0b"), true)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 8, y + sz - 6), Vector2(x + sz - 8, y + 20), Color("#94a3b8"), 2.5)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + sz - 8, y + 20), Vector2(x + 8, y + 14), Color("#cbd5e1"), 2.5)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 8, y + 14), Vector2(x + 16, y + 10), Color("#94a3b8"), 2.5)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(x + 2, y + 6.0, sz - 4.0, 4.0), Color("#475569"), true)
		"falling":
			var f_pts := PackedVector2Array([
				Vector2(x, y),
				Vector2(x + sz, y),
				Vector2(x + 16.0, y + sz)
			])
			canvas.draw_colored_polygon(f_pts, Color("#e11d48"))
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x, y), Vector2(x + 16.0, y + sz), Color("#fb7185"), 1.2)
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 16.0, y + sz), Vector2(x + sz, y), Color("#881337"), 1.2)
		"laser":
			canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(x + 16, y + 6), 5.0, Color("#ef4444"))
			canvas.draw_line(Vector2(x + 16, y + 6), Vector2(x + 16, y + 160), Color(1.0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.65), 2.5)
		"fake_door":
			var fdw: float = 32.0
			var fdh: float = 56.0
			var fx: float = x
			var fy: float = y + sz - fdh
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(fx, fy, fdw, fdh), Color("#241433"), true)
			canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(fx, fy, fdw, 3.0), Color("#a855f7"), true)
			canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(fx + 10, fy + 32.0), 2.5, Color("#ef4444"))
			canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(fx + 22, fy + 32.0), 2.5, Color("#ef4444"))

func _draw_door(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	# Monumental glowing white portal arch (Exit Door)
	var dw: float = 44.0
	var dh: float = 58.0
	var half_w := dw / 2.0
	var post_w := 5.0
	var lintel_h := 5.5
	var dx := pos.x
	var dy := pos.y
	
	# Tashqi aura
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - half_w - 3.0, dy - dh - 3.0, dw + 6.0, dh + 3.0), Color(0.95, 0.98, 1.0, 0.20), true)
	
	# Qora ichki bo'shliq
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - half_w + post_w, dy - dh + lintel_h, dw - post_w * 2.0, dh - lintel_h), Color("#05070c"), true)
	
	# Nur ustuni
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - 7.0, dy - dh + lintel_h + 1.0, 14.0, dh - lintel_h - 1.0), Color(0.85, 0.95, 1.0, 0.45), true)
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - 2.5, dy - dh + lintel_h + 1.0, 5.0, dh - lintel_h - 1.0), Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.85), true)
	
	# Oq ramka
	var frame_col := Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - half_w, dy - dh, post_w, dh), frame_col, true)
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx + half_w - post_w, dy - dh, post_w, dh), frame_col, true)
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - half_w, dy - dh, dw, lintel_h), frame_col, true)
	canvas.draw_rect(Rect2(dx - half_w - 2.0, dy - dh, dw + 4.0, 2.5), frame_col, true)
	
	# Poydevor
	canvas.draw_line(Vector2(dx - half_w - 2.5, dy), Vector2(dx + half_w + 2.5, dy), frame_col, 2.0)
	
	# Ustidagi ▼ indikator
	var tri_pts := PackedVector2Array([
		Vector2(dx - 6.0, dy - dh - 10.0),
		Vector2(dx + 6.0, dy - dh - 10.0),
		Vector2(dx, dy - dh - 2.0)
	])
	canvas.draw_colored_polygon(tri_pts, frame_col)

func _draw_player(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var pw: float = 28.0
	var ph: float = 32.0
	var r := Rect2(pos.x - pw / 2.0, pos.y - ph, pw, ph)
	canvas.draw_rect(r, Color("#181520"), true)
	canvas.draw_rect(r, Color("#342f3a"), false, 1.2)
	# Ko'zlar
	canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(pos.x - 5, pos.y - 18), 3.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(pos.x + 5, pos.y - 18), 3.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 1))
	canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(pos.x - 4, pos.y - 18), 1.5, Color(0, 0, 0, 1))
	canvas.draw_circle(Vector2(pos.x + 6, pos.y - 18), 1.5, Color(0, 0, 0, 1))

# --- Playtest rejimi ---
func _on_test_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	is_testing = true
	top_bar.visible = false
	bottom_palette.visible = false
	canvas.visible = false
	playtest_ui.visible = true
	
	GameManager.is_custom_editor_mode = true
	_spawn_test_world()

func _on_stop_test_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	_clear_test_world()
	GameManager.is_custom_editor_mode = false
	is_testing = false
	
	playtest_ui.visible = false
	top_bar.visible = true
	bottom_palette.visible = true
	canvas.visible = true
	canvas.queue_redraw()

func _spawn_test_world() -> void:
	_clear_test_world()
	
	var processed_platforms: Dictionary = {}
	
	for key in cell_map:
		var elem: Dictionary = cell_map[key]
		var t: String = elem.get("type", "platform")
		var gx: int = int(elem.get("gx", 0))
		var gy: int = int(elem.get("gy", 0))
		var x: float = float(gx * GRID_SIZE)
		var y: float = float(gy * GRID_SIZE)
		
		if t == "platform":
			if processed_platforms.has(key):
				continue
			var span: int = 1
			while cell_map.has("%d_%d" % [gx + span, gy]) and cell_map["%d_%d" % [gx + span, gy]].get("type") == "platform":
				processed_platforms["%d_%d" % [gx + span, gy]] = true
				span += 1
			
			var plat = SCENE_PLATFORM.instantiate()
			plat.set("platform_size", Vector2(span * GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE))
			plat.position = Vector2(x, y)
			playtest_world.add_child(plat)
			continue
			
		var node: Node2D = null
		match t:
			"trap_floor":
				node = SCENE_TRAP_FLOOR.instantiate()
				node.set("platform_size", Vector2(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE))
				node.position = Vector2(x, y)
			"spikes":
				node = SCENE_SPIKES.instantiate()
				node.set("spike_size", Vector2(GRID_SIZE, GRID_SIZE))
				node.position = Vector2(x, y)
			"pop_up_spikes":
				node = SCENE_POP_UP_SPIKES.instantiate()
				node.set("spike_width", float(GRID_SIZE))
				node.set("max_height", float(GRID_SIZE))
				node.position = Vector2(x, y + GRID_SIZE)
			"saw":
				node = SCENE_SAW.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
				node.set("patrol_distance", float(elem.get("move_distance", 64.0)))
				node.set("saw_radius", 16.0)
			"circular_saw":
				node = SCENE_CIRCULAR_SAW.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
				node.set("orbit_radius", float(elem.get("orbit_radius", 64.0)))
				node.set("saw_radius", 16.0)
			"spike_ball":
				node = SCENE_SPIKE_BALL.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y + 16)
				node.set("chain_length", float(elem.get("chain_length", 64.0)))
				node.set("ball_radius", 16.0)
			"crusher":
				node = SCENE_CRUSHER.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x, y)
				node.set("crusher_size", Vector2(64, 64))
				node.set("target_y", y + 160.0)
			"spring":
				node = SCENE_SPRING.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x, y)
			"falling":
				node = SCENE_FALLING_SPIKE.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y)
			"laser":
				node = SCENE_LASER.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y)
				node.set("beam_length", float(elem.get("beam_length", 160.0)))
			"fake_door":
				node = SCENE_FAKE_DOOR.instantiate()
				node.position = Vector2(x + 16, y + 32)
				
		if node:
			playtest_world.add_child(node)
			
	# Chiqish darvozasi
	var door = SCENE_EXIT_DOOR.instantiate()
	door.position = exit_door_pos
	playtest_world.add_child(door)

	# Chegaraviy devorlar va shift
	var cw := _get_canvas_width()
	var left_w = SCENE_PLATFORM.instantiate()
	left_w.position = Vector2(0, 0)
	left_w.set("platform_size", Vector2(32, 540))
	playtest_world.add_child(left_w)
	
	var right_w = SCENE_PLATFORM.instantiate()
	right_w.position = Vector2(cw - 32, 0)
	right_w.set("platform_size", Vector2(32, 540))
	playtest_world.add_child(right_w)
	
	var ceiling = SCENE_PLATFORM.instantiate()
	ceiling.position = Vector2(0, 0)
	ceiling.set("platform_size", Vector2(cw, 60))
	playtest_world.add_child(ceiling)
	
	# O'yinchi (faqat bitta marta yaratiladi!)
	_spawn_test_player_once()

func _spawn_test_player_once() -> void:
	for p in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("player"):
		p.queue_free()
		
	var player = SCENE_PLAYER.instantiate()
	player.name = "Player"
	player.position = player_spawn
	player.spawn_position = player_spawn
	playtest_world.add_child(player)

func _clear_test_world() -> void:
	for c in playtest_world.get_children():
		c.queue_free()

func _on_custom_player_died() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("die")
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.35).timeout
	if is_testing:
		for c in playtest_world.get_children():
			if c.has_method("reset_trap"):
				c.reset_trap()

func _on_custom_level_completed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("win")
	_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("test_won_notice"))
	await get_tree().create_timer(1.2).timeout
	if is_testing:
		_on_stop_test_pressed()

# --- Saqlash va Yuklash ---
func _on_slot_selected(idx: int) -> void:
	var id := slot_btn.get_item_id(idx)
	if id == 99:
		# Qayta yuklash (Revert)
		SoundManager.play("click")
		_load_slot(current_slot)
		_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("reloaded_notice", [current_slot]))
		_select_current_slot_in_dropdown()
		_set_save_mode(false)
		return
		
	if id >= 1 and id <= 5:
		current_slot = id
		SoundManager.play("click")
		_load_slot(current_slot)
		_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("loaded_notice", [current_slot]))
		_select_current_slot_in_dropdown()

func _snap_door_pos(raw: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var gx: int = clampi(int(floor(raw.x / float(GRID_SIZE))), 0, _get_cols() - 1)
	var gy: int = clampi(int(round(raw.y / float(GRID_SIZE))), MIN_ROW, MAX_ROW + 1)
	return Vector2(float(gx * GRID_SIZE + 16), float(gy * GRID_SIZE))

func _snap_player_pos(raw: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var gx: int = clampi(int(floor(raw.x / float(GRID_SIZE))), 0, _get_cols() - 1)
	var gy: int = clampi(int(round(raw.y / float(GRID_SIZE))), MIN_ROW, MAX_ROW + 1)
	return Vector2(float(gx * GRID_SIZE + 16), float(gy * GRID_SIZE))

func _load_slot(slot: int) -> void:
	cell_map.clear()
	var data: Dictionary = CustomLevelManager.load_custom_level(slot)
	var raw_p = data.get("player_spawn", [144, 384])
	player_spawn = _snap_player_pos(Vector2(float(raw_p[0]), float(raw_p[1])))
	
	var raw_d = data.get("exit_door", [848, 384])
	exit_door_pos = _snap_door_pos(Vector2(float(raw_d[0]), float(raw_d[1])))
	
	var raw_elements: Array = data.get("elements", [])
	for elem in raw_elements:
		var gx: int = int(elem.get("gx", int(elem.get("x", 0) / float(GRID_SIZE))))
		var gy: int = int(elem.get("gy", int(elem.get("y", 0) / float(GRID_SIZE))))
		gx = clampi(gx, 0, _get_cols() - 1)
		gy = clampi(gy, MIN_ROW, MAX_ROW)
		var key := "%d_%d" % [gx, gy]
		var clean_elem: Dictionary = elem.duplicate()
		clean_elem["gx"] = gx
		clean_elem["gy"] = gy
		clean_elem["x"] = gx * GRID_SIZE
		clean_elem["y"] = gy * GRID_SIZE
		cell_map[key] = clean_elem
		
	canvas.queue_redraw()
	
	var file_path := CustomLevelManager.get_slot_path(slot)
	_set_save_mode(not FileAccess.file_exists(file_path))

func _set_save_mode(save_mode: bool) -> void:
	is_save_mode = save_mode
	if not save_btn: return
	if is_save_mode:
		save_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("save", 0.8)
		save_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_save")
		save_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.9, 0.88, 0.92, 1))
	else:
		save_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("load", 0.8)
		save_btn.text = " " + LocaleManager.t("btn_load")
		save_btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.38, 0.85, 1.0, 1))

func _on_save_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if is_save_mode:
		var elements_list: Array = []
		for key in cell_map:
			elements_list.append(cell_map[key])
			
		var data := {
			"name": "Slot %d Zonasi" % current_slot,
			"player_spawn": [player_spawn.x, player_spawn.y],
			"exit_door": [exit_door_pos.x, exit_door_pos.y],
			"elements": elements_list
		}
		var ok: bool = CustomLevelManager.save_custom_level(current_slot, data)
		if ok:
			_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("saved_notice"))
			_setup_slots()
			_set_save_mode(false)
	else:
		# Yuklash holatida bosilsa - oxirgi saqlangan holat yuklanadi
		_load_slot(current_slot)
		_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("reloaded_notice", [current_slot]))

func _on_load_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	_load_slot(current_slot)

func _on_clear_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	cell_map.clear()
	player_spawn = Vector2(144, 384)
	exit_door_pos = Vector2(848, 384)
	canvas.queue_redraw()
	_show_toast(LocaleManager.t("cleared_notice"))
	_set_save_mode(true)

func _on_back_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	var adm = get_node_or_null("/root/AdManager")
	if adm and adm.has_method("show_banner"):
		adm.show_banner()
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file("res://scenes/main/main_menu.tscn")

func _show_toast(msg: String) -> void:
	if not toast_lbl: return
	toast_lbl.text = msg
	toast_lbl.visible = true
	var tw := create_tween()
	toast_lbl.modulate.a = 1.0
	tw.tween_interval(1.8)
	tw.tween_property(toast_lbl, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.4)
	tw.tween_callback(func(): toast_lbl.visible = false)

func _setup_touch_controls() -> void:
	var left_btn = get_node_or_null("PlaytestUI/TouchControls/DPad/LeftBtn")
	var right_btn = get_node_or_null("PlaytestUI/TouchControls/DPad/RightBtn")
	var jump_btn = get_node_or_null("PlaytestUI/TouchControls/Action/JumpBtn")
	
	if left_btn: _bind_touch(left_btn, "move_left")
	if right_btn: _bind_touch(right_btn, "move_right")
	if jump_btn: _bind_touch(jump_btn, "jump")

func _bind_touch(btn: Button, action: String) -> void:
	btn.button_down.connect(func(): Input.action_press(action))
	btn.button_up.connect(func(): Input.action_release(action))
	btn.mouse_exited.connect(func():
		if Input.is_action_pressed(action):
			Input.action_release(action)
	)

func open() -> void:
	visible = true
	modulate.a = 0.0
	var tween := create_tween()
	tween.tween_property(self, "modulate:a", 1.0, 0.2)
	
	if tag_input:
		tag_input.text = ""
		
	is_in_lobby = not DuelService.active_duel_id.is_empty()
	_update_view_state()
	
	if not is_in_lobby:
		_load_and_render_friends()

func _update_view_state() -> void:
	if search_box: search_box.visible = not is_in_lobby
	if lobby_box: lobby_box.visible = is_in_lobby
	if incoming_box: incoming_box.visible = false
	if countdown_label: countdown_label.visible = false
	if proposal_panel: proposal_panel.visible = true
	
	if is_in_lobby:
		_refresh_player_cards()
		_update_action_buttons()
		_update_selected_level_card()

func _update_action_buttons() -> void:
	if DuelService.is_bot_duel:
		if propose_btn: propose_btn.visible = false
		if play_bot_btn:
			play_bot_btn.visible = true
			play_bot_btn.text = "Duelni Boshlash (AI Ghost)"
			_style_button(play_bot_btn, "white")
		if leave_lobby_btn:
			leave_lobby_btn.text = "Ortga"
	else:
		if propose_btn:
			propose_btn.visible = true
			propose_btn.text = "Raqibga Taklif Qilish"
			_style_button(propose_btn, "white")
		if play_bot_btn:
			play_bot_btn.visible = true
			play_bot_btn.text = "AI Ghost Bilan O'ynash"
			_style_button(play_bot_btn, "glass")
		if leave_lobby_btn:
			leave_lobby_btn.text = "Tark etish"

func _refresh_player_cards() -> void:
	var d: Dictionary = DuelService.active_duel
	if d.is_empty():
		return
	var my_id := ProfileManager.player_id
	var pa_id: String = str(d.get("player_a_id", ""))
	var pb_id: String = str(d.get("player_b_id", ""))
	
	if player_a_name:
		player_a_name.text = ProfileManager.username if (pa_id == my_id or DuelService.is_bot_duel) else "Raqib"
		player_a_tag.text = ""
		
	if player_b_name:
		if DuelService.is_bot_duel or pb_id == "bot_ghost":
			player_b_name.text = "AI Ghost Bot"
			player_b_tag.text = "Mashg'ulot Raqibi"
		else:
			player_b_name.text = "Raqib" if pa_id == my_id else ProfileManager.username
			player_b_tag.text = "Ulangan" if pa_id != my_id else "Kutilmoqda..."

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Boblar va Darajalar Tanlash (Interactive Chapter Tabs & Level Grid)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _on_chapter_tab_pressed(chapter: int) -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	selected_chapter = chapter
	_update_chapter_tabs()
	_setup_level_grid(chapter)
	_update_selected_level_card()

func _update_chapter_tabs() -> void:
	if btn_ch1: _style_button(btn_ch1, "white" if selected_chapter == 1 else "glass")
	if btn_ch2: _style_button(btn_ch2, "white" if selected_chapter == 2 else "glass")
	if btn_ch3: _style_button(btn_ch3, "white" if selected_chapter == 3 else "glass")

func _setup_level_grid(chapter: int) -> void:
	if not level_grid:
		return
		
	for child in level_grid.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
		
	var start_lvl := (chapter - 1) * 20 + 1
	var end_lvl := chapter * 20
	
	for lvl in range(start_lvl, end_lvl + 1):
		var lvl_in_ch := ((lvl - 1) % 20) + 1
		var btn := Button.new()
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(58, 32)
		btn.text = "%d" % lvl
		btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		btn.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
		
		var is_selected := (chapter == selected_chapter and lvl_in_ch == selected_level_in_chapter)
		_style_level_button(btn, is_selected)
		
		btn.pressed.connect(func():
			_on_level_selected(chapter, lvl_in_ch)
		)
		
		level_grid.add_child(btn)

func _on_level_selected(chapter: int, lvl_in_ch: int) -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	selected_chapter = chapter
	selected_level_in_chapter = lvl_in_ch
	
	# Barcha tugmalarni yangilash
	if level_grid:
		var children = level_grid.get_children()
		for i in range(children.size()):
			var b = children[i] as Button
			if b:
				var is_sel := ((i + 1) == lvl_in_ch)
				_style_level_button(b, is_sel)
				
	_update_selected_level_card()

func _update_selected_level_card() -> void:
	var actual_level := (selected_chapter - 1) * 20 + selected_level_in_chapter
	var l_data: Dictionary = {}
	var ldb = get_node_or_null("/root/LevelDatabase")
	if ldb and ldb.has_method("get_level"):
		l_data = ldb.get_level(actual_level)
		
	var title_str: String = str(l_data.get("title", "%d-Daraja" % actual_level))
	
	if selected_badge:
		selected_badge.text = "%d-BOB · DARAJA %d" % [selected_chapter, actual_level]
		
	if selected_title:
		selected_title.text = "Nomi: " + title_str
		
	if selected_gimmick:
		match selected_chapter:
			1: selected_gimmick.text = "Qorong'i O'rmon"
			2: selected_gimmick.text = "Qorli Cho'qqilar"
			3: selected_gimmick.text = "Yashil O'rmon"

func _style_level_button(btn: Button, is_selected: bool) -> void:
	var normal := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	normal.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	normal.content_margin_left = 6.0
	normal.content_margin_right = 6.0
	normal.content_margin_top = 4.0
	normal.content_margin_bottom = 4.0
	
	var hover := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	hover.set_corner_radius_all(10)
	hover.content_margin_left = 6.0
	hover.content_margin_right = 6.0
	hover.content_margin_top = 4.0
	hover.content_margin_bottom = 4.0
	
	if is_selected:
		normal.bg_color = Color(0.12, 0.24, 0.38, 0.95)
		normal.border_color = Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 1.0)
		normal.set_border_width_all(2)
		normal.shadow_color = Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.4)
		normal.shadow_size = 4
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
		
		hover.bg_color = Color(0.16, 0.30, 0.46, 1.0)
		hover.border_color = Color(0.40, 0.85, 1.0, 1.0)
		hover.set_border_width_all(2)
		hover.shadow_color = Color(0.22, 0.74, 0.97, 0.6)
		hover.shadow_size = 6
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
	else:
		normal.bg_color = Color(0.08, 0.11, 0.17, 0.85)
		normal.border_color = Color(0.22, 0.30, 0.45, 0.5)
		normal.set_border_width_all(1)
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.80, 0.88, 0.96, 0.9))
		
		hover.bg_color = Color(0.12, 0.18, 0.28, 0.95)
		hover.border_color = Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.85)
		hover.set_border_width_all(1)
		hover.shadow_color = Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97, 0.25)
		hover.shadow_size = 3
		btn.add_theme_color_override("font_hover_color", Color(1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0))
		
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", normal)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", hover)
	btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", normal)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# AI Ghost / Practice Duel Start
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _on_practice_bot_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	DuelService.setup_bot_duel(selected_chapter, selected_level_in_chapter)
	is_in_lobby = true
	_update_view_state()
	_set_search_status("Mashg'ulot dueli: O'zingiz xohlagan darajani tanlab 'Boshlash' tugmasini bosing!")

func _on_play_bot_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	# Har doim hozir tanlangan bob va daraja bilan bot duelini boshlash
	DuelService.setup_bot_duel(selected_chapter, selected_level_in_chapter)
	if proposal_panel: proposal_panel.visible = false
	_start_countdown_sequence(selected_chapter, selected_level_in_chapter, randi() % 999999)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Online Raqibga Taklif Yuborish (Negotiation)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _on_propose_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	_set_search_status("Taklif yuborilmoqda: %d-Bob, %d-Daraja..." % [selected_chapter, selected_level_in_chapter])
	DuelService.propose_level(selected_chapter, selected_level_in_chapter)

func _on_proposal_received(_proposer_id: String, zone_id: int, level_id: int, proposal_id: int) -> void:
	pending_proposal_id = proposal_id
	if incoming_box and proposal_text:
		var actual_lvl: int = (zone_id - 1) * 20 + level_id
		var l_data: Dictionary = {}
		var ldb = get_node_or_null("/root/LevelDatabase")
		if ldb and ldb.has_method("get_level"):
			l_data = ldb.get_level(actual_lvl)
		var title_str: String = str(l_data.get("title", "%d-Daraja" % actual_lvl))
		
		proposal_text.text = "Raqib taklifi: %d-Bob · %d-Daraja (\"%s\")" % [zone_id, actual_lvl, title_str]
		proposal_text.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.95, 0.98, 1, 1))
		incoming_box.visible = true
		SoundManager.play("win")

func _on_accept_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if pending_proposal_id > 0:
		DuelService.respond_proposal(pending_proposal_id, true)
		incoming_box.visible = false

func _on_reject_pressed() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if pending_proposal_id > 0:
		DuelService.respond_proposal(pending_proposal_id, false)
		incoming_box.visible = false

func _on_match_agreed(zone_id: int, level_id: int, random_seed: int) -> void:
	if incoming_box: incoming_box.visible = false
	if proposal_panel: proposal_panel.visible = false
	_start_countdown_sequence(zone_id, level_id, random_seed)

func _start_countdown_sequence(zone_id: int, level_id: int, random_seed: int) -> void:
	if not countdown_label:
		return
	countdown_label.visible = true
	
	for count in [3, 2, 1]:
		countdown_label.text = str(count)
		countdown_label.scale = Vector2(1.5, 1.5)
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_property(countdown_label, "scale", Vector2(1.0, 1.0), 0.35)
		SoundManager.play("click")
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.9).timeout
		
	countdown_label.text = "START!"
	SoundManager.play("win")
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout
	
	DuelService.start_match()
	duel_started.emit(zone_id, level_id, random_seed)
	visible = false

func _on_match_started(_started_at: String) -> void:
	pass

func _on_duel_updated(data: Dictionary) -> void:
	var status: String = str(data.get("duel_status", ""))
	if status == "LOBBY":
		is_in_lobby = true
		_update_view_state()

func _on_leave_lobby() -> void:
	SoundManager.play("click")
	if is_matchmaking:
		_cancel_matchmaking("Qidiruv bekor qilindi.")
	if DuelService.is_bot_duel:
		DuelService.leave_active_duel()
		is_in_lobby = false
		_update_view_state()
		return
		
	DuelService.leave_active_duel()
	is_in_lobby = false
	_update_view_state()
	visible = false

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Qidiruv va Taklif Yuborish (Direct Challenge & Matchmaking)
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _on_invite_pressed() -> void:
	if not tag_input:
		return
	var tag := tag_input.text.strip_edges().to_upper()
	if tag.begins_with("#"):
		tag = tag.trim_prefix("#")
	if tag.is_empty():
		_set_search_status("Iltimos, do'stingiz ID sini kiriting (masalan WW-1234)")
		return
		
	_send_direct_invite(tag, tag)

func _send_direct_invite(tag: String, display_name: String) -> void:
	_set_search_status("Taklif yuborilmoqda: %s..." % display_name)
	DuelService.send_invitation(tag, func(res: Dictionary):
		if res.get("success", false):
			is_in_lobby = true
			_set_search_status("Taklif yuborildi! Raqib kutilmoqda...")
			_update_view_state()
		else:
			_set_search_status(res.get("message", "Taklif yuborib bo'lmadi"))
	)

func _on_random_btn_pressed() -> void:
	if is_matchmaking:
		_cancel_matchmaking("Qidiruv bekor qilindi.")
		return
		
	is_matchmaking = true
	mm_poll_timer = 0.0
	mm_dots_timer = 0.0
	mm_dots_count = 0
	if random_btn:
		random_btn.text = "Qidiruvni bekor qilish"
		random_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("close", 0.75)
	_set_search_status("Navbatga ulanmoqda...")
	
	DuelService.find_random_match(func(res: Dictionary):
		if res.get("matched", false):
			_on_matched_success()
	)

func _on_matched_success() -> void:
	is_matchmaking = false
	if random_btn:
		random_btn.text = "Tasodifiy Raqib Qidirish"
		random_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("lightning", 0.85)
	is_in_lobby = true
	_set_search_status("Raqib topildi! Lobbiyga ulanmoqda...")
	_update_view_state()

func _cancel_matchmaking(reason: String) -> void:
	is_matchmaking = false
	DuelService.cancel_matchmaking()
	if random_btn:
		random_btn.text = "Tasodifiy Raqib Qidirish"
		random_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("lightning", 0.85)
	_set_search_status(reason)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_matchmaking:
		mm_poll_timer += delta
		mm_dots_timer += delta
		
		if mm_dots_timer >= 0.4:
			mm_dots_timer = 0.0
			mm_dots_count = (mm_dots_count + 1) % 4
			var dots := ".".repeat(mm_dots_count)
			if search_status:
				search_status.text = "Onlayn raqib qidirilmoqda" + dots
				
		if mm_poll_timer >= 1.5:
			mm_poll_timer = 0.0
			DuelService.poll_match_status(func(res: Dictionary):
				if res.get("matched", false):
					_on_matched_success()
			)

func _set_search_status(msg: String) -> void:
	if search_status:
		search_status.text = msg

func _on_copy_my_id() -> void:
	DisplayServer.clipboard_set(ProfileManager.player_tag)
	if copy_id_btn:
		copy_id_btn.text = "Olingan!"
		copy_id_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("check", 0.75)
		var tw := create_tween()
		tw.tween_interval(1.5)
		tw.tween_callback(func():
			if copy_id_btn:
				copy_id_btn.text = "Nusxa"
				copy_id_btn.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("copy", 0.75)
		)
	_set_search_status("ID xotiraga nusxalandi: #" + ProfileManager.player_tag)

# -------------------------------------------------------------
# Do'stlar va Faol O'yinchilar Ro'yxati
# -------------------------------------------------------------
func _load_and_render_friends() -> void:
	if not friends_vbox:
		return
		
	for child in friends_vbox.get_children():
		child.queue_free()
		
	var loading_lbl := Label.new()
	loading_lbl.text = "O'yinchilar ro'yxati yangilanmoqda..."
	loading_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	loading_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.5, 0.6, 0.75))
	loading_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
	friends_vbox.add_child(loading_lbl)
	
	DuelService.fetch_active_players(func(active_list: Array):
		if not is_inside_tree() or not friends_vbox:
			return
		for child in friends_vbox.get_children():
			child.queue_free()
			
		var local_friends: Array = ProfileManager.get_saved_friends()
		var combined_map: Dictionary = {}
		
		# 1. Avval saqlangan mahalliy do'stlar
		for f in local_friends:
			if f is Dictionary:
				var t: String = str(f.get("player_tag", "")).strip_edges().to_upper()
				if not t.is_empty() and t != ProfileManager.player_tag:
					combined_map[t] = {
						"tag": t,
						"name": str(f.get("username", t)),
						"is_friend": true
					}
					
		# 2. Keyin Supabase'dagi boshqa faol o'yinchilar
		for p in active_list:
			if p is Dictionary:
				var t: String = str(p.get("player_tag", "")).strip_edges().to_upper()
				if not t.is_empty() and t != ProfileManager.player_tag and not combined_map.has(t):
					combined_map[t] = {
						"tag": t,
						"name": str(p.get("username", t)),
						"is_friend": false
					}
					
		if combined_map.is_empty():
			var empty_lbl := Label.new()
			empty_lbl.text = "Hozircha do'stlar yo'q. ID kiriting yoki Mashg'ulot (AI Ghost) duelini sinab ko'ring!"
			empty_lbl.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
			empty_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.5, 0.6, 0.75))
			empty_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 12)
			friends_vbox.add_child(empty_lbl)
			return
			
		for t_key in combined_map.keys():
			var item: Dictionary = combined_map[t_key]
			_create_friend_card(item["tag"], item["name"], item["is_friend"])
	)

func _create_friend_card(tag: String, uname: String, is_friend: bool) -> void:
	var card := PanelContainer.new()
	var card_style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	card_style.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.10, 0.16, 0.85)
	card_style.border_color = Color(0.20, 0.30, 0.45, 0.50)
	card_style.set_border_width_all(1)
	card_style.set_corner_radius_all(12)
	card_style.content_margin_left = 12.0
	card_style.content_margin_right = 12.0
	card_style.content_margin_top = 6.0
	card_style.content_margin_bottom = 6.0
	card.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", card_style)
	
	var hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	card.add_child(hbox)
	
	# Icon
	var icon := IconFactory.create_texture_rect("users_white", Vector2(16, 16), 0.75)
	icon.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	hbox.add_child(icon)
	
	# Name & Tag VBox
	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 1)
	
	var name_lbl := Label.new()
	name_lbl.text = uname
	name_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
	name_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.95, 0.98, 1.0))
	vbox.add_child(name_lbl)
	
	var tag_lbl := Label.new()
	tag_lbl.text = "#" + tag + (" · Do'st" if is_friend else " · Onlayn")
	tag_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 10)
	tag_lbl.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.38, 0.74, 0.97))
	vbox.add_child(tag_lbl)
	
	hbox.add_child(vbox)
	
	# Quick Invite Button
	var invite_btn_card := Button.new()
	invite_btn_card.text = "Chaqirish"
	invite_btn_card.icon = IconFactory.get_icon("swords", 0.75)
	invite_btn_card.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(95, 28)
	invite_btn_card.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 11)
	_style_button(invite_btn_card, "chip")
	
	invite_btn_card.pressed.connect(func():
		_send_direct_invite(tag, uname)
	)
	hbox.add_child(invite_btn_card)
	
	friends_vbox.add_child(card)

# DuelService - Wrong Way 1v1 Competitive Multiplayer Engine
# - Synchronizes invitations, negotiation proposals, countdowns, and finishes via Supabase
# - Real-time state polling + event distribution
# - Zero race-condition atomic finish integration

signal invitation_received(duel_data: Dictionary, sender_tag: String, sender_name: String)
signal duel_updated(duel_data: Dictionary)
signal proposal_received(proposer_id: String, zone_id: int, level_id: int, proposal_id: int)
signal match_agreed(zone_id: int, level_id: int, seed_num: int)
signal match_started(started_at: String)
signal match_finished(is_victory: bool, winner_id: String)
signal opponent_disconnected_alert(seconds_left: int)

var SUPABASE_URL: String = Env.get_supabase_url()
var SUPABASE_ANON_KEY: String = Env.get_supabase_anon_key()

var active_duel: Dictionary = {}
var active_duel_id: String = ""
var is_polling: bool = false
var poll_timer: float = 0.0
const POLL_INTERVAL: float = 0.85

var last_proposal_id: int = 0
var last_status: String = ""

# Aloqa uzilishi tekshiruvi (10s countdown)
var is_opponent_disconnected: bool = false
var disconnect_countdown: float = 10.0

# AI Ghost / Practice Bot Duel tizimi
var is_bot_duel: bool = false
var bot_target_time_ms: float = 0.0
var bot_timer_active: bool = false
var bot_elapsed_time: float = 0.0

func _ready() -> void:
	# Bosh menyuda turganida ham kelayotgan takliflarni tekshirish uchun fon taymeri
	# TAVSIYA: Agar multiplayer hozirgi relizda shart bo'lmasa, batareya va internetni
	# asrash maqsadida 3 soniyalik doimiy background polling to'xtatib qo'yildi.
	pass
	# var bg_timer := Timer.new()
	# bg_timer.wait_time = 3.0
	# bg_timer.autostart = true
	# bg_timer.timeout.connect(_check_pending_invitations)
	# add_child(bg_timer)

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if is_bot_duel and bot_timer_active and GameManager.is_duel_mode and GameManager.is_level_running:
		bot_elapsed_time += delta * 1000.0
		if bot_elapsed_time >= bot_target_time_ms:
			bot_timer_active = false
			GameManager.is_level_running = false
			match_finished.emit(false, "bot_ghost")

	if is_polling and not active_duel_id.is_empty() and not is_bot_duel:
		poll_timer += delta
		if poll_timer >= POLL_INTERVAL:
			poll_timer = 0.0
			_poll_active_duel()
			
	if is_opponent_disconnected and not active_duel_id.is_empty() and not is_bot_duel:
		disconnect_countdown -= delta
		opponent_disconnected_alert.emit(int(ceil(disconnect_countdown)))
		if disconnect_countdown <= 0.0:
			is_opponent_disconnected = false
			_trigger_forfeit()

func search_player(tag: String, on_result: Callable) -> void:
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, code, _h, body):
		http.queue_free()
		if code == 200:
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(body.get_string_from_utf8())
			on_result.call(parsed)
		else:
			on_result.call({"success": false, "message": "Server xatosi: %d" % code})
	)
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/rpc/search_player_by_tag"
	var headers := _get_headers()
	var payload := JSON.stringify({"p_player_tag": tag})
	http.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func fetch_active_players(on_result: Callable) -> void:
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, code, _h, body):
		http.queue_free()
		if code == 200:
			var arr = JSON.parse_string(body.get_string_from_utf8())
			if arr is Array:
				var filtered: Array = []
				var my_id: String = ProfileManager.player_id
				var my_tag: String = ProfileManager.player_tag
				for p in arr:
					if p is Dictionary:
						var p_id: String = str(p.get("id", ""))
						var p_tag: String = str(p.get("player_tag", ""))
						if p_id != my_id and p_tag != my_tag and not p_tag.is_empty():
							filtered.append(p)
				on_result.call(filtered)
				return
		on_result.call([])
	)
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/profiles?select=id,username,player_tag,avatar_url&limit=10&order=updated_at.desc"
	http.request(url, _get_headers(), HTTPClient.METHOD_GET)

func send_invitation(target_tag: String, on_result: Callable) -> void:
	var my_id: String = ProfileManager.player_id
	if my_id.is_empty():
		on_result.call({"success": false, "message": "Avval profilingiz yuklanishi kerak"})
		return
		
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, code, _h, body):
		http.queue_free()
		if code == 200:
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(body.get_string_from_utf8())
			if parsed is Dictionary and parsed.get("success", false):
				var duel: Dictionary = parsed.get("duel", {})
				set_active_duel(duel)
				ProfileManager.add_recent_friend(target_tag)
			on_result.call(parsed)
		else:
			on_result.call({"success": false, "message": "Taklif yuborishda xatolik"})
	)
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/rpc/create_duel_invitation"
	var headers := _get_headers()
	var payload := JSON.stringify({
		"p_sender_id": my_id,
		"p_target_tag": target_tag
	})
	http.request(url, headers, HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

	var my_id := ProfileManager.player_id

func setup_bot_duel(zone_id: int, level_id: int) -> void:
	is_bot_duel = true
	bot_timer_active = false
	bot_elapsed_time = 0.0
	var actual_lvl: int = (zone_id - 1) * 20 + level_id
	
	# Har bir daraja uchun raqobatbardosh, lekin yutsa bo'ladigan bot vaqti
	var base_sec: float = 11.5 + (float(actual_lvl) * 0.22)
	var bot_sec: float = base_sec + randf_range(-0.8, 1.8)
	bot_target_time_ms = bot_sec * 1000.0
	
	active_duel = {
		"id": "bot_session_local",
		"player_a_id": ProfileManager.player_id,
		"player_b_id": "bot_ghost",
		"selected_zone_id": zone_id,
		"selected_level_id": level_id,
		"random_seed": randi() % 999999,
		"duel_status": "LOBBY"
	}
	active_duel_id = "bot_session_local"
	is_polling = false
	duel_updated.emit(active_duel)

func start_bot_match_timer() -> void:
	if is_bot_duel:
		bot_timer_active = true
		bot_elapsed_time = 0.0

func start_match() -> void:
	if is_bot_duel:
		start_bot_match_timer()
		return
	if active_duel_id.is_empty():
		return
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, _c, _h, _b): http.queue_free())
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/rpc/start_duel_match"
	var payload := JSON.stringify({"p_duel_id": active_duel_id})
	http.request(url, _get_headers(), HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

# ========================================================
# 3. ATOMIK G'OLIBLIKNI ANIQLASH (CLAIM FINISH)
# ========================================================
func claim_finish(completion_ms: float, deaths: int, on_result: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
	if is_bot_duel:
		bot_timer_active = false
		GameManager.is_level_running = false
		var won: bool = (completion_ms <= bot_target_time_ms)
		match_finished.emit(won, ProfileManager.player_id if won else "bot_ghost")
		if on_result.is_valid():
			on_result.call({"success": true, "result": "VICTORY" if won else "DEFEAT"})
		return
	if active_duel_id.is_empty():
		return
	var my_id := ProfileManager.player_id
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, code, _h, body):
		http.queue_free()
		if code == 200:
			var parsed = JSON.parse_string(body.get_string_from_utf8())
			var is_win: bool = (parsed.get("result", "") == "VICTORY")
			var winner: String = str(parsed.get("winner_id", my_id))
			match_finished.emit(is_win, winner)
			if on_result.is_valid(): on_result.call(parsed)
	)
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/rpc/claim_duel_finish"
	var payload := JSON.stringify({
		"p_duel_id": active_duel_id,
		"p_player_id": my_id,
		"p_completion_time_ms": completion_ms,
		"p_deaths": deaths
	})
	http.request(url, _get_headers(), HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)

func _trigger_forfeit() -> void:
	if active_duel_id.is_empty():
		return
	var opponent_id := get_opponent_id()
	var http := HTTPRequest.new()
	add_child(http)
	http.request_completed.connect(func(_res, _c, _h, _b):
		http.queue_free()
		match_finished.emit(true, ProfileManager.player_id)
	)
	var url := SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/rpc/forfeit_duel_disconnect"
	var payload := JSON.stringify({
		"p_duel_id": active_duel_id,
		"p_disconnected_id": opponent_id
	})
	http.request(url, _get_headers(), HTTPClient.METHOD_POST, payload)
